ba si 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()bcu bdun po de yang rten dang dpyod pa dang 'bras bu gsum gyi dbang du mdzad nas bstan la/ de la'ang gsum ste/ rnam shes lnga ldan gyi sa dang yid kyi saganyis rten gyi rang bzhin no/ /rtog bcas dpyo /da bcas dang /rtog med dpyod bcas dang / rtog med dpyod med kyi sa ste/ gsum rten gyi 'jug tshul lo/ /mnyam par bzhag ma bzhag dang / sems yod med kyi sa ste/ bzhi rten gyi skabs so/ /spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sa gsum mo//'bras bu la gnas skabs kyi 'brabs bu nyan sa byang sa rang sa gsum/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu phung po lhag bcas lhag med do/ /de'i 'grel pa lta bu rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba ste/ sa'i dngos gzhi'i tshig don gnyis ka mu bzhi la sogs par gtan la dbab par bstan la rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ma gtogs pa la bsdu ba gtan la dbab pa yod do/ /de gnyis kyis gsung rab rnams kyi don bstan no/ /gzhi bsdu ba ni/ sngar gyi gzhung de dag sde snod gsum du bsdu tshul te/ 'di'i mdor bstan du sde snod gsum ga bsdu ba smos nas rgyasabashad du mdo sde dang 'dul ba bsdu ba gnyis las ma bshad pa ni ma mo bsdu ba sa sde lnga po nyid yin pas logs su ma bshad de/ thos pa'i sa gtan la dbab pa bsdu bar/ de la ma mo bsdu ba ni sa bcu bdun dang bsdu ba bzhi'o zhes 'byung bas so/ /rnam grangs bsdu ba ni rjod byed ming gi rnam grangs bstan pa'am kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi rnam grangs bye brag tu 'chad pa'o/ /de gnyis gzhung ngo / /rnam par bshad pa'i sgo ba/ ba ni de dag bshad tshul ston pa ste/ de

ltar gsung rab kyi don dang gzhu/rdo/rdzu/sdo/tshul gyi dbang gis sde lnga'o/ /sdom rnam pa gnyis kyi theg pa thun mong gi sdom mngon pa kun las btus ni mtshan nyid kun las ba yis pa dang / bden pa rnam nges/ chos rnam nges/ thob pa rnam nges/ 'bel gtam rnam nges te lngar bsdus nas ston pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i sdom theg chen bsdus pa ni shes bya'i gnas la sogs pa don bcus theg chen bsdus nas ston pa'o/ /dbyig gnyen gyi rab tu byed pa sde brgyad ni chos thams cad sems tsam du ston pa sum cu pa/ de rigs pas sgrub pa nyi shu pa/de'i gzhi phung po lnga 'thad par ston pa phung po lnga pa/ de ltar yin yang bshad nyan 'thad par ston pa rnam bshad rigs pa/ sgo gsum gyi las 'thad par ston pa las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa ste rang rgyud du brtsams pa lnga/ phyin drug sogasaspyod pa rgya chen dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang / mtshan nyid gsum 'thad par ston pa mdo sde rgyan/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/ dbus dang mtha' rnam 'byed gsum gyi 'grel pa ste/ gzhan 'grel du brtsams pa gsum ste brgyad do/ /zhesagasungs so/ kha cig slob dpon 'dis sa bcu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mang du mdzad pas sde brgyad nges pa med cing byams pa dang 'grel ba'i chos nyi shu'i grangs nges med zer ro/ /grangs nges mdzad pa rnams ni/ sa sde lnga sdom gnyisabyams chos lnga rab tu byed pa sde brgyad de/ de dag la 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni/sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bstan bcos kyi rigs bsdu na/ bka' la mi brten pa dang /brten pa gnyis/ mi brten pa la bka' nyid la 'grel pa btab pa dang / bka'i 45

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()don rang rgyud du brtsams pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang tshig don gnyis ka rgya cher 'grel pa so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa lta bu rgya cher 'grel/tshig gi cha spros pa dang bcas nas 'chad pa ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa lta bu tshig gi 'grel pa/ go dka' ba'i don rnam par 'byed pa sdud 'grel gnyis lta bu dka' 'grel/ don gyi gtso bo bsdus nas ston pa sdud pa'i don bsdus dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa lta bu bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ ngag gi don dril nas ston pa ngag don tsam gyi 'grel pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/bka' gcig gi don rdzogs par ston pa dang / thor bur ston pa dang / bka' mang po'i don ston pa gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan nam mdo rtsa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge tshul gyi kā ri kā lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bslab btus sam bshes spring la sogs pa'o/ /spyir 'grel pa la 'grel pa dang bshad pa rnam par bshad pa dang bshad sbyar dang / don bsdus dang / dka' 'grel dang rgya cher 'grel dang legs par sbyar ba dang / rnam par phye ba la sogs pa ming mang po 'byung ngo / /de ltar bstan bcos kyi dbye ba ni/ blo gros 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos tsam gyi dbye ba yin la/ sngar gyi mtshan nyid dang nges tshig ni / bstan bcos khyad par can gyi yin pas 'gal bar mi bsam mo/ /gsum pa la bzhi ste/ bshad bya chos kyi khyad par/ slob dpon gyisa'achad tshul gyi khyad par/ slob mas mnyan tshul gyi khyad par/ gnyis kas chosakyi don sgrub par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir shes bya la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos sna tshogs la bslab dgos te/ 'dul ba las kyang phyi rol 46

bu ston chos 'byung /pa'i bstan bcos la sogs pa'ang bslab par gsungs shing byang sems kyis ni khyad par du thams cad la bslab par gsungs so/ /'on kyang gtso bo lam du 'gro ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bshad nyan byed dgos la bstan pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/ 'od ldan las/ bslab pa gsum ni rab ston cing / /phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /sangs rgyabs gsung du mkhas pas rtogs/ /zhes bsgrub bya bslab pa gsum/ lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya gsum ste/ cho me thams cad bdag med/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas kyi 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal ba ste gsum ston cing ngo bo thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba la bshad do / / so sgo thar par/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdo las/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba / mtha' mar dge ba/ don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba zhes gsungs shing thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba ni thogs med la sogs pas thos bsam sgom gsum la bshad/ kha cig mdo'i mgor gleng gzhi/ bar du mdo dngos/ mthar mthun 'gyur yi rang ste gsum la 'chad/ slob dpon dge ba'i lhas bstan bcos kyi thog mar mchod brjod/ bar du bstan bcos kyi lus/ mtha' mar bsngo ba gsum la bshad do/ /'dir rnam bshad rigs pa ltar bshad na/ thog ma dang bar dang mtha' ma ni tshul khrims dang 4/7ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung po

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()yongs su nyams pa med pas dge ba'o/ /don bzang po ni phyin ci ma log pa'i brjod par bya ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /tshig 'bru bzang po ni go bar byed pas rjod par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ma 'dres pa ni gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /yongs su rdzogs pa ni nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen po'i phyir ro / / yongs su dag pa ni rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol bsango bo nyid rnam par grol ba'o/ /yongs su byang ba ni sa gzhan gyi nyon mongs kyi bag la nyal spangs pas rgyud rnam par grol ba'o/ /de dag dang ldan pa ni dam pa'i chos su rtogs par bya'o/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chosani 'phags pa'i bden pa mdo sde la 'jug nyon mongs pa 'dul ba la snang /rten 'brel gyi chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba zhig yin pa theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs yin zhid / theg chen gyi lugs kyis(rgyud bla mar sngar bshad pa bzhin nam/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dad dang dga' dang blo rnams kyi/ khyu phyir chos 'di dge ba yin/ /don rnam gnyis ldan gzung sla dang / /yon tan bzhi can tshangasaspyod ston/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma yin ldan pa dang / khams gsum nyen mongasarnam spong rdzogs byed dang / /ngo bo nyid dag dri ma dag pa ste/ /tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan yin par 'dod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i lugs kyis/ ji skad du/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /gang la sems ni rab sgom byed/ /de nyid sang rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa'o/ /zhes pas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bshad do/ /de lta bu'i bstan pa bka'am bstan bcos khyad par can de yang tshig 48

bu ston cho 'byung /dang don gyis gnyis su 'dus te/mdo sde rgyan las/ji ltar mnam na rab dku la / / myangs na zhim pa'i sman bzhin du//chos kyang de bzhin gnyis su gnas//don dang yi ger shes par bya//zhes gsungs so//don phun sum tsho gis pa tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan la sogs pa'o//yi ge phun sum tsho gis pa ni mdo sde rgyan las/bstan dang de bzhin bshad pa dang //theg dang mthun dang bde ba dang //grags pa dang ni ci rigs dang //nges par 'byung dang mthun pa'i phyir//de mdor sems dpa' mchog rnams kyi//yi ge phun tshogs yin zhes bya//zhes so//rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba las kyang mdo sde'i lus ni rnam par gnyisate tshig 'bru dang don to zhes so//de la tshig 'bru ni gnas yin la/don ni de la gnas pa yin par rig par bya'o//de gnyis ka bsdus pa ni shes par bya ba yin no zhesapa dang /chos mchog chung ngur yang rab tu byed pa'i lus ni rnam pa gnyis te sgra dang don to//zhes so//des na bshad bya'i chos ni sangs rgyas kyisagasungs/sdud pa pos bsdus/mkhas grub rnams kyis bkral/lo paṇa skyesamachog rnams kyis bsgyur/bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang lung dang ldan pa'i rgyud sde'am mdo sde bka'am bstan bcos mdo sde mngon pa 'dul ba'i sde snod gang yin pa 'di dang 'di 'chad ces bya'o//gnyis pa la gang gis 'chad pa slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/gang la brten nas bshad pa'i thabs/ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul dang gsum mo//dang po la gzhung so sor slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs te/sum brgya pa las/tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes//nad par snying brtse 'khor ni dad pa dang //chos dang 49

'tshe chen 'od snang ga 'i rdzo 2 gung gces bsdus/()zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla mar bsngags/ /zhes pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gi /mtshan nyid mdor bsdus mkhyen par mdzod/ /chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod brten na/khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gus par mdzod/ /ces dang / zhi ba lhas/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /zhes pa dang / tsan+d+ra go mis/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ khus dang ldan la blang bar bya/ /zhesagasungs shing / mdo sde rgyan du/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhasaldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ /zhes tshul khrims dang ldan pas dul ba dang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas zhi ba dang shes rab dang ldan pas nyen mongs pa nyer zhi dang / yon tan gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas lhag pa dang / gzhan don la le lo med pas brtson 'grus dang bcas pa dang / thosapa che bas lung gis phyug pa dang / shes par bya ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu rtogasapa dang / tshig smra mkhas pa dang / zang zing la mi blta bas brtse ba dang / chosaston pa la skyo ba med pa ste chos bcu ldan dang / byang chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes lung gi yon tan thos pa mang ba/rtogs pa'i yon tan bden pa mthong ba/ tshig smra mkhas pa/ bsam pa zang zing la mi blta ba'i brtse ba can/ bsam sbyor snyoms las med pas skyo med de chos lnga ldan nam/50

bu ston chos 'byung /rgya che the tshom spong ba dang/ /gzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /ston pa phun tsho gos yin zhes bya/ /zhes mang du thos pas thosapa rgya che ba/shes rab che bas gdul bya'i the tshom spong ba/ sgo gsum dge bsabla mar gzung bar 'os pa/ nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi de kho na nyid ga rdzis ston pa ste chos bzhi ldan la bshad do/ /de dag kyang phal cher 'phags pa'i chos yin pas ldan par dka' yang med kha med kyi yan lag tu dgos pa ni/ gsum ste/mkhas pa'i shes rab/ brtse ba'i bsam pa/ sbyor ba bzod pa dang ldan gsum mo / / dang po la gsum ste/ bshad bya la mkhas pa dang / 'chad byed la mkhas pa dang / kun spyod la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po ni/shes bya'am sde snod kun lamakhasana'ang legs mod kyi 'dir gang 'chad pa de'i tshig don la lung rigs man ngag dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa zhig dbos te/ des gdul bya'i the tshom gcod nus pasaso / / gnyis pa ni rjod byed kyi brda dag pa dang / gang nas bshad kyang 'brel/ji tsam bshad kyang ran/ ji ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa gsum gyi ngag 'brel/gzhan dga' bar nus pa'i dbyangs snyan pa dang gsum la 'chad do/ /yang na mdo sde rgyan nas/ ngag tshig shin tu rigs pa dang / /bstan dang rnam 'byed the tshom gcod/ /lan mang byed dang ldan pa ni/ /mgo smos rnam spros go rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa ni/ /'khor gsum gyis ni dag pa ste/ /'di ni nyes pa brgyad dag dang / /bral ba nyid du shes par bya/ /le lo dang ni mi go dang / /skabs mi 'byed dang ma nges dang / /the tshom dag ni mi gcod dang / /de dang bral bar bstan mi byed/ /skyo ba /rdo ni ser sna nyid/ /'di dag gtam gyi

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()nyes par 'dod/ /de dag med phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /bshad pa bla na med par 'gyur/ /zhes gtam gyi nyes pa brgyad dang bral bas 'khor gsum dag pa'i bshad pa'am/ rnam bshad rigs par brjod pa'i skyon bcu gcig gi gnyen por chos kyi gtam rnam pa nyi shu dang ldan par gsungs te/ spyod lam mi sdug par 'dug pas sdod ma yin pa la brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por nyan 'dod pa nyid dang bshad pa'i 'os su gyur pa nyid du shes nas smra ba'i dus su smra ba'o/ /bdag gi bshad nyan 'di lta bu la de ma tshang bas snying po med cing lam du 'gro bar ma mthong ngo / /brjod pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por brnyasapa med pas bsgrims pas smra ba'o/ /brjod pa bar chad pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por gsum ste go rim du smra ba ste dus sngar bya ba sbyin pa la sogs pa dang yang dag phul gyi gtam las brtsams nas smra ba ste bstan pa'o/ /mdo sde rnam par bshad pa las brtsams nas brgal ba'i tshig bkod smra ba mtshams sbyar bar smra ba'o/ /rjes su mthun par smra ba ni 'dri ba'i lan lung bstan pa las brtsams te mgo gcig tu lung bstan pa la sogs pa rnams la de bzhin du lung ston pa'o/ /brjod pa go bar mi byed pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por gsum ste/ dad pa can rnamasal dga' bar bya ba dang / sngar gnas pa dang zhe 'gras pa rnams la 'dod par bya ba dang / bar na gnas pa the tshom can rnams la mgu bar bya ba'o/ /brjod pa mchod par mi 'gyur ba'i skyon gyi gnyen por gnyis te/ sdig pa'i las can spro ba bskyed pa'i 'os ma yin pas spro ba mi bskyed pa dang / smad na snying na ru 'ong bas mi smad pa'o/ /don 'thad pa med par brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por 52

bu ston chos 'byung /rigs pa ste tshad ma dang mi 'gal ba'o/ /don zab mo spyod yul ma yin pa dbang po tha ma la zab mo brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por 'brel ba ste snga phyi 'brel ba'o/ /rnam par g.yengs nas brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por ma 'dres pa ste gtam gzhan du 'phro ba spangs pa'o/ /don med pa brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por chos dang ldan pa ste dge ba dang mthun pa'o/ /mi 'tshams par brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por 'khor ji lta ba bzhin te gdul bya dang 'tshams pa'o/ /nyon slongs pa can gyi bsam pas brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por lhag ma lnga'o/ /nyon slongs pa can gyi bsam pa ni gsum ste/ bdag bzang por yid ches par bya ba'i bsam pa dang / dad nas bkur sti byed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang /phrag dog gi bsam pa'o/ /dang po'i gnyen por gsum ste/ byams pa'i semasaphan pa'i sems snying brtse ba'i sems gsum ni nyan pa po bde ba dang nyon mongs pa med pa dang sdug bsngal med par smon pa gsum mam/ dge ba dang mi dge ba la phyogs pa dang tha mal pa dag la byams sogs rim pa bzhin nam/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang / de'i lam rtogs par bya ba dang / bshad pa'i don khong du chud pa'i bsam pas so/ /gnyis pa'i gnyen por rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang tshigs su bcad pa la mi brten pa ste de dag 'dod pa spangs pa'o/ /gsum pa'i gnyen por bdag la bstod par mi bya zhing gzhan la smad par mi bya ba ste phrag dog dang bdag la lhag par yid ches par 'dod pa spangs pa'o/ /nyi shu po 'di lnga lnga rim pa bzhin/ ji lta bur dang / gang gi don du dang / gang 'dra ba'i dang /gang 'dra bas gtam bya ba dang / yang 5/tam gyi sbyor ba dang / gtam gyi las

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung tso bsdus/()dang / gtam gyi yon to dang / smra ba po'i yon to bstan cing skyon dang bral ba ni / 'chad byed la mkhas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni sgo gsum dge bas kun gyis bkur bar 'os pas rang gi kun spyod la mkhas pa dang / gdul bya'i kun spyod la mkhas pa ni dbang po dang khams dang bag la nyal shes pas de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan pas don du 'gyur gyi/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu par/ nyis pa dbang po zhan cing le lo can/ /theg pa gnyis la nan tan mi byed par/ /theg pa chen po'i 'khor lo ldan mi 'gyur/ /de ni rgya chen theg chen snod ma yin/ /zhesapa'am/ de bzhin snod min nyan thos theg pa dag /theg chen bshad pa thos nasarmongs 'gyur zhing / /chad par blta la ngan song lhung 'gyur bas/ /des na dbang po brtags te chos bstan to/ /zhes gsungs shing / yang / rgya chen chos kyi sdod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ /zhes pa dang / dman la zab dang rgya che dung / /zhes gsungs pas/ sdod kyi kun spyod dam mtshan nyid la mkhas dgosas / / gnyis pa la/ rab sems can thams cad byang chub chen po la gzhag 'dod kyi snying rje/ de med na gang 'chad pa'i don de legs par shes shing phan 'dod kyis zang zing la stos med du 'chad pa'i snying rje nges par dgos te/des rang gi bshad pa lam du 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams ni phyog dang longs spyod tshegs chen rnyed cing snying po med pa dag /rab dga'i yid kyis sems can sdug bsngal rnams la sbyin rnams rgya chen rtag gtong na/ /chos kyang skye rgu rnams la rnam pa kun tu phan5 /da tshegs chen rnyed min zhing / man tu

bu ston chosang /btang yang zad med 'phel 'gyur ba lta lan cig ma yin smos ci dgos/ / zhes so/ /de lta min na chos 'tshong ba'i nyes par 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo las/ chos ston kyang chos nyan pa rnams la snying rje chen po mi bskyed pa ni/ bdud kyi las so/ /zhes pa dang / mang du thos kyang gzhan gyisashes kyis dogs te chos la slob dpon gyis dpe mkhyud byed pa yang bdud kyi la so/ /zhes pa dang / dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ 'dod phyir su dag dam chos ston byed pa/ /de dag 'dod pa btang ba phyir len te/ /myos pa de dag thang med rin ོ chos/ /thob par gyur kyang sprang por rgyu bar byed/ /ces so/ /gsum pa la/ 'chad dus kyi ngal dub dang dka' las la skyo ba med pa'i bzod pa / slob mas dri bar bzod pa/ gzhan gyis brtsad par bzod cing lan 'debs nus pa gsum gyis gdul bya rjes su 'dzin nus par 'gyur ro/ /'khor (g.yo nag pa)gyis log sgrub bzod pa dgos gsung ste pha rol la phan nges par shes pa'i mngon shes dang ldan na de ltar bya ste/ de lta min par/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad la sogs pa dang / do ker can la sogs pa lnga la sogs pa mang po dang 'gal bas ha cang blo sna rings pa'i gtam yin gyi/chags sdang gis log par sgrub pa'i bshad nyan gyis mngon mtho'am nges legasaci zhig la phan/ de ltar chos de dag tshang bas bshad na 'khor gyi skye bo la 'jeb shing mdzes la lam du 'gyur te/ mdo sde rgyan nas de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan par rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yis//byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ༷ shun pa ste/ /bshad pas bo'i nang na

ba ga 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()nyi ma bzhin du lham zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ mngon pa kun las ba yis su/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi dang drug gsungs te/ ji skad du/ rnam par bshad pa'i gtan la dbab pa gang zhe na/ gang gis mdo sde rnams rnam par bshad par byed pa ste/de'ang gang zhe na/ yongs su shes par bya ba'i dngos po dang / bongs su shes par bya ba'i don dang / yongs su shes par bya ba'i rgyu dang / yongs su shes pa dang /yongs su shes pa'i 'bras bu dang / des rab tu shes pa'o/ /yang rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi ste/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba'i sgo dang / dngos po bsdu ba'i sgo dang / yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag gi sgo dang / gong nas gong du mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo dang/ spong ba'i sgo dang/ yi ge yongs su bsgyur ba'i sgo dang / chud za ba dang mi za ba'i sgo dang / gang zag rnam par bzhag pa'i sgo dang /rab tu dbye ba rnam par bzhag pa'i sgo dang / tshul gyi sgo dang / yongs su shes pa la sogs pa'i sgo dang / stobs dang stobs ma yin pa'i sgo dang / bzlas te brjod pa'i sgo dang / mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhung kha cig las dgos don bsdus don tshig don gsum gyis 'chad cing / la lar spyi dang yan lag gi don gnyis kyis 'chad do/ /mchims pa ni/ don bstan pa dang gzhung bshad pa dang de dag nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung gi ngag don skam phogs su bstan te/ gang las 'ongs pa'i 'brel/ ci'i phyir bkod pa'i dgos pa/ ci zhig bstan pa'i brjod bya gsum gyis nges par byed pa ste/ desaslob ma chos kyi don bzang bar 'gyu/ // /gnyis pa ni/ dkyus kyi them sbyor

bu ston chos sku nga /gyis khyad par gyi gzhi ngos bzung ste/ drogs spang gi tshul gyis khyad par du byed pa'i chos bshad nas des don dngos shugs la ji ltar bstan dpyod pa ste/ desaslob ma tshig la mkhas par byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag gis gzhung don rtogs kyang gzhan gyi rgol ba mi bzlog pa srid pas bshad zin pa de nyid la 'gal zlos ma 'brel lo zhes bsam pa ma rtogs pa'i brgal ba bkod nas de'i bsam pa gsal byed kyi lan gdab pa dang lung rigs gzhan gyi lan don dgongs pa can du drogs pa spangs pa ste/ de slob ma gzhung don la nges pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rnam bshad rigs par/ mdo don smra ba dag gis ni/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /brgal ba dang lan gnyisagacig tu bya ba ni brgal ba'i lan gdab pa'i don gyi phyir ro/ /zhes pas/ thog mar mdo la sogs pa'i dgos pa thos nas nyan pa dang 'dzin pa la 'bad par 'gyur bas dgos pa bshad/ de bsdus don las rtogs pas bsdus pa'i don mdo'am bstan bcos kyi lus sgra dang don gnyis sam/ brjod bya'i don dril nas ston pa'o/ /de tshig don las rtogs pas/ tshig gi don bshad gzhir bzhag nas khyad par gyi chos la togs pa bsu ba'i sgo nas dri tshig dang lan gyisamatha' dpyad nas 'chad pa'am/ don gcig la ming mang po dang ming gcig don mang po la 'jug pa dang / sgra'i zur gcig la drangs te 'chad pa dang / yi ge bsgyur nas 'chad pa dang / dgag pa'i sgra khong nas phyung ste tshig bsgyur nas 'chad pa la sogs pa'o/ /yang rnam bsad rigs par/ rnam pa bzhi dag gis

'tshe' 'od snang ga 'i rdzong gce bsdus/()tshig gi don rig par bya ste rnam grangs kyis dang mtshan nyid kyis dang nges pa'i tshig gis dang rab tu dbye bas so/ /de la rnam grangs ni ming gzhan no/ /mtshan nyid ni don gang la ming de yod pa'o/ /nges pa'i tshig ni ming gi rgyu mtshan brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ kha cig nges tshig sgra'i bshad pa min par 'dod pa mi ༷sad de/ a pra shi kha la sogs pa sgra'i bshad par gnas brgyad du bshad pasas / / mtshams sbyar ni/ don snga phyi 'brel ba dang / go rim snga phyi 'brelaba'i mtshams sbyar nas tshig don gyi go rim mi 'gal bar shes so/ /rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba dang snga phyi mi 'gal ba ni brgal lan las shes pas sgra la brgal ba dang don la rgol ba'i brgal ba bkod nas de'i don lan gyis nges par byas te 'chad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gdul bya'i dbang gis dang / dgosapa'i dbang gis dang / 'jug pa'i dbang gis bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum la bsdus 'bring rgyas par 'chad pa ste/ mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsungs pa bzhin dang / rigs kyi bye brag gis theg pa che chung gi chos dang / don gnyer gyi bye brag gis bshad bya ci rigasapar ston pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i ne kyi phyir/ /de dag khyod la gsol 'debs na/ /rab rgyas bdag gis ma bslab ces/ /thog mar tshig de brjod par bya/ khyod ni shes shing mkhas yin na/ /bdag nyid chen po'i mdun du ni/ /bdag gis ji ltar bshad nus zhes/ khyod kyis de skad brjod par bya/ /'phal du brjod par mi bya yi/ /sdod la brtag pa byas nas bya//38

bu ston chos5nga /gal te snod du shes gyur na//gsol ma btab kyang bshad par bya//'khor mang po 'khod nang du//gal te ngang tshul ga mthong na/khyod kyi yo byad bsnyungasami bshad//sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod par bya//gal te 'dod pa chung zhig ste//tshul khrims dag par gnas yin na/khyod kyis byams pa'i sems bskyed la//yo byad bsnyung pa'i gtam gyis shig/gal te sdig 'dod chung gyur cing //tshul khrims ldan pa mang gyur la//gnyen po rnyed pa de yi tshe//tshul khrimasabasngags pa brjod par bya//zhes bshad pa bzhin no//gnyis pa ni/dgos pa don du gnyer ba'i bye brag gis mtshan nyid gtan la dbab pa dang /sgrub pa nyams len ci rigs par 'chad pa'o//gsum pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/sbyor ba la bkod pa bsham pa dang /dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab pa dang /bdud tshar gcod cing 'khor la byams pas khyab par bya ba gsum mo//dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/mkhas pa dus su sems par byed pa na/khang bur zhugs te de bzhin sgo bcad nas//chos 'di thams cad la ni tshul bzhin lta//langs nas zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis shod//mkhas pa bde la rtag tu gnas par 'gyur//bde la 'dug nas de bzhin chos kyang ston//gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su//yangs pa'i snyan ni rab tu bshams bting ste//bzang po'i tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur ba//chos gos gtsang ma des ni rab bgos nas//rngul gzan nag po de bzhin bshams byas la/sham thabs che tshad legs par rab bgos nas//bcos bu'i ra rnams sna tshogs legs bting ba//rkang rten bcas pa'i khri la9

'tshe che ga'od ngal /sa skya'i rdzo yangs bsdus/()rab 'dug cing/ /rkang pa legs par bkrus te steng 'jog nas/ /gdong dang bzhin gyi mdangs ni rab snam zhing / /chos kyi stan de la ni rab 'dug nas/ /sems can lhags pa rtse gcig gyur rnams la/ /gtam yang rnam pa sna tshogs nye bar ston/ /dge slong dag dang dge slong ma dag dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang dge bsnyen ma dag dang / /rgyal bo dag dang rgyal bu rnams la yang / mkhas de rtag tu phrag dog med par ni/ /sna tshogs don ldan snyan pa'i gtam yang ston/ /le lo dag kyang rnam par rab spangs nas/ /skyo ba snyam pa'i 'du shes bskyed mi bya rdo / mkhas pas mi dga' thams cad rnam par spang / /byams pa'i stobs ni 'khor la sgom par bya/ /nyin mtshan du yang chos mchog rab tu sgom/ /mkhas pa des ni bye ba phrag khrig dpes/ /'khor rnams mgu zhing de bzhin dga' bar byed/ /de la nam yang 'dod pa cung zad med/ /zas dang skom dang bza' dang bca' ba dang / /gos dang mal cha chos gos rnams dang ni/ /na ba'i gsos sman dag kyang mi bsam ste/ /'khor rnams la ni ci yang mi bslang ngo / /gzhan du mkhas pa rtag tu bdag nyid dang / /sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /phan phyir 'jig rten chos gang bstan pa ste/ /bdag gi bde ba'i yo byad kun snyam sems/ /zhes pa dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ta bya thā/sha me sha ma ba ti sha mi ta sha tru/ e ku re/ me ku re/ mā ra dzi te kā ra de yu ke lha re te dzo pa ti/ o lo ya ni/ bi sha tha ni me le/ ma la pā na yī/ khu khu re kha ge gra se / gra sa zhe/ o mu khri/ ga re mu khri/ a sku'i sha mi tā ni/ sa gra hā brnya na ni/gri hi tā sarba ra pra thā ti na/ bi mu ghā mā twe 0bra sha sbru bi twa bu mu tra/ ā nu ta gti

bu ston cho 'byung /tā/ sa spru ma re su tsa ri ta pa ri shudhe/ bi ga thos sa spru mā ra dmi ṇi/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di dag ni/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i tshig nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i tshig ste / de dag chos smra ba des legs par kha rtan du byas la chos kyi khri la 'dug ste/byang chub kyi rnam par mngon par bsgrubs pa'i byams pas 'khor thams cad la khyab par byas la bdag la sman pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes dang / chos nyan pa la nad pa'i 'du shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes dang / chos kyi tshul la yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed la/ sngags kyi tshig 'di dag sngon du byas te/ chos kyi gtam bshad na / de'i khor yug dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams mig bsgyur ba'i las kyis phyir 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang bar chad byed par mi nus so zhes pa dang / chos smra bas gtsang sbra dang kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba dang legs par bkrus pa dang / legs par gosabago bar bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ phar phyin drug ldan te / rang gi rtogs pa'i tshig don ster ba dang / sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod sdom pa dang / tsha grang la sogs pa gnod pa sran pa dang / bshad pa la spro ba dang / de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa dang / tshig don gyi 'gal 'brel dpyod cing 'chad pa ste drug gam/ yang na slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ chos kyi sbyin pa la sogs pa sbyin pa na nyan thos la sogs pa'i yid la byed pa spong ba dang / skye bo thams cad mi snyan par smra ba la sogs bzod pa dang / 'dun pa skyed pa dang /theg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang / bla na med pa yang 61

'tshe ga 'od pal /sa 'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba rnams mi dmigs pa'i go cha nyid kyis byed pa dang zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa rjes la nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang / stong pa'i rgyas gdab pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ gang gis nyan pa'i gang zag gang la brten nas nyan pa'i thabs/ ji ltar nyan pa'i tshul gsum mo/ /dang po la/ nyan pa po rab 'bring tha gsum las/ dang po la rnam bcad nyan pa po'i skyon spang ba dang / bsgrub bya nyan pa po'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po la skyon bcu gsum dang / drug dang /gsum spong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam bshad rigs par/ skyon bcu gsum gyi gnyen por rnam pa bcu drug gis chos mnyan par gsungs shing / bcu gsum ni nang du yang dag par 'jog pa'i tshe smra ba po la bdag nyid kyis bskyod pa dang /spyod lam mi sdug pa'i skyon dang / rigs mtho ba la sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'i skyon dang / don du mi gnyer ba'i skyon dang / gzhan gyi phyogs byed pa snying na ba'i skyon dang / mchod par mi 'gyur bas smra ba po rab tu mi 'dzin pa'i skyon dang / sun ci phyin du rgol ba'i bsam pa'i skyon dang / chos dang chos smra ba la yon tan yid la mi byed pa'i phyir rim gro mi byed pa'i skyon dang / chos la tshig dang yig 'bru ma 'brel ba'am chos smra ba la tshul khrims dang rigs dang byad gzugs dang tshig 'byin pa ma tshang ba la sogs pa'i skyon yid la byed pa'i phyir brnyas pa'i skyon dang / smod pa'i skyon dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur sti 'dod pa'i skyon dang / sems rnam par g.yengs ba dang gnyid rmugs kyis bsdus pas62

bu ston chos 'byung /mi nyan pa'i skyon dang / dgongs pa dang chos nyid la phyin ci log tu rtog pasalegs par yid la mi byed pa'i skyon dang / 'dun pa dang 'jug pa zhan pa nyid kyis rab tu yid la mi byed pa'i skyon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam bshad rigs par/nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang bsdus dang / /skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na las kyi skyon dang / mos pa med pa'i skyon dang / mchod par mi 'gyur ba'i skyon dang / bsam pa'i ston dang / mi mthun pa'i skyon dang / 'dzin pa'i skyon no/ /las kyi skyon la lubs kyi las spyod lam mi sdug pa dang / lus ngag gnyis rka'i las de gnyis kyis bskul bar mi byed pa dang / yid kyi las nyan par mi 'dod pa'o/ /bsam pa'i skyon ni gzhan la klan ka btsal ba dang / 'di lta bu zhig tu rgol ba las thar par bya ba'i bsam pa'o/ /mi mthun pa'i skyon lnga ste/ chos la nges 'byin gyi lam min par go nas mi gus pa dang / tshig dang yi ge ma 'brel bas bsnyad pa dang / gang zag dang tshul khrims dang tshig 'byin pa'i skyon gyisagus pa med pa dang / rigs kyi skyon gyi brnyas pa'o/ khong du chud pa dang sgrub pa'i nus pa mi 'byung snyam pa bdag la brnyas pa'o/ /'dzin pa'i skyon lnga ste/log par 'dzin pa dang / don mi 'dzin pa dang / tshig 'bru mi 'dzin pa dang /brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa dang / ma lus par mi 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa la dper na char bab kyang chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i sdod kyi skyon gsum 'byung ste/ kha bub bam bcad pas mi 'bab pa dang / mi gtsang bsab ba kyang skyon can du 'gyur ba dang / bu ga dang bcas pas//ba kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i cho things bsdus/()chos kyi char bab kyang chos kyi chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i skyon gsum ste/ rnam g.yeng dang gnyid rmugs kyis mi nyan pas mi 'bab pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la mi byed pas bab kyang skyon can du 'gyur ba dang / dran pa brjed nges pa'i phyir mi gnas pa'o/ /de'i gnyen por/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang / zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang nad pa sman pa'i lung ma shes pa dang log par shes pa dang legs par shes kyang sman chud gsan pa dang 'dra ba dang / nad pa zas mi za ba dang / mi 'phrod pa za ba dang /'phrod pa zos pa skyug pa gsum rim pa bzhin no/ /des na 'chad pa po sdod la mkhas pas nyan po rnam par g.yengs na/ mi rnams tshe ni lo brgya la/ /mtshan mo nyal bas phyed du byas/ /de ni nyin par yang nyal bas/ /de yi phyed kyang dum bur byas/ /zhes pa la sogs pa skyo ba'i gtam bya/ gnyid tshugs can la semasagasal bar bya ba'i phyir ya mtshan gyi gtam dang / bong bu dang rte'u 'am/ seng ge dang wa'am/ rgan zhugs dang bud med dam/ rgan mo dang rkan mo dang / lusaskyes ngus pa'i gtam rgyud bshad la dga' ba'i gtam bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar brjod/ zhes pas rtogs par nus pa'i blo gros dang / don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang / nga rgyal med pa'i gus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thos pa nyon mongs kyi gnyen por 'gro zhing thar pa'i rgyur 'gro ba la don rtogs dgos te dbyig gnyen gyis/rgyu gsum dag gis pags pa las su rung bar 'gyur te snum bku ba dang mnye ba dang bzo ba rnams kyis so/ /de bzhin du sems kyang thos pa dang bsam pa dang 64

bu ston chos 'byung/ sgom pa rnams kyis so/ /de lta bas na sems las su rung ba nyid du bya ba'i phyir thos pa la sogs pa dag la brtson 'grus bya'o/ /gsum po de dag gi stobs kyis lam du 'gro ba rnams 'brog dgon pa'i lam las bde bar brgal bar 'gyur te lam rgyags kyi stobs dang bzhon pa'i stobs dang ston pa po'i stobasakyi so/ /de bzhin du 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa'i lam las bde ba'i lam du 'gro ba rnams sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis so/ /'di gsum char yang thos pa la rag las so zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdo las bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos yongs su 'tshol ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na / g.yo dang sgyu med par bsam pa thag pas chos yongs su 'tshol ba dang zhesasogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'grel chen du lhag pa'i bsam pas mnyan par bya zhes bya ba ni/ thod la sogs pa bor la stan dma' ba la 'dug ste rnam par g.yeng ba'i nyes pa bsal te thar pa 'dod pa'i bsam pas dam pa'i chos mnyan par bya'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i mtshan nyid ma tshang yang don go bar nus pa mnyan na phan yon chen po yod de/ rnam bshad rigs par/ rgyu bsagasapa rnams ni cung zad mnyan pas bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te/dper na 'phags pa shā ri'i bus bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba la rjes su bstan pa bram ze zhig gis thos nas gab ste 'dug nas rab tu byung ba tshul khrims nyams pa la sdug bsngal rnam pa bcu gnyis 'byung ngo zhes thos nas 'chal ba'i tshul khrims bya ba la mngon du phyogs pa las ldog pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungasaso / / gzhan yang dge 'dun srung gis cho me bstan pa la drang srong rnams kyis65

ba zug 'od thal /sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()phag nyan byas pas 'bras bu thob pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ don mi go yang chos la dad nas mnyan na bsod nams che ste/ ji skad du/ brda mi 'phrod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi gsung gus pas mnyan par bya ste/ 'di ltar dad pa tsam gyis kyang nyan na bsod nams chen po nyid dang ldan pa dang shes rab kyi khams brtas par 'gyur na don rtogs pas lta smos kyang ci dgos te ba lang rdzi dga' bos sbal ba mkhar bas mnan pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dper bya'o zhes pa dang / chos dga' chu srin du gyur pa na sangs rgyas kyi sgra tsam zhig thos pa las mngon phyag 'tshal ba tsam la goms pa'i phyir kha btsums te 'dug pa yin no/ /de lta bsan cung zad cig thos pas kyang rgyu bsags pa rnams kyi dge ba rab tu rgyas pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung nyan pa la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde sdod las/ gang gis sems can dag 'gyur ba'i/ khyu gnyis dang ni rkyen gnyis te/ /gzhan la rjes su mthun sgra dang / /nang du tshul bzhin lta ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas phyi'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsags pa dang / nang gi mthun rkyen rna ba blags te mnyan cing thos pa'i don bsam pa dang mdo bstan bcos blta ba dang mkhas pa la dri bas bskyang bar bya zhing des thos byung mthar phyin par 'gyur zhing de nas bsam bsgom la 'bad par bya'o/ /rnam bshad rigs par/rdo thal gyi rdo mes bsregs chus 'jig par byed pa dang 'dra bar nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal gyi rdo shes rab kyi mes yongs su bsregs pas ting nge 'dzin gyi chus yongs su sbangs na 'jig goms rab de'ang dam pa'i chos mnyan pa med par 66

bu ston chos 'byung / ni ma yin pas de lta bsan gus par chos nyan par bya'o/ /tshig gi khur thogasakyang don mngon par mi shes na de'i don mi 'thob ste khye'u'i mgul du gter gyi kha chems kyi yi ge btags pa dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bsan mang du thos pas kyang don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir mdo sde'i don mnyan pa la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /mel tshe ba so sor mi rtog pa ni ma nyal zhes zer bzhin du chom po rnams kyis bcom mo/ /de bzhin du sgra tsam la brtson pa'i mang du thos pa so sor mi rtog pa yang nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams kyis 'joms so/ /so sor rtogs pa de yang don shes pa nyid med na med pas de lta bas na don gzung bar ni 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rol mo mkhan rkun pos 'jigs nas mi nyal bar bya ba'i phyir glu len bzhin du bcom mo/ /zhes bya ba yang dper brjod par bya'o/ /ji ltar long ba mar me 'dzin pa ni/ gzhan dag la phan par 'gyur ba dang 'dra bar don mngon par mi shes pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa yang de lta bu yin pas de lta bsan don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir don mnyan pa la 'bad par bya'o zhes so/ /gsum pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po la gsum las/dang po chos sgrub pa'i bsam pa ste/ ji skad du/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa gtso bor byed/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa gus pa'i spyod lam ste/ sgo gsum 'dud pa'o/ /skyes rabs su/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig btud/ /rab tu dang la dri med yid/ /nad pas sman pa'i tshig mnyan bzhin/67/rim gro bskyed de chos nyen cig /ces

ba ra 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()so / / gsum pa rkyen tsho gis par dga' ba sgom pa ste/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par/ 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam ste/ /mi yi lus ni tshegasakyis rnyed pa yin/ /kye ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'/ /zhes pa dang / rgya cher rol par/ mi dang sangs rgyasa'agyung rnyed dka'/ /dad pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /mi khom brgyad spangasarnyed par dka'/ /chos nyan pa ni gtso bo yin/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang dal ba dang / /dad dang chos mnyan dam pa dang / /de dag thams cad da rnyed kyis/ /bag med ma lus rnam par spongs/ /gal te bskal pa phrag khrig tu/ /chos thosasbyi 'gyur /da pa de/ khyed kyis de ring rnyed zin gyi/ /bag med ma lus rnam par spangs/rna/rte pa// drig/ sa par/ gsung dang rna ba nyid dang ni/ /'dod dang shesarab gegs med pa/ /lnga ni gang phyir rnyed dka' bas/ /de phyir thub pa'i gsung mnyan bya/ /zhes pa dang / lus can 'di nas shi na yang / /dam chos dkon mchog 'phrad 'gyur ram/ /mi 'gyur rna bar thos pa dang / /su zhig dam chos 'chad 'gyur ba/ /de ni su kyang mi shes pas/ /de phyir khyed kyis 'bad pa yis/ /ston pa'i gsung ni mnyan par bya/ /zhes pa dang / srid pa yod na gdon mi za bar tshe thob la/ /de yang phal cher don med par ni zad par 'gyur/ /legs par gsungs pa'ang sa steng 'ga' na lan 'ga' zhig /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin du snang ba yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phar phyin drug ldan te/sgo gsum chos kyi phyir gtong ba dang /6sdus spyod sdom zhing snod kyi skyon rnams

bu ston cho 'byung/ spong ba dang / gnod pa bzod pa dang / zha pa la spro ba dang / sgra dang don la sems rtse ga ṇi ga pa dang / rab rtogs pa lhag pa rnyed pa'am/ 'bring sgra'i rjes su 'brangs pas 'dzin skyong don la dpyod pa'o/ /mtha' ma la tshad med do/ //sum pa ༷sa la nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing dge ba bsngos la gtang rag phyag :zhi /pa/ ni/ de lta bu'i thos bsam lam du 'gro ba la/ tshul gnas thosadang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pas tshul khrims dag pa rten du dgos te/ ting nge 'dzin(zla ba na me dang gcig)rgyal po las/ ji snyed chos kyi rnam par byang chub kyang / /thos pas rgyags shing tshul khrims mi srung na/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba ngan 'gro der 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mang thos tshul gnas kyang bsam sgom dang 'brel dgos te btsun pa chos la gnas pa'i dge slong zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ bsgom pa la ma brten par thos pa dang / sems pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chosal gnas pa ma yin la/ thos pa dang sems pa la ma brten par bsgom pa la sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chos la gnas pa ma yin gyi/ gnyis ka la brten te gnyis ka la gnas na chos la gnas pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /mdo sde rgyan las kyang / de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi bsgom pa gang yin de yang don med min//de ltar bde bar gshegs kyis bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na bsgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang bsgom 'jug 'gyur na sdu/na pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'a:nga gtse4bsdus/()so / / des na thog mar sdug bsngal mang po'i gzhi'am rgyu 'chal ba'i tshul khrimasakyi gnyen por tshul khrims srung zhing / de nas nyen mongs pa rnam par sbyang ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de'i rim pa ni/ zhi ba lhas/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya//de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag la brtson bya zhing / /mi sdug la sogs bsgom par bya/ /zhes so/ /de la thog mar bzod pa dgos te/de med na skyo ba la ji mi snyam pa med pas thos pa la mi 'jug pas so/ /thos pa med na nyon mongs spong ba'i bsam gtan gyi thabs mi shes pas thos pa btsal lo / / thos pas chos shes su zin kyang lang long can du spyod na ting nge 'dzin mi skye bas/ chos dang mthun pa'i tshig gis smras gyur kyang / khro dang zhe sdang yid mi ches pa dag /rab tu smra ste 'di ni byis pa'i chos/ /don de rnam par shes na yid mi rton/ /zhes zla ba sgron me las 'byung ba bzhin bsnyen bkur 'dod sred byisapa dang 'grogs pa spangs te/ nags na ri dwags bya rnams dang / mang rnams mi snyan sgrog mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i nags dben pa bsten no/ /de nas rnam g.yeng spong ba la mi brtson na mnyam par 'jog par mi 'gyur bas/ mnyam gzhag la brtson dgos la de'i 'bras bu nyon slongs pa spyong ba yin pas mi sdug pa la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /mang du thos kyang sgrub pa dang bral ba ni/ nyes pa chen po ste/drag shul can gyis zhus par/ gal te thos pa dang ldan pa dal ba phun sum tshogs pa 'di rnyed nas rnyed pa la sogs pa la chags pa'i sems mi spyong na de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na bslu ba gcig bur 'gyur ro zhes pa dang /70

bu ston chos lcing / dkon brtsegs las kyang 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig rgya mtsho'i chu chen pos khyer ba chus skom bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de bzhin du 'od srungs 'di la dge sbyong dang bram ze kha cig chos mang po bslabs te kun chub par byas kyang 'dod chags la sred pa mi sel zhe sdang la sred pa mi sel gti mug la sred pa mi sel ba de dag chos kyi rgya mtshos khyer la nyon mongs pa'i skom pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur te ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes so / / des na bdag lta bu kha bshad la song nas lag len med pa la snying po med pas don sems shing lag len gal che ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/ thos pas rgyags na gus par mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i smra ba rnams la chags/ /brjod par 'gyur zhing shes bzhin med par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /nang gi sems las shin tu ring bar 'gyur /lus dang sems kyang rab sbyangs ma yin 'gyur/ khengs pa dang ni mdud pa mang por 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /byis pa dam pa'i chosabasam rab tu nyams/ /sems ni mi mnyen shin tu rtsub par 'gyur/ /zhi gnasalhag mthong dag dang rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rtag tu bla ma dag la gus pa med/ /sbags pa'i gtam dag la ni dga' ba bskyed/ /snying po med la gnas shing shes rab nyams/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni lha tshogs rnams kyis mi bkur zhing / /de tshe de la'ang 'dod pa mi bskyed la/ /so so yang dag rig las nyams 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /gang dag lus / /ngon sum mang yod pa/ /mkhas pa de

sa tsher 'od snang la /sa skya'i chong gce bsdus/()dag gis ni spyo bar 'gyur//de yi srog ni don med 'gyur ba ste//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/bdag ni sgrub nyams da ni ci bya zhes//'chi ba'i dusatshe byis pa mya ban byed//gting rnyed ma gyur shin tu sdug bsngal 'gyur//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/rtobaskyod bzhin du 'gul zhing g.yo ba ste//de ni de ltar the tshom 'gyur du nges//de ni nam yang blo brtan mi 'gyur te//smra ladaga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/gar la dga' ba'i khrod na 'dug pa zhig/dpa' bo gas gyi yon to brjod pa bzhi//bdag nyid nan to khos par 'gyur ba ste//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/de ni g.yo ldan yang zhing re 'chad 'gyur//phyir phyir zhing ni rnam par 'gyed pa rtsom//'phags pa'i dam pa'i chos las rab tu ring //smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/mthu chung bsti stang gis ni dga' 'gyur te//mi shes ldan pa g.yo zhing 'gyur ba yi//spre'u ltar de yi sems ni g.yo bar 'gyur//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/rang gi blo yi shes pa dma' ba'i phyir//rmongs pa de ni gzhan gyi dring la 'jog/de ni sto mongs phyogs kyi dbang du 'gro/smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/mig kyang 'khrul zhing de bzhin rna ba'ang 'khrul//sna yang 'khrul zhing de bzhin lte yang 'khrul//lus kyang 'khrul zhing yid kyang 'khrul bar 'gyur//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/de yi sems ni rna ba'i rnam shes la//rab tu chags shing sgras rgyags shes rab nyams//log par sems shing lam ngan 'gro bar 'gyur//smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go/zhes pa la sogs pa gsungasanas/yun ring dus nas smra la dga' ༷san//de ni bdag nyid dga' ba mi

bu ston chog 'byung / thob bo/ /tshig gang dga' ba mtha' yas thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsams kyang mchog yin no/ /bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug na pa zos pas mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro lta bu ni 'di la don sems yin/ /de lta bsan smra la dga' spangs te/ /rtag tu bag yod byos la don soms shig /ces gsungs so/ /tshul 'di mang thos sgrub pa dang bral ba/ /tshogs ma bsags kyi bu ston kha ches bris/ /dge bas myur du shi 'phos dga' ldan du/ /mi pham chos kyi dga' ston myong bar shog /chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul nges par bstan pa'i le'u ste/ dang po rdzogs so// /// spyi don bzhi pa chos ji ltar byung tshul la gnyis te/ spyir 'jig rten du chos ji ltar byung tshul/ khyad par bod du ji ltar byung tshul lo/ /dang po la/spyir byang sems kyi tshogs sam smon lam rdzogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa dang / gdul bya dge ba'i rtsa ba smin pa na sangs rgyas 'byung ba yin zhing des dam pa'i chos ston pa yin pa la/ 'di la gsum ste/ spyir bskal pa gang la sangs rgyas byon tshul/ khyad par bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas byon tshul/khyad par du mi mjed 'jig rten du thub pa'i dbang po byon tshul lo/ /dang po la/spyir bskal pa la sgron ma'i bskal pa dang mun pa'i bskal pa gnyis las sgron bskal la sangs rgyas 'byung gi mun bskal la sangs rgyas mi 'byung ngo / /sgron bskal bskal pa bzang po la sangs tshis stong ngam stong dang lnga/ de nas mun

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/()bskal bskal pa chen po drug cu/ de nas sgron bskal bskal pa snyan pa chen po la sangs rgyas khri/ de nas mun bskal brgyad khri 'das pa dang bskal pa skar ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal la sangs rgyas brgyad khri/ de nas mun bskal sum brgya/ de nas sgron bskal yon tan bkod pa la sangs rgyas brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung bar bskal bzang nas bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ snying rje pad ma dkar po'i rjes su 'brangs te sangs rgyas stong dang lnga 'byon tshul dang /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te sangs rgyas stong 'byon tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la gling bzhi pa di nyid du 'khor ༄ ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud ces bya ba byung ngo / /de la sras rgyal bu mig mi 'dzum pa la sogs pa stong dang / rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong dang bcas pa mnga'o/ /de'i mdun na 'don gyi gtso bo bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul zhes bya ba sras brgyad cu dang slob ma bram ze stong dang bcas pa yod de/ de'i sras bram ze rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya ba mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan rin chen snying po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de nas 'bor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis zla ba gsum du sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur byas so/ /de nas de'i sras rgyal bu stong gis zla ba gsum gsum bsnyen bkur byas te lo nyis brgya lnga bcu dang zla ba gsum 'das pa dang / yab bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis lo bdun du bsnyen bkur byas chos mnyan nas rmi lam brtags pas rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis srog chags /༷ po za ba dang stag la sogs pa gcan

bu ston rma tshing /gzan gdug pa can gyis rgyal po de yang gsod par 'gyur ba dang / blon po kha cig shing rta bde ba la zhen nas lam gol bar 'dong ba la sogs pa rmis te sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ rgyal po rgyal srid la chags shing mi dge ba spyad pasangan song du 'khor bar lung bstan/ blon po de dag tī rang du lung bstan/gzhan mang po byang chub chen por 'gyur ro zhes rmi ltas lung bstan no/ /de nasabram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis rgyal po chen po la/ rgyal po chen po/ mir gyur pa yang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'ang rnyed par dka'/dam pa'i chos nyan pa'ang rnyed par dka' yi bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugasaskyed cig ces bskul bas/ rgyal po na re/ kho bo bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas bar mi 'dod do zhes rgyu mtshan (lor lo dbyen)dang bcas pa smra zhing sems bskyed du ma 'dod pa la/ bram zes lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du bskul bas/ sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzang po 'byung na bskyed do zhes khas blangs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas rin chen snying pos me long bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas gang bzang ba la 'dam du bcug pas rgyal po'ang dad nas rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzung ba'i phyir khab tu zhugs nas skye bo'i 'grul bcad de sems par byed do/ /de'i rgyal bu stong yang rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzung ba'i phyir khang par zhugs te sems par byed do/ /de'i bar la bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis srog chags mang po dge ba rgya chen po la bkod do/ /de ltar lo bdu/ 3'das pa dang / rgyal po 'khor bcas

ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/()lhas bskul nas langs te sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing bzung zhing sems bskyed pas/ rgyal po chen po bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du sangs rgyas tshe dpag med du lung bstan no/ /bu thu bo mig mi 'dzum ni tshe dpag med mya ngan las 'das nas sgod la chos nub pa'i tho rangs mngon par rdzogasapar sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po zhes pa'o/ /de mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su bu gnyis pa ni mthu chen thob ste rab tu brtan pa yon tan nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zhes par lung bstan no/ /bu gsum pa ni 'jam dpal te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa rdulabral yang dag brtsegs su sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs su lung bstan no/ /bu bzhi pa ni kun tu bzang por ro/ /lnga pa ni pad+ma dam par ro/ /drug pa ni dbang sgyur dbang phyug rgyal por ro/ /bdun pa ni snang ba rdul bral spos mtho dbang phyug rgyal por ro/ /brgyad pa ni ye shes rdo rje rnam par 'gying ba'i dbang phyug tu'o/ /de nas bar skabs 'dir srog chags khri sangs rgyas su lung bstan nasade nas bu dgu pa mi 'khrugs par lung bstan no/ /bcu pa gser gyi me tog tu'o/ /bcu gcig pa rgyal po'i zla bar ro/ /de bzhin du rgyal bu stong tshang bar lung bstan no/ /de nas rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / srog chags dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag gnyis dang / de nas rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi sras brgyad cu dang / de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi slob ma bram ze stong phrag gcig dang / de nas bram ze bye ba phrag gsum lung bstan pas sa rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob kyi ba/ ḍi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bram ze rig byed

klog pa stong gi dang po lung bsta/spyi /( sne/ sa la rig byed klog pa stong gi gnyis pa skar ma skyong ni bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas dang po 'khor ba 'jig go/gsum pa ta'i ra ni gser thub tu lung bstan no/ /bzhi pa kun gyisabasrungs ni sangs rgyas 'od srungs su'o/ /lnga pa dri med 'od ni byams pa'o/ /de bzhin du dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i bar du lung bstan no/ /de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis rig byed klog pa stong gi mtha' ma la zhing zungs sems skyed cig ces bsgos pas cung zad bsam long yod do zhes zer nas/ de nas rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi bsnyen bkur ba lngas zhing bzung sems bskyed pas bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas su lung bstan no/ /de nas mtha' mas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la bskal pa bzang po de la thub pa nyi ma du mchis par 'gyur/ bka' bstsal pa/ thub pa nyi ma stong dang bzhi('a nga kya rang ba marapas)'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsol ba/ thub pa nyi ma stong dang bzhi po de dag gi sku tshe'i tshad dang gdul bya la sogs pa ji tsam pa de tsam du gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas legs so gnang ste sangs rgyas gsal mdzad ces par lung bstan no/ /de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi dgongs par/ rgyal po chen po la sogs pa srog chags mang pos sems bskyed cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa yang bzung zin gyi/ da ni bdag gis sems bskyed par bya'o snyam du dgongs te/zhing ma dag pa mi mjed kyi zhing sems can ma rungs pa mi dge ba bcu tshang bar spyod pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa shin tu gdul dka' ba rnams la thugasarjes lhag par gzigs nas smon la/ 7chen po lnga brgya btab ste bden pa'i

ba chen 'od snang gas skya'i chos sku pa gces bsdus/()stobs brjod pas/ sangs rgyas rin chen snying pos legs so gnang ste byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis brtson 'grus brtsams pa ni bzhi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma dag par smon pa dang zhes pa la sogs pa dang / khyod ni pad ma dkar po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /gzhan ni me tog lta bu'i byang chub semasadapa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsngags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod de bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya thub par lung bstan/ phyogasabacu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis skyes bskur/ lha dang mi'i skye rgu thams cad kyis mchod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas rin chen snying po mya ngan las 'das nas sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs te (lo bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug tu )mchod pa'ang byasaso / / bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul yang rab tu byung nas lo nyi khri'i bar du tshangs par spyad do/ /de ltar na bskal bzang 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa mdzesapar snang gal 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya bar sangs rgyasayon tan mtha' yas rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i tshe pho brang rnam par dag pa can du gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor srung zhes bya ba btsun mo bdun 'bum dang sras stong du tshang ba yod do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po des sangs rgyas dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la lo bye ba tshang bar bsnyen bkur te/ dge slong re re la'ang g.yog gsum gsum phul lo/ /de'i tshe rgyal bu de dag sangs rgyasang ba brgya lam rnyed par 'gyur/ /mir skye ba yang shin1 / dka' ba rnyed/ /grogs po gang dag

bu ston chos nga/ dad dang chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'/ /zhesapa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa smra zhing tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du rgyal po sras dang btsun mor bcas pa zhugs te nam mkha' la phyin te sangs rgyas kyi sbyan sngar 'khod pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po/ dad pa ni yongs su mi nyams shing khyad par du 'gro bar 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos bstan pa mnyan nas rang gi khyim du phyin pa dang / zla ba nya la bab pa dang btsun mo ma smad pa'i pang bar khye'u chos semasadang / dpe med ma'i pang bar chos kyi blo gros gnyis rdzus te byung ngo / /de gnyisadang bcas te sangs rgyas la chos mnyan no/ /de'i tshe rgyal po 'di snyam du rgyal bu 'di dag thams cad byang chub tu zhugs pa sha stag yin na gang thog mar sangs rgya brtag par bya'o snyam ste/ gzhen nu de thams cad kyi ming bris nas rin po che sna bdun gyi bum par bcug ste zhag bdun du mchod pa byas te/ btsun mo'i 'khor dang sras stong dang gzhon nu gnyis kyi mdun du nang mis bum pa'i nang nas ming rnams phyung ngo / /thog mar gzhen nu rnam par dag pa'i blo gros kyi ming byung bsas g.yos shing rol mo'i sgra byung ste/ de ni 'khor ba 'jig go /de nasagazhon nu rnam par rgyal ba'i sde gser thub bo/ /dbang po zhi ba 'od srungs so/ /don thams cad du grub pa ni shākya thub pa'o/ /ska rags can ni byams pa'o/ /mchog gi blo gros ni seng ge'o/ /glog gi lha ni tog ces bya ba'o/ /bzang po ni me tog dam pa'o/ /'od kyi dpal ni me tog go /rnam par snang ba'i pad mo ni skar rgyal lo/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od ni // legs so/ /rdul med ni lag bzang

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()ngo / / blo gros rgyal po ni 'od do/ /dge ba bkod pa'i rgyal po ni skar ma ldodaga' ba'o/ /phyogs 'byor pa ni mngon par 'phags pa gshegs pa'o/ /rnamapar dag pa bkod pa'i rgyal po ni yon tan mnga' ba'o/ /dpal sbas ni nor dpal lo/ /lus shin tu rnam par 'byed pa ni ye shes 'byung gnas so/ /dragashul can ni rin po che 'byung gnas so/ /rin chen grags ni kun tu snang ba'o/ /de bzhin du rgya cher byas te bu stong gi nang nas gcig bzhag pa cod pan brgyan pa'i bar du byung ste/ /de ni sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas grags pa'o/ /denas tha chung blo mtha' yas kyi ming byung ba dang snag gi gnyen mtshams dang spun rnams na re/ bdag cag gis sems can thams cad smin par byas sangs rgyasakyi mdzad pa byas pa'i 'og tu khyod kyis ci byar yod ces spyos pa dang / des smrasapa / sangs rgyas cho me rnams 'di dag nam mkha' mtshungs shing 'dra/ /bdag gi yid la sems can zad pa med snyam bgyid/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bdag gi smon lam 'dir dag 'gyur/ /bdag gi smon lam ci 'dra thams cad 'dir gson cig khyed kyi tshe tshad ji tsam pa dang bsdoms pa dag /tshogs kyi rgyal po ji snyed de dag kun bsdoms pa/ /thams cad bsdoms pa de snyed bdag gi tsher 'gyur te / /bdag gi dge slong tshogs kyang de kun ma lus snyed/ /ces pa 'a(sogs pa smras te/ de ni stong gi mtha' ma pa mos pa zhes bya bar 'gyur te sangs rgyas dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i tshe tshad dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ji snyed pa de snyed du 'gyur zhing bdag nyid de ltar mos pas mos pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rgyal bu stong gis khye'u chos sems dang chos kyi blo gros la khyed gnyis smon lam ji ltar 80

bu ston chos 'gung /'debs zhes dris pas/ chos sems ni nga khyed thams cad kyi lag na rdo rjer gyur te nang na spyod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba thams cad las phyi rol tu ma gyur la phyi nang gi chos thams cad nyan mos rtogs par smon lam btab ste de ni phyag na rdo rje ste sangs rgyas stong gi bka' sdud pa po yin zhing ma 'ongs pa na bskal pa rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba la 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas yongs su dag par sangs rgyas rdo rjes rnam par gnon par lung bstan no//chos kyi blo gros kyis khyed thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul bar gsol ba 'debs par smon lam btab ste de ni tshangs pa gtsug phud can no / / yul 'khor srung ni mar me mdzad do/ /des na sangs rgyas stong yin gyi stong rtsa gnyis zhes pa dang phyag rdor mos pa'o zhes zer ba ni blun po'i kha la ma rgyug cig 'o na bskal pa bzang po zhes brjod pa ci zhe na/ 'jig rten 'di chus 'jig pa'i tshe mtsho las gser gyi pad ma stong byung bar gyur te/ de la lha rnamasakyis brtags pas sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i ltas su shes te kye ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o/ /zhes brjod pas bskal pa bzang po zhes grags par gyur to zhes snying rje chen po pad dkar(ni ngas rtsa kyi lhar྾sa so)las bshad la/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo las bskal pa bzang po'i ming bskal pa pad ma stong mthong zhes btags pa yod do/ /de la sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba la gnas bskal gyi mar 'grib kyi brgyad khri pa nas brgya pa'i bar la 'byung ngo / /brgyad khri bas snga bar mi 'byung ste skyo ba shas chung bas chos don du mi gnyer bas so/ /brgya pa bas phyi bar mi 'byung ste tshe dang sems can dang nyon mongs pa dang lta ba dang dus 81

ba chen 'od snang la / 'i chog 'gung gce bsdus/()kyi snyigs ma lnga bdo bas so/ /yar 'phel la mi 'byung ste mi dge ba ngang gis spong zhing dngos po rnamasa'aphel bas skyo ba mi skye bas so/ /ji skad du/(mdzod las)mar ni bskal pa 'grib pa yi/ /brgya yi bar la de dag 'byung / /zhes pas so/ /de dag kyangabaskal pa bzang po 'di'i rnam gzhag la dgongs kyi thams cad du mi bsam ste snying rje pad ma dkar por/ 'jig rten gyi khams mthe bong can na tshe lo brgyapa'i dus su mi mthe bong tsam gyi nang du sangs rgyas skar ma la dga' ba zhes bya ba sku khru gang ba sor bdun gyi tshad tsam pa yod par bshad cing brgyad khri bas snga ba'i sangs rgyas mang po bshad pas so/ /'di'i tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus su 'khor ba 'jig sum khri'i dus su gser thub/ nyi khri'i dus su 'od srungs/ brgya pa'i dus su shākya thub pa/ brgyad khri pa'i dus su byams pa 'byung ngo / /mdo bskal bzang du sangs rgyas re re'i yul dang rigs dang 'od dang yab dang yum dang sras dang rim gro pa dang shes rab can dang rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog gnyis dang 'khor 'dus pa dang tshe tshad dang bstan pa gnas pa'i tshad dang sku gdung ste mchog zung so so bgrangs pa'i don bcu gsum bcu gsum gyis bstan cing / kha cig gis gdung smos te bcu bzhi'o/ /'khor 'dus pa'ang kha cig la re re dang kha cig la mang po dang sku gdung la rgyas par 'gyur ba dang ril po gcig tu 'dug pa gnyis so/ /ston pa 'di la dper brjod na/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po / nga skye ba'i yul ni ser skya zhes bya'o/ /rigs ni rgyal rigs so/ /gdung ni go'u ta ma'o/ /'od ni 'dom gang ngo / /yab ni zas gtsang zhes bya'o/ /yum ni sgyu 82

bu ston chos 'byung /'phrul ma zhes bya'o/ /sras ni sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /rim gro pa ni kun dga' bo zhes bya'o/ shes rab can rnams kyi mchog ni nye rgyas zhes bya'o/ /rdzu'aphrul can rnams kyi mchog ni pang nas skyes zhes bya'o/ /'dus pa dang po la ni dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /sku tshe'i tshad ni lo brgya'o/ /dam pa'i chos ni lo lnga brgya'i (lnga stong )bar du gnas so/ /lo lnga brgya'i (lnga stong )bar du ni dam pa'i chos ltar snang ngo / /sku gdung ni rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na sangs rgyas mos pa 'byon pa'i dus na mi'i tshe lo dpag tu med pa thub par bshad pa dang 'gal te mi'i tshe lo brgyad khri bas snga bar mi 'byung bas so zhe na/bden te de ni sangs rgyas kyi smon lam gyi stobs yin pas bsam gyis mi khyab bo / / yang sangs rgyas stong du nges na brgyad stong par dge slong khri bskal pa bzang po 'di la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas bar bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ bden te bskal pa bzang po la sangs rgyas stong du grags pas de gtso bor smos kyi gzhan ma bkag go zhes 'phags pa grol sde gsung ste/ nyi khri snang bar grangs stong gi nges pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du bskal pa bzang po la grangs stong du grags pa'i 'di nyid kyis thabs la mkhas pas gzhan sgrub pa dang dgag pa med par shes par bya ba'i don du yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang na 'jig rten 'di zhig pa'i rjes su 'dir chags pa la sangs rgya ba la 'dir sangs rgya zhes dgongs te bskal pa 'dzin pa zhig pa'i shul du 'dir chags pa la 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ /yang na stong bam stong // lnga bshad pa ni sangs rgyas mdzad pa

'tshen na 'od ngal /sa sbya'i cho 'byung ga rtse bsdus/()bcu gnyis 'dir dngos su ston pa'i dbang du byas la/ sangs rgyas mang po bshad pa ni de dag bskal pa bzang po'i ring la byang chub 'thob pa'am/ yang na sprul pa'i dbang du byas pa ste bram ze khye'u bla ma nas sangs rgyas su bshad pa bzhin no/ /de lta na'ang bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis su mi 'gyur te sangasargyas zhes tshul bzung nas chos mi ston pas so/ /bskal pa 'di la sngar sangasargyas bzhi las ma song na dus kyi 'khor lo las/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangasargyas rnam par gzigs la sogs pa shākya thub pa'i mthar thug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun zhes pa dang / 'jig rten na'ang 'das pa'i sangs rgyasarabs bdun zhes grags pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de zhing 'dir byung ba'i sangs rgyas yin zhing 'das pa'ang yin pas de tsam la dgongs par zad do / / yang mdo tha dad na sangs rgyas stong la mtshan mi mthun pa tog la rab gsal dang / mos pa la snang mdzad dam gsal mdzad ces 'byung ba ni mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin la/ 'ga' zhig 'gyur khyad yin pas the tshom mi bya'o/ /gsum pa la zhing 'di la mi mjed ces zer ba ni mi mjed ni bzod pa'i ming ste nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyis mi 'phrog cing 'dod cing bzod la de la sems sran thub pas mi mjed de snying rje pad dkar las/ ci'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya zhe na/ sems can de dag 'dod chags la mi mjed pa dang zhe sdang la mi mjed pa dang gti mug la mi mjed pa dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba rnams la mi mjed pas de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der bskal pa chen po 84

bu ston cho 'byung/bzang po zhes bya ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir bzang po zhes bya zhe na/bskal pa chen po bzang po de la sems can 'dod chags dang zhi sdang dang gnyi mug la spyod pa rnams kyi nang du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa stong 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ zhes gsungasaso / / de yang zhing de'i byang sems rnams la de lta bu'i yon tan yod pas de'i ming gis btags pa'am/ yang na sangs rgyas la bzod pa de mnga' bas de'i ming gis btags te/ 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan gyi bkod pa bstan par/ca byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ba sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa bzod pa dang dul ba dang des pa dang ldan pa dag yod de / de dag ni sems can thams cad kyis spyos bsdigs mtshon gyis btab kyang ji snyam mi mjed de 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnams kyis mi 'phrog go / rigs kyi bu skyes bu dam pa de dag gi ming gis 'jig rten gyi khams de mi mjed ces brjod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan la gdags tshul yang gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i zhing 'dir thub pa 'byon tshul la/slob dpon klu sgrub kyi mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod par/ dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas/ dang por thugs bskyed tshul/ bar du tshogasabasags tshul/ mthar sangs rgyas /sdu la lugs gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi

'tshe' 'od snang la /sa sbya'i rma rus ngas bsdus/()lugs dang / theg chen gyi lugs so/ /dang po la gsum las/ dang po semasabaskyed tshul ni/ sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus su rgyal po gsal grags zhes bya ba zhig byung ngo / /de'i 'khor glang po che'i 'dul spyong shes pa zhig la glang po che zhig 'dul sbyong byed du bcug pas des glang po che'i 'dul sbyong legs par byas te rgyal po la gsol ba dang / rgyal po na re/ khrid shog gsungs nas khrid phyin pa dang rgyal pos zhon te phyin pas glang po che ba lang mo 'dod chags skyes pa'i dri tshor te gcong rong dang nags tshal thams cad la thogs pa med par rgyugs pas rgyal po skrag ste glang rdzi la ci bya dris pa dang / glang rdzi na re/ shing gi yal ga la 'jus shig zer nas 'jus so/ /de nas lhung ste brgyal ba la glang rdzis brgyal ba sangs par byas pa dang / rgyal po khros te glang po tshe ma thul bzhin du thul zer ba 'di btson rar chug cig zer ba dang / glang rdzis smras pa/bdag gis glang po che'i lus thul yang sems ma thul ba lags so zhes smras so / / rgyal po na re/ khyod kyis lus thul ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ des smras pa/ da zhag bdun nas glang po che log nas 'byung de nas shes par 'gyur ro/ /zhesasmras nas zhag bdun lon pa na glang po che byung ba la lcags kyi tho lum bsregasate rab tu 'bar ba mdun du bzhag nas glang rdzi des kha kha zhes brjod pa dang glang po che de mi bzod bzhin du za bar rtsom mo/ /de rgyal po la bstan te bdag gis de'i sems ma thul lo zhes smras pas rgyal po yid ches te sems skyed cing smon lam btab pa/ sbyin pa 'di yis shākya'i rigs skye te/ /yon tan rigasarus mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur teḥ/6/tshangs pa'i bar gyi nyam thag 'ching ba

bu ston chos 'gung /rnams/ /hā bge rgya chen 'jigs med sgrol bar shog /ces smon lam btab ste sems bye/ dpa/ ni/ / de nas bzung ste sangs rgyas yul 'bor skyong gi bar sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong bsnyen bkur zhing bskal pa grangs med par tshogs bsags te grangs med pa dang po rdzogs te/ lung las/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas/ /'dren pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ /bdun khri lnga stong tshang ba yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes so/ /de nas sangs rgyas legasamadzad nas bzung ste dbang po rgyal mtshan gyi bar bdun khri drug stong bsnyen bkur zhing grangs med gnyis pa rdzogs par byas so/ /lung las/ sangs rgyasalegs mdzad nas bzang ste/ /dbang po rgyal mtshan thub pa'i bar/ /bdun khri drug stong tshang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes so/ /de nasamar me mdzad nas/ 'od srungs kyi bar bdun khri bdun stong bsnyen bkur zhing grangs med gsum pa rdzogs par byas te/ lung las/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas ni/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs bar dag tu/ /bdun khri bdun stong tshang ba yi / / sangs rgyas rnams ni ngas mchod do/ /zhes so/lung gci ro)/ /mdzod(lung ring 'i ltar)nas/ rin chen gtsug tor can yan chad kyis grangs med dang po rdzogs so/ /de nas mar me mdzad yan chad kyis gnyis pa rdzogs so/ /de nasarnam par gzigs yan chad kyis gsum pa rdzogs par bshad do/ /rnam gzigs mar me rin chen gtsug /grangs med gsum gyi mtha' mar byung / /dang po shākya thub pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de 8 7 pa chen po brgyar mtshan bzang

ba na 'od nga gas skya'i chos5ngas bsdus/()po'i rgyu sgrub par byed pa la byang chub sems dpa' nges gnas zhes zer ba yinano / / de nas bskal pa brgya lus pa sangs rgyas skar rgyal la zhag bdun dutshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod cing bskor ba bar ma chad par byas pa'i brtson 'grus kyis bskal pa chen po dgu'i tshogs 'dums te de nas bskal pa chen po dgu bcu rtsa gcig 'das pa na grong khyer nyer ldan du sangs rgyas 'od srungs byon pa'i tshe bram ze khye'u bla mar gyur pa yan chad kyis mtshan gyi rgyu rdzog so / / de nas dam pa tog dkar tu zhakhrungs pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa bcaganyis kyi tshul zhib tu lung dang mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo las shes par bya zhing /khyad chos/ston dang bse ru byang chub par//bsam gto mtha' brten gcig la kun//zhes pas so so'i skye bo grangs med gsul du thar pa cha mthun bsags pa zhig gis sgod la bdud btul gung la bsam gtan bzhi pa'idangos gzhi la brten nas sbyor lam yan chad rgyud la bskyed nas tho rangs skya rengs 'char ga'i skad cig gcig yan chad la phyin drug rdzogs te/ji skad du/kun la thams cad snying rje yis//sbyin par byed pas sbyin pa rdzogs//chagasabacas yan lag bcad kyang ni//mi gzugs bzod dang tshul khrims kyi//skar rgyal bstod pas brtson 'grus kyi//de ma thag la ting 'dzin blo//zhes pas phyin drug rdzogs nas sangs rgyas te chos dang gzugs sku'i bdag nyid can du gyur nas kun shes nas rab bzang gi bar la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te lhag med du mya ga las 'das par 'dod do//gnyis pa theg chen gyi lugasaX gsum ste/dang po byang chub mchog tu

bu ston chos 'byung /sem bskyed tshul/bar du bskal pa grangs med par tshogs bsags tshul/mthar bdud bzhi bcom na gsangs rgyas tshul lo//dang po la sems bskyed kyi lnga po/rgyu/phan yon/dbye ba/ji ltar tsod pa'i tshur dang lnga'o//dang po ni/mdo sde rgyan las/spro ba che dang rtsom pa che//don che ba dang 'byung ba che//byang chub sems dpa'i sems pa ste//don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba//zhesagrogs go cha dang spyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/'bras bu rang gzhan gyi don 'grub cing byang chub ོ po 'byung ba/dmigs yul byang chub chen po dang sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'i sems pa 'byung ba sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid du bshad do//mngon rtogs rgyan nas/sems bskyed pa ni gas don phyir//yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod//de dang de ni mdo bzhi du//bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod//ces gsungs shing /de'i 'grel pa dag ldan du/gzhan gyi don gyi phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigasapa'i 'dod pa ni sems bskyed pa'i mas ṣ+ka do//zhes so//gnyis pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'am/byang sems kyi cho 'phrul mthong ba'am gzhan las thosapa las dang bsnye/theg chen gyi sde sdod thos pa / de la sems bskyed pas dang bsogs/byang sems kyi chos nub tu nye ba mthong bde las chos la gces smras sa/snyigasama'i sems can nyon mongs par mthong bal snying rje de la rmes da gas ste rkyen bzhi dang /rigs phun sum tsho gis pa/dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa / snying rje che ba/'khor ba'i dus mi 'jigs pa ste rgyu bzhi dang /rang dang gas dang rgyu dang sbyor ba'i stobs/ 9stobs bzhi ste bcu gnyis so so'am

ba ho 'od snang gas skya'i cho 'byung sa bsdus/()tshogs pa la brten nas skye bar bshad do/ /byang sa las rgyu bzhi rkyen bzhi stob bzhi las skye bar bshad cing mdo sde rgyan du/ grogs stobs rgyu stob rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba//gzhan gyis brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi rgyu dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab bsnyen byas/ /bsod nams ye shesatshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni/ /skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ khes don dam sems bskyed kyi rgyu bshad do/ /bsdu na ji skad du/ de tshwathog mar rigs nus pas/ /snying rje'i sa bon rab sad cing / /sbyor dang bsam pa phun tsho gis las/ /byang chub sems ni yongs su gzung / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ skyes thob kyi 'bras bu ngo mtshar/ bar skabs kyi 'bras bu yid bzhin gyi nor bu sems la rnyed pas dgos 'dod char bzhin du 'bab/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de/dpal byin gyis zhus par/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /gal te de la gzugs ma/sna/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'chi/ pa/ sa sol ngo/ pho/ sgo nas dbye na smon chag gnyis/ phra rags kyi sgo nas phye na brda dang (byang sem so snye)chos nyid kyis thob pa gnyis/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye na kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis/ sa mtshams kyi phye na/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spang ba//0/zhes pa ltar bzhi dang / grogs dang

bu ston chos 'byung /dpes phye ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /zhes pa'am/ bskyed pa sa dang 'dra bar 'dod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /bsdu ba rnam par gtan la dbab par ni bcu gsungs te/ sems bskyed pa ni rnam pa bas ste/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba dang chos nyid kyi thob pa dang / ma nges pa dang nges pa dang yongs su ma dag pa dang yongs su dag pa dang / stobs chung ba dang stobs dang ldan pa dang / 'bras bu yongs su ma grub pa dang / 'bras bu yongs su grub pa'o/ /de la yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba ni byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa nyid du skyon med pa la ma zhugs pa thams cad kyi'o/ /de la chos nyid kyis thob pa ni byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa nyid du skyon med pa la zhugs pa rnams dang nyan thos byang chub tu yongs su bsngos pa rnams kyi'o/ /ma nges pa ni de'i rigs can ma yin pa rnams dang de'i rigs can sems bskyed pa la phyir ldog pa'i chos can rnams kyi gang yin pa'o/ /semasabaskyed pa nges pa ni de las ldog pa las rig par bya'o/ /de la yongs su ma dag pa ni 'di ltar 'di na la la gzhan gyi rjes su zhugs pa'am rgyal pos 'jigs pa'am rkun pos 'jigs pa'am 'dzin khris 'jigs pa'am/ chu klung gisa'ajigs pa'am 'tsho ba'i phyir ram rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i phyir ram/ kha gsag dang gzhogs slong gi phyir nges par ma brtags yongs su ma brtags par gzu lums su sems bskyed par byed pa dang de lta bu dang mthun par sems bskyed par byed pa gang yin pa de ni yongs su ma dag pa yin par rig par bya'o/yongs su dag pa ni de las ldog pa la rig par bya'o/ /de la stob chung ba ni

'tshe na 'od tha lags 'i chos 'gung bsdus/()'di ltar 'di na byang chub sems dpa' la la sems bskyed pa las 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi kun nas dkris pa dag gis zil gyisaganon par byed cing yang dag pa'i sgrub pa las rab tu nyams par byas nasalog pa'i sgrub pa la kun tu sbyor bar byed pa'o/ /stobs dang ldan pa ni de lasaldog pa las rig par bya'o/ /de la 'bras bu yongs su ma grub pa ni mo pasaspyod pa'i sa nas bzung ste sa bcu pa'i bar gyi'o/ /de la 'bras bu yongs su grub pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa las te bcom ldan 'das kyis nga ni dka' ba spyod pa de las thar zhing bdag nyid kyi yang dag pa'i smon lam dang byang chub dam pa yang thob pa yin no/ /zhes ji skad du gsungs pa lta bu'o zhes gsungasaso / /lnga pa ni snying rje pad dkar nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis sems dang po bskyed par bshad do/ /bskal bzang du/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub de la/ /'jam gang zhig ni dbul bar byas nasakyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs la/drin lan bsabs pa ltar na ston pa 'di sngon rigs la gnas pa'i dus na las kyi nusapas dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la shing rta 'dren pa'i rgyad cig tu skyes so/ /de'i tshe zla bo stobs chung ba la srung ma a wang gis yang yang bsnun pas shin tu brtse ba skyes te de'i rkyen gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nasa.a wang la 'di la snying rje'i sems cung zad skyed cig ces smras pas de rab tu khros nas mdung rtse gsum pa bsnun pas tshe'i dus byas te me'i shing rta 'dren pa'i dmyal ba las thar te bskal pa /rgyad kyi sdig pa byang bar gyur to zhes

bu ston chos 'byung / lngang la/phung po gsum pa ltar na ston pa 'di ྾ dpon gyi bu mngon dgar gyur pa na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes chen la dang por sems bskyed par bshad de/yang na ga mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/de bzhin gshegasapa shākya thub pa chen po la kham sa'i bum pa gcig 'gron bu lnga mchil lham zung gcig gdugs gcig rnams phul te/de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang //'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang //de bzhin mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba//de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang char bar shog/ces smon lam btab ste sems bskyed do//gnyis pa tshogs bsags tshul la gsum ste/gang bsag bya'i tshogs ngos gzung ba/ji tsam bsags pa'i dus/ji ltar bsags pa'i tshul dang gsum mo//dang po la tshogs kyi rang bzhin/de phar phyin la sbyar ba/nges tshig las/sgrub tshul/'bras bu/dmigs yul/rnam grangs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang brgyad do//dang po ni/mdo sde rgyan nas/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs//bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med//gcig gis 'khor bar mngon mtho byed//gas gyis sto mongs med par 'khor//zhes pas mngon mtho nges legs kyi rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba zag bcasazag med rnams ni tsho gis kyi rang bzhin no//gnyis pa ni/sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi//tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi//gsum pa gzhan ni gnyis/ste//lnga char yang ni me shes tshogs//zhes so//gsum pa ni/rgyun du bsgom pa thob nas ni//dge ba yang dang yang du bsgrub//ces pas khri ta la saṃ bha ra zhes pa tshogs yin pas/ ta na rgyun du bha wā na zhes pa bsgom pa/

ba chen 'od snang lags 'i cho 'gung tso bsdus/()ra ti ni yang nas yang du ste/ rgyun mi chad par yang yang bsgom pa thob pasatshogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ brtan pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'jug dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /lhun gyis grub par bya ba dang / /dbang bskur mthar thug bya ba'i phyir/ /brtan rnams tshogs ni sgrub par byed/ /ces pas/ mos pas spyod pa dang / sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar dang / sa bdun pa dang / sa brgyad dgu gnyis dang / sabastopa'i tshogs rnams ni grangs bzhin du/ sal 'jug pa dang / sa bdun par mtshan ma med pa dang / brgyad par lhun gyis grub pa dang / bcu par dbang bskur ba dang / sang rgyas kyi sal mthar thug par bya ba'i phyir sgrub bo/ /drug pa ni rin chen phreng bar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku ni/ /bsod namasatshogs las 'khru pas pa ste/ /chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shesatshogs las gzungs/ /zhes pa dang / rigs pa drug na par/ bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog slus pas so/ /de yang rgyu'i gtso bo'i sgo nas bstan pa ste/ phal pa'i tshul gyis gnyis ka yang tshogasaganyis ka'i 'bras bu yin no/ /bdun pa ni/ bsod na mas tshogis kyi dmigasayul kun rdzob bam ji snyed pa/ ye shes tshogs kyi dmigs yul don dam mam ji lta ba'o/ /brgyad pa la dbye sgo bcu gnyis tsam du mdzad de/ dang po theg chen gyi lugs la/ thab sher ba gnyis te mtshan mar 'dzin pa gcod pas shesarab dang / dge ba'i rtsab sdud pas thabs so/ /ga ya go ri'i mdo las/ thabasani sdud pa shes pa'o/ shes rab ni dpyod pa shes pa'o zhesaso/ /de nyid la shes94
