bu ston chos 'gung / rab kyis stong pa nyid la dmigs shing rtogs/ thabs snying rjes sems can gyi don byed pas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis dge chos thams cad bsdusashing sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin te/ dkar po'i chosakun rnam par g.yengs pa dang / /mnyam par bzhag dang gnyis kar shes par bya / / pha rol phyin pa gnyis dang gnyis/ /gnyis kyis yongs su bsdus pa yin//zhes pa dang / longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang / /rab gus gnyis la mi skyo dang / /rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes theg chen thams cad phyin drug gis bsdus par gsungs so/ /'o na nyan rang la phyin drug med dam zhe na/ med de theg bsdus 'grel par/ brtse ru lta bu rnams la ni/ /pha rol phyin drug ming yang med/ /bcom ldan lhag gcig pha rol phyin/ /drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa lags/ /zhes so/ /'o na nyan thos kyi sde snod du'ang phyin drug la sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnams bstan pas gsal zhe na/ de ni cung zad tsam zhig bstan pa yin gyi yongs su rdzogs pa lta ga la ste/ rin chen phreng bar/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub semasadapa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des/ /byang chub semasadapar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang / ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang / /thabs ni de ltar ma bstan phyir/ /nyan thos kyi ni theg pa 'di//theg chen chos zhes bya ba min/ /zhes pas so/ /gsum pa sa'i sgo nas dbye ba ni/rin chen phreng bar/ ji ltar nyan tho/ /ga pa las/ /nyan thos ni brgyad

ba chen 'od nga lags 'i cho 'gung ka zhes bsdus/()bshad pa//de bzhin theg pa chen po la//byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'o//zhes pa'am/skyabs gsum bdun cu par/ji ltar dgra bcom zad ye shes//sa bdun sngon du 'gro ba can//de bzhin rdzogs sangs rgyas ye shes//sabasasngon du 'gro ba yin//zhes pas/nyan thos la dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sadang /rig kyi sa dang /brgyad pa'i sa dang/mthong ba'i sa dang /bsrabasapa'i sa dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang /byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ste brgyad yod pa ltar/theg chen la rab tu dga' ba tshwasogs pa'i sa bcu re re la pha rol tu phyin pa bcu re re gtso che la gzhan phal ba'i tshul du spyod pas dag par bshad do//de sa'i gtso po yin gyi phal pa ni/dad pa'i sal gnas pa yis//zhes pa ltar tshogs lam la dad pa'i sa dang /sa thob pa ni mos pa dang //zhes pa ltar/sbyor lam man chad mos spyod kyi sa'ang yod do//yang byang sar sa bdun du bshad pa'ang yod de/rigs kyi sadang /mos pas spyod pa'i sa dang /lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa'i sa dang /ngesapa'i sa dang /spyod pa'i sa dang /spyod pa nges pa'i sa dang /mthar thug par 'gro ba'i sa'o//zhes so//bzhi pa bsdu ba bzhin dbye na/rgyan las/sbyin mtshungasade ston len 'jug dang //bdag nyid rjes su 'jug rnams kyis//snyan par smra dang don spyod dang //don mthun wo du 'dod pa yin//zhes pas spyin pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs pa'i sbyin pa dang /gzhan la phyin drug ston pa'i snyan par smra ba dang /gzhan dag phyin drug len du 'jug pa'i don spyod pa dang /rang nyid kyang phyin drug la 'jug pa don mthun pa ste ༷/ ba bzhi'o//lnga pa spyod pa bzhir dbye

bu ston chos 'byung /na / rgyan las/ lus can theg pa chen po dang / /theg pa dman la mos pa dang / /gnyis ka 'dun par bya ba dang / /gdul ba'i phyir na brtan rnams kyi/ /spyod pa bzhi po mdo bzhin du/ /rjes su 'brangs nas bshad pa yin/ /zhes pas theg chen la mos pa rnams kyi phyir phar phyin bcu'i ngo bor gyur pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa/ theg dman la mos pa rnams kyi phyir byang phyogs so bdun gyi bdag nyid byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa/ gnyis ka la mos pa rnamasamathun par bya ba'i phyir mngon shes drug gi rang bzhin mngon shes kyi spyod pa/theg pa gsum rka'i gdul bya smin pa'i phyir gdul bya smin pa'i thabs dpag tu med pa ston pa sems can yongs su smin pa'i spyod pa ste bzhi gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo bzhin du bshad do/ /byang sa las kyang/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di bzhis ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad bsdus par rig par bya'o zhes so/ ༷drig pa mi zad pa brgyad cur dbye na dga' khri'i 'gyes snas khog yadapa)ldan las/ sems bskyed bsam sbyor lhag bsam dang / /pha rol phyin drug tshad med dag /mngon par shes dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /so sor rig ston tshogasaganyis dang / byang chub phyogs mthun zhi gnas sogs/ /gzungs sogs chos kyi mdo bshad dang / /bgrod gcig thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /zhes pas semasabaskyed pa dang / /bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / mngon shes lnga dang / bsdu ba bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / chos la rton gyi gang zag la mi rton/ don la rton gyi si tso la mi spyan/ nges don la rton gyi drang don la mi

ba zug 'od snang la /skya'i cho 2 sgyu pa gce bsdus/()rton/ ye shes la rton gyi rnam shes la mi rton pa ste rton pa bzhi dang / tshogasaganyis dang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun dang / zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis dang / gzungs dang spobs pa gnyis dang / 'dus byas thams cad mi rtagazag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad bdag med/ myang 'ad thams cad zhi ba ste chos kyi mdo bzhi dang / bgrod pa gcig pa dang thabs la mkhas pa ste brgyad cu blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo las bshad cing /thub pa dgongs rgyan du de dag gis theg chen gyi lam thams cad bsdus par yang bshad do/ /bdun pa sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis su dbye na mngon rtogasargyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho//rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnamasakyis/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa la dpe de dag gis mtsho ni pa'i don 'phags pa rnam grol sde dang slob dpon seng bzang ltar na grogs 'dun pa dang bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba dang phar phyin bcu re re dang mngon shes drug dang tshogs gnyis dang byang phyogs so bdun dang snying rje lhag mthong dang gzungs spobs dang chos kyi dga' ston dang bgrod gcig lam ldan dang chos kyi sku ldan te grogs de dag dang ldan par 'dod la/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang dag ldan dang thub dgongs su mi zad pa brgyad cu'i phyin drug re rer bgrangs pa gzhan sde tshan re bgrangs pa dang go rim bzhin sbyar ro/ /de lta bu'i sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyis theg chen gyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa bsdus 98

bu ston chos nga / par slob dpon seng ge bzang po dang 'jigs med la sogs pa mang pos bzhed la kha cig slob lam bsdus par bzhed do/ /brgyad pa spyor ba bzhin dbye na/rnam kun mngon rdzogs dang / rtse mo'i sbyor ba dang / mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang /skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'o/khyu sbyor ba bzhi yi bdag nyid dang / /zhes so/ /yang na go cha'i sgrub pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa tshogs kyi sgrub pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ste sgrub pa bzhi'o/ /dgu pa theg pa thun mong gi skad dang bstun nas lam bzhir dbye na tshogs lam dang sbyor lam dang mthong lam dang sgom lam ste bzhi'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i lam ni 'bras bu yin pas ma gtogs so/ /tshogs sbyor gnyis ni de kho na nyid mos pas spyod pa tsam yin gyi mngon sum du ma mthong bas mos pas spyod pa'i sa yin la mthong lam dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam gyis de nyid mngon sum du mthong bas mngon par rtogs pa'o/ /dang po gnyis ni zag bcas kun rdzob shes pa yin pas lam bden dngos min no/ /'o na bsdu bar/ lam gyi bden pa gang zhe na/ tsho gis kyi lam gang yin pa dang / sbyor ba'i lam gang yin pa dang / rnam par dag pa'i lam gang yin pa de thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ lam gyi bden pa che khasabya'o/ /zhes pa dang / kun las ba yis su'ang lam lnga lam bden du bshad do zhe na / skyon med de lam bden gyi 'khor yin pa'am lam bden rjes mthun pa yin pa la dgongs te kun btus 'grel par/ lam rnam pa lnga zhes bya ba ni rab tu dbye ba lnga'i skabs kyis so/ /rab tu dbye ba 'di yang lam gyi bden pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i skabs kyis rig par bya'o/ /zhes lam gyi bden pa'i 'khor du 99

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos na pa gce bsdus/()bshad la/ bsdu bar yang / 'jig rten pa'i chos gang dag yang 'byung ba'i srid pa sun 'byin cing de la mi phyogs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bskyed par byed pa de dag ci'i phyir kun 'byung ba'i bden pas bsdus pa yin zhe na/ de dag ni ngo bo nyid kyis yang 'byung ba'i srid pa la mi phyogs pa yin mod kyi 'on kyang yang 'byung ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi legs par spyad pa dang rjes su mthun pa yin pas de'i phyir de dag kyang kun 'byung ba'i bden pas bsdus pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /tshogs sbyor gyi rang ldog zag med yin la lam bden mtshan nyid pa'o zhe na/(mtsho rag pa/)de mi 'thad de bsdu bar/ thosapa dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dag la brtson par byed de de yang kun rdzob shes pa dge ba zag pa dang bcas pa yin no / / de de la brten nas nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa de dag la brtson par byed de/ de yang kun rdzob shes pa dge ba zag pa dang bcas pa yin no/ /de de la brten nas mthong ba'i lam gyi sbyor ba nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa dang ldan pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa de dag la brtson par byed de/ de yang kun rdzob shes pa dge ba zag pa dang bcas pa yin no/ /de de la brten nas mthong ba'i lam gyi bar chad med pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog skyed par byed de/ de yang kun rdzob shes pa dge ba zag pa dang bcas pa yin no zhes de dag zag bcas su bshad do/ /bcu pa bslab pa gsum du dbye na/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang lhag pa'i 100

snye ston cho 'byung /sems dang lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa'o/ /rgyan las kyang / bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /mtha' ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ /zhes so/ /bcu gcig pa ni bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum ste/sbyin pa la byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ste gsum mo//dang po ni/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o//gnyis pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gsum pa ni bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi phar phyin rnams so/ /bcu gnyis pa lam bdun nam byang phyogs sum na so bdun du dbye ba ni grags pa nyid do/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis ston pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyang bshad par nus gsungasaso / / gnyis pa dus ji tsam du bsags pa'i dus ni/ gsung rab nas mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ste bskal pa grangs med gsum dang bdun dang bcu dang sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa bshad la/ bcu gsum du bshad pa'ang yod gsung ngo / /de la grangs med gsum ni gsung rab phal cher las 'byung zhing grangs med kyi don yang mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa dang thub pa dgongs rgyan la sogs pa mang po nas/ bgrang ba las 'das pa'i grangs med ma yin gyi/ grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cur phyin pa'i grangs med la bzhed la/ grangs ni/ gcigabacu/ brgya/ stong / khri/ 'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur/ ther 'bum/ ther 'bum chen po/ phrag khrig phrag khrig chen po/ rab bkram/ rab bkram chen po/101

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()gtams/ gtams chen po/ dkrigs/ dkrigs chen po/ mi 'khrugs pa mi 'brugs pa chen po/ khyad phyin/ khyad phyin chen po/ pang steng / pang steng chen po / ded 'dren/ ded 'dren chen po/ mtha' snang / mtha' snang chen po/ rgyu rigargyu rig wo po/ 'od mdzes/ 'od mdzes byu po/ dbang po/ dbang po r+sā golegs phyin/ legs phyin chen po/ rtogs 'gro/ rtogs 'gro chen po/ 'bying rdul/ 'byeng rdul ོ po/ rgya rtags/ rgya rtags mu po/ stobs 'khor/ stob gcor chen po/ brda shes/ brda shes chen po/ rnam 'byung / rnam 'byung chen gostobs mig stobs mig chen po/ grangs med pa ste bar nas grangs kyi gan gzhan brgyad chad ces gsung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i sa las bskal pa chen po grangs med pa bgrang ba'i tshul gnyis te/ bskal pa chen po re re la'ang lo dang zla ba dang skad cig la sogs pa grangs med pa'i bskal pa chen po grangasamed pa zhes bya ba dang / bskal pa chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa'i grangs med pa la bskal pa chen po grangs med pa zhes bya ba gnyis las 'tshang rgya ba la grangs med mang po dgos par bshad pa ltar na grangs med dang po bzung la grangs med gsum gyis chog pa ltar na grangs med kyi lugs phyi ma 'dzin par bzhed do/ /'di ltar byas na mdo dag las bskal pa chen po gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa zhes pa dang mthun par snang ngo / /brgyad stong 'grel par grangs med gsum du bshad pa dgongs pa can yin gyi nges don du grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum du bzhed de/ ji skad du 'di ltar bskal pa grangs med pa dang pos ni tshogs kyi sa nas brtsams te sa dang po'i bar du rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /102

bu ston cho 'gung / gnyis pa ni dri ma med pa'i sa nas bzung ste sa bdun pa'i bar du'o/ /yang bskal pa grangs med pa gsum pas ni sa mi g.yo ba nas bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyisasangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur ba yin pas na sgra ji bzhin pa nyid kyi mdo dang 'gal lo zhe na/ gsum tshan du mtshungs pas na bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis shes gsungs pa yin gyi don dam par ni ma yin no/ /des na de ltar drangs pa'i don gyi mdo bshad pa ni shin tu 'gal ba kho na'o/ /'di ltar dbyig gnyen gyi zhal snga nas kyis/ tshogs kyi bkun tu rdzogs par byed pa la bskal pa grangs med pa gcig 'da' bar byed do/ /de'i 'og tu mos pas spyod pa'i sa rdzogs par byed pa na bskal pa grangs med pa gnyis 'da' bar byed do/ /de'i 'og tu sa rab tu dga' ba nas brtsams te byang chub sems dpa'i sa chos kyi sprin gyi bar yang so sor bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gsum gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sa rdzogs par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sa kun tu 'od sgrub par byed pa yin te/ de ltar na bskal pa grangs med pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyis sangasargyas nyid thob pa yin no zhes bshad do zhes so/ /rgya cher rol par/ bskal pa grangs med pa bdun du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pa zhes bdun du bshad do/ /nyan thos pa kha cig grangs med bcur 'dod par dul lha'i sde pa tha dad bklag par bshad do/ /des na lugs mang po snang yang mang pos 'dod cing grags pa dang / byams pas/ sa ni dang po yin par 'dod//'di de bskal pa dpag med kyis/ /zheX3 pa dang / grang med gsum ni rdzogs

'tsheg 'od ngal /sa 'i cho ching tso bsdus/()pa yis/ /sgom pa'i lam ni tshar phyin to/ /zhes pa grangs med gsum du bshad par bya'o/ /de yang sems bskyed byas ma thag grangs med rtsom pa la ma zhugasate / ji skad du/ dkon mchog sprin las/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni bskal pa grangs med pa du mas yang dag par grub pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ dpag pa dang / bsam pa dang / brtag par mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bskal pa grangs ma mchis pa gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yang dag par grub pa ma lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul bsgrub par bya ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de ni bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis yang dag par bsgrub par mi nus kyi nam byang chub sems dpa' chos mnyam pa nyid du zhugs par gyur pa de'i tshe nas brtsams te bskal pa bgrang bar bya yi/ thog ma'i sems nas brtsams te de ni ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /des na theg bsdus las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /sems brtan khyad par 'gro ba yis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i grangasamed gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ bzang po ni dge ba ste de stobs dang ldan par gyur pa ni bzang po'i stobs can te/ de de la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /smon pa ni 'dir smon lam du 'dod de de la de yod pas smon lam gyi stobs can no/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs can ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis zil gyis mi gnon pa'i phyir ro/ /smon lam gyi stobs104

bu ston chos 'gung / can ni rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa'i phyir ro/ /sems brtan pa nyid ni mi dge ba'i grogs pos mos pa bzlog kyang byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir ro/ khyad par du 'gro ba ni mthong ba'i chos dang tshe rabs phyi ma la dge ba'i chos 'phel ba dang yongs su mi nyams pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar gang gi tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba dang smon lam gyi stobs can dang sems brtan te bar ma dor mi ldog pa dang khyad par du 'gro ba ste yon tan cung zad kyis chog par mi 'dzin pa de na brtsams te grangs med pa gsum brtsams so/ /zhes so/ kha cig(rgyang ro ba)na re/ grangs med kyi mgo sbyor lam nas rtsom ste/ byang sa las/bskal pa chen po grangs med pa dang pos ni mos pas spyod pa la gnas pa las yang dag par 'das nas sa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa thob ste zhes pa dang /de'i 'grel par/ brtson 'grus 'bar ba rgyun mi chad par dge ba'i rtsa ba la gnas pas ni mos pa la spyod pa'i sa nas grangs med pa yin par bstan pa'i phyir zhes bshad pas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /'di dpyad par bya ste/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa nas rtsom par bshad pas sbyor lam kho na nas brtson par mi 'grub ste byang sa nas kyang mos pas spyod pa sems dang po bskyed pa man chad la bshad cing kun las ba yis kyi 'grel par yang / mos pas spyod pa can gyi byang chub sems dpa 'a ni rigs la gnas pa thog mar smon lam chen po btab pa nas bzung nas rab tu dga' ba'i sa la ma zhugs pa'i bar du ste so so rang gis 'jig rten las 'das pa thob pa med pa'i phyir ro zhes pas so/ /de ltar min na sngar gyi lung dang / a sa ka ra gup+ta/snyo/5bskal pa grangs med pa dang pos ni

ba chen 'od ngags skya'i cho 'gu pa gce bsdus/()tshogs kyi lam nas brtsams nas sa dang po rdzogs kyi bar du'o/ /zhes pa dang ji ltar mi 'gal/ des na tshogs lam du bzang po'i stobs can la sogs pa nam grub pa nas grangs med rtsom mo/ /yang bsdu bar/ ji ltar skye ba gcig gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par bsgrub tu rung ste dgra bcom pa la ni re zhig skye ba gcig kyang med na skye ba'i rgyun lta smos kyang ci dgos she na/ smras pa/ tshe'i 'du byed bsrings nas mngon par sgrub par byed do zhes bshad do/ /dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen ni byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po dang brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i dbang gis grangs med gsum gyi ngesapa med gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde sdod bzhin du bshad na/ dang po rgyal po'i pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan du rgyal po tshe rnam par rgyal ba'i sras gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod ces bya bar gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrun pa nas brtsams nas bskal pa grang bang med gcig tu tshogs bsags pags dang po thob par gyur to/ /de nas grong khyer 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser du rgyal po mdzes par snang ba'i sna chen po tshong dpon shes rab bzang du gyur pa'i tshe de bshin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur zhing rjes su bstan pa mnos pa nas bzung ste grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bdun non par gyur to/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u sprin zhes bya bar gyur pas bram ze rin po che la rig byed bslab nas bsnyen bkur bya ba'i rgyu btsal ba'i phyir 106

bu ston chos 'byung / yul dbus kyi grong khyer dag tu ljongs rgyur song ste mthar gyis rgyal po dgra thul gyi pho brang pad ma can zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus kyi dbus su phyin te/ de'i tshe bram ze mar me'i bdag po'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'jig rten du byon te nam mkha' la lha rnams me tog dang rol mo sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bcas te bzhugs pa mthong nas/ khyed ci zhig byed dris pas khyed kyis mi shesasam/ 'di na sangs rgyas mar me mdzad bzhugs so zhes zer ro/ /de skyi bung zhes byed cing / kye ma sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni rnyed par dka' bas bdag gisaslob dpon gyi yon ni phyis bsab par bya ste/ dar+sha pa ṇi lnga brgya po 'dis sangasargyas la mchod par bya'o snyam du dgongs nas bram ze'i bu mo bzang len ldan la rngan par skye ba thams cad du khyim thab tu khas blangs shing ut+pal lnga nyos nasasangs rgyas la gtor te/ kṛ sna sa ra'i lngags pa bting nas mar me mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas spyan bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud par mdzod la ri dwags kyi pags pa 'di la zhabs bzhag par mdzod cigaces pa dang / der byon pas mnyes par byas te ral ba gser gyi mdog can stan du bting nas mar me mdzad kun nas spyan 'di la zhabs mi 'jog gam lung mi ston na 'di nyid du lus bskam par bya'o zhes yi dam brtan por bcas pa dang / ston pas zhabs bzhag ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyi khye'u 'di'i skra la rdog pa ma 'jog cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod gnas yin te ma 'ongs pa'i dus su shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa dang / dga' ches | 0/nga ta la bdun srid du nam mkha' la

ba si 'od thag 'i cho na khyi gce bsdus/()'phags nas ting nge 'dzin brgya stong yang mngon du byas nas sa brgyad pa thob ste/ji skad du/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la ut+pal lngas/ /gtor te ral ba stan du bting byas pas/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob gyur nas/ shākya'i rgyal por 'gyur zhes nga lung bstan/ /zhes pa dang / lung rī sa / gang tshe mar me mdzad kyisang / /lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur te/ /dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur/ khes so/ /de nas bzung ste grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bcu rdzogs so/ /mchims pa ni/ grangs med gsumapa'i mtha' ma de bzhin gshegs pa skar ma'i rgyal po yin par mngon cing / de'i tshe tshogs rdzogs mod kyi rnam pa thams cad du ma rdzogs pas bskal pa 'di'i tshe lo nyi khri pa la grong khyer nyer ldan du sangs rgyas 'od srungs byon pa'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa'i bar du tshogs bsags gsung ngo / /de dag gi skabasasu'ang sangs rgyas grangs med pa bsnyen bkur zhing chos gsan te/ zla ba sgron mar/ sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba phrag khrig dang / /de las lhag pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /kun kyang bya rgod phung po 'dir bzhugs te/ /mi dbang de kun nga yisabakur sti byas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa mngon par rdzogs par sangasargyas tshul la/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ngos gzung / thub pa'i mdzad pa khyad par du bshad/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i don bye brag tu gto la dbab pa'o/ /dang po la/ sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad rten sku/ brten pa ye shes/ mdzad pa phrin las gsum du 'chad pa dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lngar 'chad pa dang / spangs rtogs phrin las gsum du 'chad pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa 108

snye ston chos 'gung / gnyis sam gsum du 'chad pa la sogs pa bshad tshul mang po gsu pas la/sangs rgyas sa'i mdo las/shin tu 'dus chos lnga gsangs rgyas kyi sa bsdus te/lnga gang zhe na/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang me long lta bu'i ye shes dang mnyam pa nyid kyi me shes dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so zhes gsungs la/ sku gsum mam bzhin yang gsungs pas 'di la lnga/sku /sum gyi ngo bo/ nges tshig grangs nges/ gang gi yul yin pa/ dbye ba dang lnga'/ /dang bo ni/ a las/ sa bzhi chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /sprulapa dag gis tha dad 'jug /'di ni sangs rgyas rnams dag gi /chos dbyingasarnam par dag par bshad/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dbye ba/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /gzhan ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /dang po gnyis pa'i rten yin no/ /zhes pa'i rang bzhi gyi sku dang /ngo bo i sku dang / chos kyi sku zhes pa rnam grangs yin la/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang me long lta bu'i ye shes ni chos sku'o/ khyu bdag gzhan mnyam par bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la bzhugs pa mnyam nyid ye shes dang / shes bya thams cad thogs med du mkhyen pa'i so sor kun rtog gi ye shes gnyis longs sku'o/ /sna tshogs su sprul nas sems can gyi don sgrub pa bya grub ye shes ni sprul pa'i sku'o/ /rgyan las/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dpag med pas/ /sprul pa'i skur ni 'dod pa ste/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogasapa ni/ /rnam pa thams cad gnyisalaganas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dharma 1/ya zhes pa chos sku ste/ /ya'i byings

ba chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()ni tsi tsa ye zhes pa bsags pa ste/ zag med kyi chos bsags pas sku zhes pa'am/ bden gnyis las/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir/ /yon tan bsam yas kun rten phyir/ /rigs pa'i rjes 'brang ngo bo'i phyir/ /skyob pa rnams kyi chos sku yin/ /zhes pa ltar khyab pa dang rten byed pa dang ngo bo nyid du grub pas chos sku'o/ /saṃ sto ga ka ya zhes pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste theg pa chen po'i chos la yongs su rdzogs par longs spyod pas longs spyod rdzogs sku ste/ sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /ces sam/ 'di de chos rdzogs longs spyod pas/ /zhes pa dang / chos la rdzogs long spyod don phyir/ /zhes so/ /nir māṇa ka ya zhes pa sprul sku ste/ nges par 'gyur ba'am rgyun mi brtan pa'am ngesapar gzhan du sprul zhid bsgyur bas sprul sku ste/ dpag med bsam yab sprul pa yis/ /sems can don kun sgrub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes bya ste/ /sku gsum dag gis rang gzhan gyi/ /don 'di rten dang bcas par bstan/ /zhes pas longs sku rang don/sprul sku gzhan don/ de gnyis ka'i rten chos skur nges so/ /bzhi pa ni/ chos sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni sangs rgyas kho na'i yul/ rjes mthun pa sa brgyad pa'am sa dang po thob pas kyang mngon du byed nus la mos spyod pas kyang don spyi tsam yul du byed do/ /longs sku ni byang sems sa bcu pa yan chad thob pa kho na'i yul du 'dod pa dang sa thob pa thams cad kyi yul du 'dod pas lugs gnyis su'o/ /dang po ni rin chen phreng bar/ bsam yas me shes yul gyi bdag /dbang phyug chen po mchog yin no/ /zhes pa'am/ dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes 110

bu ston chog thing /gnyen gyis kyang longs sku mtshan nyid pa sa bcu pa thob pa'i yul du bshad do/ /'dod tshul gnyis pa ni/ skyabs gsum bdun cu par/ bsod nams tshogs ni tshad med las/ /'khrungs pa de ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /sa bcu la ni gnas rnamasakyi / / mthong bar gyur pa sku de yis/ /chos kyi rdzogs longs spyod 'di ni/ /rgyalasras rnams ni spyod pa yin/ /zhes sam/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la bzhugs pa rnams dang thabs cig ces pas so/ /sprul sku la mchog gi sprul sku ni drod yan chad nas nam 'dod du mthong zhing tshogs lam chen po nas phal cher mthong ste/ rgyan las/ de ltar mthong dka'i thub pa rtag mthong zhing / /zhes pasaso / / de man chad du'ang mthong srid ces gsungs so/ /skye ba'i sprul pa la sogasapa ni gang la gang 'dul du snang ste/ gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa/ /de dang de la de snang ngo / /zhes so/ /gdul bya min pa'am mi snang ba'i gdul bya rnams la mi snang ste/ rgyan las/ ji ltar chu yi snod chag na/ /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan mi snang ba/ /de bzhin sems can ngan pa la/ /sangs rgyasagazugs kyang mi snang ngo / /zhes so/ /lnga pa dbye ba chos sku la/ gser 'od las/de kho na nyid dang yang dag pa'i ye shes nyid tsam du gnas pa de ni chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /zhes pas chos can chos nyid dam dbyings ye shes sam 'dus byasa'adus ma byas gnyis so/ /longs sku la dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis long spyod rdzogs pa chen po sa bcu pa thob pa yan chad kyi yul dang / sa dang po thob pa'i byang sems yan chad kyi yul sprul sku khyad par can la longs skur btags pa gnyis so zhes gsung ngo / 1/// po ni nges pa lnga ldan te/ gnas nges

ba chen 'od snang mugs skya'i chos5nga sa bsdus/()pa 'og min ni bkas bcad bar par 'og min gtsang ma'i gnas kyi logasashig na yod par bshad/lang rkar gshegs par/rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pa yi / / 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar//gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs nas//yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas//sprul pa po de 'dir 'tshang rgya//zhes pa dang /rgyud las kyang /gtsang ma'i gnas ni spangs pa na//zhes pa dang /slob dpon ka ma la shī las/'og min zhes bya ba ni lha dag ste/de dag gi phyogs gcig na gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do//der 'phags pa nyid 'ba' zhig gnas so//de dag gi steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba'i gnas yod de der sa bcu pa la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' srid pa mtha' ma ba kho na skye ba bzhes pa yin la 'dir ni de lta bu'i sprul pa dmigs pa yin no//zhes bya ba'i lung yin no//zhes pas 'og min phal pa'i steng na yod par bshad pas/gzhi dang snying po me tog gisabargyan pa'i zhing khams nyid longs sku'i zhing du chos kyi bshes gnyen bzhed do//gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya la stong gsum/de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byamasakyi mtshams sbyor ba gcig de bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud gcigade bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams kyi rgyud bar ma gcig de bye ba phrag brgya la me rtag gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa ste rnam snang gi zhing /de'ang rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i phyag gi mthil gyi rdul phran gcig la gnas shing rnam snang de longs skur 'dod do//ngo bo nges pa mas dpes brgyan pa/lu thor nges pa sabs byang sems/longs spyod nges pa theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs2

bu ston chos 'gu pa /spyod pa/dus nges pa rgyun mi chad pa'o//sprul sku la/bzo dang skye dang byang chub che / / mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pa//sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni//rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po//zhes pas/dang po la thams cad pa'am dri zar sprul pa dang /gnyis pa bya la sogs par ston pa dang /gsum pa shākya thub pa lta bu'am/bzhi pa myang 'das te bzhi'am/chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis rnam par smin pa yin min gnyis so//zhes gsungs so//de ltar byang sems du ma sangasargyas pa rnams gcig kyang min la mang po'ang min zhing gcig dang tha dad gang du yang ma grub ste/rgyan las/zag med dbyings nas sangs rgyas rnams//mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir dang //sngon gyi lus rjes 'brangs pa'i phyir//gcig min mang po ṣ+ka ma yin//spyo dang /tha dad rigs don med phyir dang //rdzogasadang thog ma med pa'i phyir//sangs rgyas gcig min dri med gnas//tha dad min phyin mang po'ang min//zhes so//gnyis pa ni/thub pa la mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab kyang grangs la dga' ba rjes su bzung ba dang gtso bo nye bar bzung nas mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis su tha snyad mdzad de/pad ma'i ngang tshul gyis/sangs rgyas kyi sku'am mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bsam la bying ba zhi bar bya'o zhes dang /chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis kyang dga' ldan gyi gnas nas babs pa la sogs pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis gdul bya smin par mdzad pa zhes bshad pa yin no//de la'ang /rin chen phreng bar/snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa rnams//gshegs dang bltams dang rol pa dang /khab nasa'abyung dang dka' spyod dang //byang chub ched du bsnyed sde 'joms/chos kyi 'khor

ba 'a 'od ngags 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()lo bskor ba dang / /lha rnams kun nas babs pa dang / /de bzhin du ni mya ngan las/ /'das pa ston pa'i mdzad pa yin/ /zhes pa la sogs pa lha las babasapa'i mdzad pa zhes pa gcig tu bgrang ste de'ang rgya gar gyi grong khyer sgra can zhesabya ba'i grong khyer chen por/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sum cu rtsa gsum du yuma'adul ba la byon nas/ de nas mar lam be+e ḍūr+ya'i skas la byon pa la lha lasababs pa zhes zer ro/ /thabs la mkhas pa zhes pa la sogs pa'i mdo las/dam pa'i chos nub pa la mkhas pa zhes chos nub pa'ang mdzad pa gcig tu gsungs te chos don du mi 'gyur ba na nub par bstan nas sems can la chosaspong gi las mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir yin te/ gser 'od dam pa las sangasargyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te/ /zhes so/ kha cig(rig ral)na re/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba zhes gcig tu byed pa la/ gzhan dag na(rgyang ro ba)re/ de mi rigs te/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel par yang dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogs pa ston pa'i sgo nas zhes pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel par yang / dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs pa la sogasapa kun tu ston par rung ba zhes pa dang / rgyud blar/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang //zhes dga' ldan na gan pa mdzad pa'i thog mar bshad pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi 'grel chen du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sprul pa'i skus dang po dga' ldan gyi gnas nas babs pa nas mtha' ma yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'i bar gyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa cig car ston zhes pa dang mthun par 114

bu ston chos 'byung / snang ngo //'o na mdzad pa 'di dag sangs rgyas sam byang sems gang gi mdzad pa yin zhe na/mdo yab sras mjal bar/thub pa'i dbang po 'di sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas shing da dung sangs rgya ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis gzhan don byed pa'i sprul par bshad de/ji skad du/bye ba brgyad cur rgyal ba nyid//sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang //da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsal//byang chub mchog tu thugs kyang 'jug/stong gsum drug cu rtsa gcig gi/sangs rgyas zhing rnams dag gyur pas//ji ltar thub pa thabs mkhas dang //rgyal ba khyod ni kun gyis 'tshal//da dung dang por thugs bskyed par//de dang der ni yongs bstan te / / da dung du yang 'dren pa khyod/sangs rgyas mang po ston par mdzad//cesaso / / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po las kyang /bskal pa bye stong bsam gyisami khyab pa//de yi tshad ni nam yang med pa nas//byang chub mchog rab 'di ni ngas thob ste//nga ni rtag tu chos kyang rab lar do//zhes sngar sangs rgyas par gsung so//de mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa yin du chug na'ang grub mtha'i 'dod tshul gsum las nyan thos kyi lugs gong du bstan cing /theg chen gyi lugs kyis sangs rgyas rnams 'og min du sangs rgyas nas 'dod khams su mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston par gsungs te/lang spur gshegs par/'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du//sangs rgyas rnam par 'tshang mi rgya//gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du//'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o//zhes pa dang /sdug po bkod pa'i mdo las/sang rgyas thams cad 'og min du//sangs rgyas

'tsheg 'od snang gas 'i cho skang tso bsdus/()ma gyur 'dod khams su//sang rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do//zhes dang /rgyud bla mar yang /thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen//'jigs rten kun lagazigs nas ni//chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par//sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis//skye ba mngon par skye ba dang //dga' ldan gnas ni 'pho ba dang //lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang //bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang //btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang //nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang //byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang //bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni//byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang //mya ga 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams//yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su//srid pa ji srid gnas par ston//zhes sprulaskur bshad pa dang /rnam bshad rigs par yang /bram ze'i khye'u bla ma nasabazung ste yongs su mya ngan 'das pa chen po'i bar du sprul pa tsam zhig yin par bstan pa de la dgos pa ci yod ce na/zhes pa'i 'grel par/bcom ldan 'das 'od srungs kyi dus na bram ze'i khye'u bla ma tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa sprul pa yin par bstan to//de nas dga' ldan du tog dkar por skyes pa dang de nas zas gtsang gi sras don thams cad grub par bstan pa dang /khab na bzhugs pa dang /khab nas nges par byung nas ring 'phur la sogs pa la byang chub kyi lam 'tshol ba la zhugs pa dang/rim gyis sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang //de nas rim gyis mya ga las 'ad pa ོ po'i bar du sprul pa tsam zhig yin par bstan to//zhes 'byung zhing /ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas kyang /dpal ldan stug po 6 pa nyid du don dam thugs chud

bu ston chos 'byung /cing / /dga' ldan skye bo'i don mdzad phyir ni dam pa tog dkar gyur/ /de nasa'adir ni 'gro ba'i don du shākya'i tog gyur gang / /'a ri bdag las rgyal sgyu ma kun ston de ni rgyal gyur cig /ces pa la sogs pa mang po'i bzhed pas tshogs rdzogs nas sa bcu pa'i srid pa mtha' ma'i rten la 'og min du sangs rgyas nas gdod 'dod khams su mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par 'chad do/ shwakya bshes gnyen la sogs pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i lugs kyis dka' ba spyod pa'i dus su rnam smin gyi lus chu bo ne ra dz+nyā ra'i 'gram du bzhag nas ye shes kyi lus 'og min du phyin nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas nas slar ye shes dka' ba spyod pa'i lus la zhugs te byang chub snying por gshegs pa la sogs pa mdzad pas dka' ba spyod pa man chad byang sems/yan chad sangs rgyas su 'dod la lo ts+tsha ba chen po sprul pa'i sku rin chen bzang pos kyang sngags log sun 'byin du de ltar bshad(sngag snyedang bas na leg rgyu ra)do / / dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen na re/ 'og min du sangs rgyas nas 'dir mdzad pa ston pa thub pa 'di lta bu dang 'dod khams nyid du mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston cing sangs rgyas mngon du byed pa gnyis yod gsung ngo / /theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs kyi mngon pa kun las btus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyisami khyab pa gang zhe na/ gang dga' ldan gyi gnas na gnas pa nas bzung ste yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa yang 'dod pa'i khams su ston pa'i gang zag go zhes pa'i 'grel par/ byang chub se~Xdapa'i spyod pa thams cad ces bya ba

ba chen 'od snang las/skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()ni dga' ldan gyi gnas na gnas pa nas bzung ste bdud las rgyal ba'i bar du'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba ni mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa nas bzung ste yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar du'o/ /zhes sgra ji bzhin par 'chad do/ /'dir rgyud bla ma'i tshigs bcad bzhin du bshad par bya ste / bram ze'i khye'u bla ma de tshe 'phos nas dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya bar gyur te('di gdag pa'i bstan bcos na zur tsam gsal rnam bshad rig pa'i 'grel pa nag4)lha rnams la chos ston to/ /de'i tshe nyid kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs kyis lha'i rol mo'i sgra dag las/bsod nams rgya che tshogs mnga' dran rtogs dang / /blo gros mtha' yas shesarab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' sgyu rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /skyes mchog khyed kyi bsod namasadapal gyis ni/ /dga' ldan pho brang shin tu mdzes mod kyi/ /'on kyang thugasarje'i thugs dang ldan pas na/ /thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan dag tu char pa phob/ /ces pa nas/ 'di ni dus lags btang snyoms ma mdzad ces/ /snying rje'i yid dang ldan pas skul bar byed/ /ces pa la sogs pas bskul lo/ /de'i tshe gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu rnams byang chub sems dpa' mngal du 'jug pa'i lo bcu gnyis kyi gong nas bram zer sprul te 'og nas 'chad pa'i rnam pas mngal du zhugs par gyur na/ mtshan dpe dang ldan te 'khor rte rgyal lam sangasargyas su 'gyur ro zhes 'don du 'jug cing rang sangs rgyas rnams la lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' lhums su 'jug gi zhing 'di bor cig ces118

bu ston chos 'byung/zer zhing de rgyal po'i khab kyi mjug ma bsgyur ba'i ri la rang rgyal glang po zhes pa thos te rdo la rkang rjes bzhag ste 'das so/ /wā rā ṇa srir rang rgyal lnga brgya me'i khams la zhugs te 'das nas ring bsrel lhung bas/drang thong 'a po 'ad da ltar gyi sangs rgyas/chung ba mu steg kyi drang srong /gzhan 'od srungs pog kyis chos smra ba yin pasadrang sgong smra ba/rgyal po tshang pa byin gyi mi 'jig pa byin pa'i ri dwags kyi nags)drang thong lhung bar grag so/ /de na bskul ba'i don rjes su dgongs te/ dus tshe lo brgya pa dang / gling 'dzam bu'i gling dang / yul dbus dang / rigs rgyal rigasate bzhi la gzigs pa'am lung ltar na/ rigs dang dus dang yul dang rus dang bud med la gzigs pa dang lngas 'jig rten la gzigs te mi'i yul du gshegs par rtsom pa na lha rnams la grogs po dag chos snang ba'i sgo brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag ni rgyal sras 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe bstan par bya'o/ /grogs po dag dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste bsam pa mi phyed par 'gyur ro/ /dang ba ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems rnyog ma can dang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes pa nas/dbang bskur ba'i sa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste mngal du 'jug pa nas mya ngan lasa'adas pa chen po ston pa'i bar du 'gyur ro zhes pa'i bar du gsungs nas/ gang gi tshe na dga' ldan gnas mchog nas/ /'dren pa skyes bu seng ge 'chi 'pho'i tshe / /lha rnam dag la tshig tu smras pa ni/ /grogs dag bag med spyod pa spang bar gyis/ /zhes pa la sog pa gsungs shing rin po che'i cod pan ma pham pa'i dbu la bcing tshonas/ grog po dag kho bo ni 'tham bu'i gling du 'tsha rgyar 'gro ste khyed la ma pham pas chos ston to/ //sdu gsungs pas lha rnams mi dga' bar

ba be 'od snang la /skya'i cho 'gung sa bsdus/()gyur nas/ skyes bu dam pa khyed ni mi bzhugs na/ /dga' ldan gnas 'di mdzes par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer zhing / byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu'i gling de ni deng sang 'od srungs rdzogs byed dang / kun tu rgyu gnag lhas kyi bu dang / smra 'dod kyi bu mo'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi pham skra'i wā ba can dang / ka cu'i bu nog can dang / gcer bu pa gnyen gyi bu ste rtog ge pa drug dang /bram ze rgyu rgyal dang / bram ze rnas rdeg dang / bram ze bzang ldan dang / bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe dang / bram ze pad ma'i snying po dang / bram ze dmar po ste rjes su sgrog pa drug dang / rings byed kyi bu lhag spyod dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur dang / kun tu rgyu rab bzang dang / bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal dang / drang sgong nyon mongs med dang / steng rgyas 'od srungs ral ba can te/ snyoms la sug pa drug ste/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyis ma rungs par bgyis pasagashegs pa'i skabs ma lags so/ /zhes gsol bas dung gi sgra dang rol mo'i sgra gzhan mi 'dre ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'od gzhan ltar de dag gi chos dang mi 'dre zhing de dag nga nyid kyis zil gyis gnon nus so/ /seng ge gcig gisagacan gzan tshogs rnams du ma rnam par skrag /rdo rje gcig gis brag gi rtse mo du ma rnam par 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lha ma yin dpung du ma rnam par 'joms/ /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams du ma rnam par sel/ /zhesagasungs nas kho bo ji lta bu'i gzugs kyis 'gro bar bya zhes dris pas/ la la tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis/ la la brgya byin la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis rigasaso zer yang / lha'i bu gzi brdzid dam1 ༵ na re/ rig byed nas 'byung ba bzhin

bu ston chos sku nga /glang po che'i gzugs kyis rigs so zer nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chas pa dang rgyal po zas gtsang gi khyim du ltas bco brgyad byung ngo / /de nas dgun 'das te dpyid zla tha chung skar ma sag la bab pa'i tshes bco lnga zla ba nya skar ma rgyal(mdo na 'di ga bod de 'grig pa bka' 'gyur la'i sa sam gsungs)gyi dus su yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i glo g.yas par glang po che'i rnam pas lhums su zhugs te/gser gyi dra bas legs g.yogs spyi gtsug dmar/ /thal dar mche ba drug dang rab ldan zhing / /dung dang kha ba dngul mdog lta bu yi/ /glang po'i mchog cig khong du song snyam byed/ /de zhugs nas ni bdag gi lus dang sems/ /sngon chad mthong thos myong bar ma gyur pa'i/ /gya nom bde bas shin tu bder gyur te/ /bsam gtan mnyam par bzhag pa bzhin du gyur/ /ces so/ /rmi ltas de bram ze rnams la dris pas sras khyad par can zhig 'byung ste/ khab tu bzhugs na 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang / rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan no/ /de nas yum gyi lhums rgyal sras kyi nye bar spyad pa rin po che bkod pa zhes par byin gyis brlabs nas/ zla ba bcur zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyad nas lha dang mi'i skye rgu phrag khrig phrag sum cu rtsa drug smin par byas so/ /de nas me tog kha 'bus shing rgyas par ma gyur pa la sogs pas ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ba dang / lum+bi ni'i tshal du yum gyi phyag shing blak+ṣa la 'a sdus te/ yum gyi glo g.yasapa nas yum la gnod pa med par na bza' dang bcas nas bltams (rgyan gtu rgyal rab bzhi pa tsi'u dbang zhes pa'i dus su shing pho stag gi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la rgya gar du bcom ldan 'das snu gsangs/ de'i 'od dang cho 'phrul rnams rgya nag tu mthong bas sangs rgya byon par 121

ba ga 'og thal gas 'i cho nga gce ba /()shes/lo nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs/yum 'dus ba la sus na rtsa gsu du byon pa'i bar la rgyas po tra ya na mo la gyi snye la bskul na de lha snyel du bcom ldan 'ad kyi rdzu tsan dan la bzheng te snyel du gdan drangs/bcom ldan 'ad lha la bab na byon pa'i tshe/sku de bzheng nas dag dud de phyag byas/sangs rgya mya spran la 'ad na lo stong na rgya nan tu 'byon par lung brten to//)pa na lha me tog gtor/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi ka shi ga'i ra kyis blangs/dga' bo nyer dga' gnyis kyis sku khrus gsol ba dang / ko snang thong gsung ste / shar du dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /stor lha mi rnams kyi sbyin gnas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /nub tu nga ni 'jig rten na phul du phyin pa'o/ /'di ni nga'i skye ba'i mtha' ma ste skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba mthar dbyung ngo / /byang du sems can thams cad kyi nang na bla na med par byam//'og tu bdud dang bdud kyi sde gzhom par bya'o/ /sems can dmyal ba pa thamatshocad kyi sems can dmyal ba'i me gsod pa'i chos kyi sprin chen po'i char phab ste de dag bde bas tshim par bya'o/ /steng du sems can thams cad kyis gyen du lta bar 'gyur bar bya'o zhes gsungs te/ gom pa bdun bdun por ba dang pad ma byung ngo / /de'i tshe bkra shis pa'i ltas phyogs thams cad snang bas gang ba dang yul chen po bzhir rgyal phran bzhi btsas/ ya rabs kyi rigs lnga brgya/ grangasaldan ma la sogs pa brgyad brgya/ 'dun pa la sogs pa bran lnga brgya/ bsngagasaldan la sogs rte'u khri/ rte'u mo khri dang / ba lang khri yang btsas/ gling gi dbusasu byang chub kyi shing skyes/ skyed tshal lnga brgya dang / gter kha lnga brgya yang byung ste rgyal bu don thams cad grub par btags so/ /de nas rigs kyi lha mchod pa'i 122

bu ston cho 'byung /sar phyin te shākya mu cor smra ba rnams thub pa bzhin 'dug pas shākya thub par btags/shākya 'phel gyis phyag btsal ba'am lha rnam kyi bang phyag btsal bsalha'i lhar btags so//zhag bsnyen nas yum tshe'i dus byas te sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes so//de byang chub sems dpas nongs pa min gyi sras mngon par 'byung ba gzigs na yum snying 'gas par 'gyur ba tshe tshad mthar thug pa'i phyir ro//mdo gzhan nas ri bo kun 'dzin la gan pa'i drang sgrong nyen mongs med kyi tsha bo mes byin gyi bus shes te/mkhan po/'dir ni nyi ma thams cad dag/gcig car byung bar gyur tam ci//'di ltar ri ni phug bcas pa//'od gcig gis ni gsal bar gyur//zhes dris pas lan du/nyi ma'i 'od ni rgyun du rno//bu gcig snang ba'i 'od 'di dag/yan lag reg na 'od bsil bas//nges par thub pa de yi 'od/zhes so//de nas nyon mongs med ser skyar zhugs te/rgyalachen bdag cag 'dir mchis pa/khyed kyi sras ni mthong bar 'tshal 'jig rten gtso bo rnam 'dren pa//thub pa de ni blta bar 'tshal//zhes pa dang /mnal du song ba na'ang spyan gzigs pas smras pa/rigs dang ldan pa'i rta rnams ni//mtshan mo'i bzhi cha nyal ba ltar//dgos pa don gnyer rnams kyi gnyid//mig la yun ring mi gnas so//zhes so//mtshan mkhan dag 'khor los sgyur bar lung ston na cir 'gyur/sa bdag rtog pa po rnam blo 'byul te//rtsod pa'i dus su 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung //bsod nams mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni//nyes las rnam brgalasangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur//zhes so//gzhen nu skye rgya'i bdag mo la gtad sdo/pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma brgyad/nu ma

ba chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'gung tso bsdus/()snun pa brgyad/ rtsen ba'i ma ma brgyad/ dri ma 'phyi ba brgyad de so gnyis la gtad de bskyed bsrings so/ /de lta bu'i cho 'phrul de ri bo gangs can na gnasapa drang thong nag po zhes pa mngon shes lnga dang ldan pa zhig gis tshor nas snag tsha mes byin dang bcas pas rdzu 'phrul gyis ser skya'i grong khyer du phyin te de'i mtshan bltas pas de ji ltar 'gyur ba shes te ngo mtshar dang mya ngan skyes nasade'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing bskor ba byas nas gdong mchi ma dang bcas te lung bstan pa/ btsas gyur gzhon nu 'di yi mtshan bltas na/ /sum cu rtsaganyis mtshan gyis brgyan par mthong / /'di ni gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ khyim du gnas na 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lam/ khyim nas khyim med rab tu byung gyur na/ /'dren pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog par/ /'jig rten 'dir ni mngon rdzogs byang chub 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i gnas mchog sbubs su nub pa dang / /spyi gtsug 'gro ba kun gyis mi mthong bas/ khab tu'ang bzhugs mi 'gyur zhes lung yang bstan/ /zhes so/ /'o na khyod ngu ba'i rgyu ci/ lha bdag ni chos mdzod skyes bu mchog 'di dang / /phrad na don ma grub par 'chi 'gyur te//zhi ba ma thob rang gi nyes mthong nas/ /yid la gdung ba skyes nas ngu ba yin/ /zhes so/ /de nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas yar skyes nas shākya'i khye'u stong phrag bcu dang lhan cig tu yi ge'i slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen gyi grwar byon te/ kye slob dpon tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs pa drug cu rtsa bzhi las bdag gang la bslab/ slob dpon ngo mtshar te/ sems can dag pa ngo mtshar che/ /bstan bcos kun la bslab gyur kyang / /'jig rten 'jig rten rjes bsnyeg 124

bu ston chos 'byung /phyir/ /yi ge'i grwar ni byon par gyur/ /yi ge gang gi ming dag kyang / kha dog gis shes par ma gyur pa/ /de la 'di ni byang gyur kyang / /yi ge slob pa'i grwar byon to/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas gzhon nu nags rgyur song zhing 'dzam bu'i grib ma la bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar la mnyam par bzhag pas phyi rol pa'i drang srong rtsa 'phrul can lngas nam mkha' la 'gro ma nus par phyag dang bskor ba byas so/ /de'i tshe shing gzhan gyi grib ma 'phos kyang / de'i(sring ma)ma 'phos pas yab ngo mtshar te/ thub pa gang tshe bltams pa dang / /gang tshe 'od ldan bsam gtan mdzad/ /'dren pa 'di ltar lan gnyis su/ /mgon po khyod zhabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag byas so/ /de nas shākya rgan rabs dag gis/rgyal po la lha ltas mkhan dag gzhon nu 'dis khab bzhes na/ 'khor lo sgyur bar 'gyur ro zhes lung ston na gas mo blang bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal pos/ gzhon nu'i tshul dang mthun pa'i bu mo gang yod ltos shig de nas shākya lnga brgya tsam nged kyi bu mo mthun no zer ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu nyid la dris shig zer nas dris pas/ dgung bdun na lan bya'o gsungs te/ bsam pas/ 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis mtha' yas rig /'thab mo 'khon bcas mya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa / / 'jigs byed dug gi lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'i sodang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ /bdag ni bud med tshogasadang mdzes ma yin/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde bas zhi sems su/ /bdag ni mi smra nags tshal gnas par bya/ /yang des brtags nas/ thabs mkhas pa dang snying rjes/ 'dam dang lcag lcig khrod na pad+ma rnam par 'phel/ /mi rnams125

ba 'a 'od snang la /sa 'i chos thing tso bsdus/()gang ba'i nang na rgyal po mchod pa thob/ /gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mchog thob gyur pa/ /de tshe sems can bye ba phrag khrig 'chi med 'dul/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gang byung ba/ /de dag kun gyis btsun mo sras dang slas(bas)kyang bsten/ /'on kyang 'dod pas chags med bsam gtan bde ma nyams/ /bdag kyang de dag yon tan rjes su bslab par bya/ /snyam ste/ bud med kyi yon tan yi ge la bris te 'di 'dra ba bdag la gsol zhes pa dang / rgyal pos mdun na 'don la khyod song la gang na yon to 'di dag yod pa'i bu mo de 'on cig rgyal rigs bram ze'i bu mo dang / /rje'u rigasadamangs rigs de bzhin te/ /su la yon to 'di yod pa'i/ /bu mo de ni 'dir 'on cig /nga yi bu 'dis rigs dag dang / /rus la ngo mtshar 'dzin ma yin/ /yon tan bden pa chos kyi rnams/ /de la 'o de yi yid dga' 'o/ /zhes smras so//de nas bram ze des yul kun tu song song bas shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma mthong na yi ge de byin pa dang bzhin 'dzum ste/ bram ze yon tan 'di dag bdag la kun tshang gis/ /des pa'i gzugs can de ni bdag gi khyim thab 'os/ /gal te gzhen nu bzhes na phyi bgol ma mdzad gsungs/ /brgya la skye bo phul dang bzhugs par gyur kyang gda'/ /zhes smras so/ /de mdun na 'don gyis rgyal po la gsol bas rgyal po bud med 'di rdzun che bas yid ma ches te zhag bdun na bu mo thams cad 'dun khang du shog cig gzhon nus yid du 'ong ba'i bo byad dag sbyin no zhes smras te/ dgung bdun nas ga nusa'adun khang du song ba la bu mo rnams ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin yo byad dag byin 126

bu ston chos 'byung/zhing de dag gis kyang gzi brjed ma bzod par myur du song ngo / /de nas sa 'a tsho ma 'ongs pa dang yo byad zad de/ des 'dzu 5 dmul te bdag gis nongs pa ci bgyis nas bdag la rngan sdang mdzad/ gzhon nus rngan sdang min gyi khyed 'phyisapas lan no gsungs nas sor gdub srang brgya stong ri ba de byin no/ /de nas de song ba dang bya ra ba dag gis rgyal po la gzhen nu sa 'tsho ma la spyan chags te bka' mchid kyang cung zad bgyis so zhes gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos shākya lag na be con can la khyed kyi bu mo gzhon nu la byin cig ces pho nya btang bas/de na re/ gzhen nu pho brang na skyid de bar gcing rte rtsal mi shes na/bdag gi rigs chos la bu mo sgyu rtsal shes pa la gtong ba lags na sgyu rtsal mi shes pa la ji ltar sbyin zhes zer ro/ /de bzlas pasang la 'dis 'di dang lan gnyis(shākya tham cad kyi byag byed pa na/rgan pa gzhon pa la byag byed dgo pa ya zer na phyag byed ma ⑫/)su ngor bltas te brnyas so snyam ste rgyal po sems shing 'dug go / de nas gzhon nus de thos nas rgyal po la ci nongs/ 'di bka' mi stsal du mi rung ngo / /zhes smras pas rgyal pos don de bsnyad do/ /de nas gzhon pre rtsal gyis 'gran par khas blangs pas rgyal po mnyes te sgyu rtsal 'gran par dril bsgrags so/ /de nas zhag bdun na shākya gzhen nu lnga brgya tsam tshogs te sa 'tsho ma rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du bzhag ste ral gri'i thabs dang 'phong dang spyad kyi 'dzin stangs rgyal bas khyer cig ces dam bcas so/ /de nas thog mar lha sbyin 'ongasapa dang / glang po che khrid pa dang phrad de phrag dog dang nga rgyal gyis thal mo lan gcig bsnun te bsad do/ /de nas ma/7 bos grong khyer gyi sgo nas gud

ba chen 'od thal /sa 'i chos 2 nga gces bsdus/()du bor ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rkang pa'i mthe bos blangs nas ra gebadun 'obs bdun gyi phyir rgyang grags gcig tsam du 'phangs te gzhong chen por gyur nas glang po'i gzhong zhes grags so/ /de nas slob dpon kun gyi bshes gnyen dpang du btsugs te yi ge 'gran pas byang chub sems dpa' rgyalalo / /de nas shākya srid sgrub dpang du btsugs te brtsis pas byang chub semasadapa' rgyal te srid sgrub kyis kyang mi 'khrugs pa tshun chad las ma shes byang chub sems dpas snying po mchog gi bar shes so/ /de nas mchong pa dang / rkyal dang bang yang byang chub sems dpa' lhag go /de nas dga' bo kun dga' bo gnyisakyis stobs brgal ba'i phyir drung du phyin pas de'i lag pa reg ma thag 'gyeldolo / / de nas lhas sbyin gyis phyin pas byang chub sems dpa'i phyag g.yas pasabateg ste nam mkha' la bskor nas sal bor yang lus la mi gnod par bya so / /de nas shākya gzhon nu thams cad rub pa dang byang chub sems dpas regam thag 'gyel lo/ /de nas 'phong 'gran par byed de kun dga' bos rgyang grags gnyis/ lhas byin gyis rgyang grags bzhi/ mdzes dga' bos rgyang gragasadrug be con can gyis dpag tshad gcig gi pha rol tu lcags rnga re 'ben du btsugs pa la rang rang gi la phog gi de phan chad la ma phog go /byang chub sems dpas rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu lcags rnga gcig de'i drung du shing ta la bdun dngar/ de'i pha rol tu lcags kyi phag rgod gcig btsugs te lha kha pa nas/ mes seng ge za 'gram gyi gnam ru blangs te phyed krung du 'dug pasabardungs te mda' 1 / gcig shing ta la bdun/ phag rgod

bu ston chos na gung / rnams phug ste sa la zug nas mi snang bar gyur nas khron pa lta bu byung bas mda'i khron pa zhes grags so/ /de nas lag rtsis dang glang po che'i gnyar zhen nas sposasbyor gyi bar sgyur rtsal thams cad la byang chub sems dpa' lhag par gyur pa dang / be con can gyis bu mo phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong gi mchog tu sa 'tsho ma dbang bskur te de dag dang rtse dga' la longs su spyod do/ /de nas lha klu kha cigam la/ skyes bu dam pa 'di ni btsun mo'i 'khor du yun ring du bzhugs na/ snod du gyur pa'i sems can rnams med par 'gyur zhing de nas mngon par 'byung bar mi 'gyur grang snyam zhing / gus pa dang bcas pas mngon par 'byung zhing sangs rgyas nas chos gsungs snyam zhing 'dug go /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang / sil snyan gyi sgra lab/skul ba'i tshig bas su bcad pa/sdug bsngal brgyas gang sems can mthong nas ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabasadang gnas gyur cing / /phan byed mgon dang dpung gnyen gyur cig ces/ khyod kyis sngon ni smon lam de skad btab/ /dge ba dpa' bo sngon gyi spyod pa dang / /'gro phan bya zhes smon btab dran par byos/ /'di ni khyod kyi dus dang tshod yin gyi / / drang srong mchog rab khyim nas 'byung bar byos/ /zhes sogs kyis bskul zhing / btsun mo rnams kyi rol mo'i sgra las kyang sngon gyi skyes rabs dag gleng ste/srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'chi me rab 'bar 'di ni mgon med pa/ /srid las 'byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsu/ 2/ rtag ston da'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro

ba ga 'od thag 'i rdzong gce bsdus/()ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i slog 'dra ste ༈ / ri gzar 'bab chu lta bur myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes sogs nas/ sngon gyi spyod de rjes su dran gyis la/ /gti mug ma rig kun pas bsgribs pa yi/ /'gro la shes rab dam pa 'od bzang ba/ /chos mig dri med nyon mongs med pa byin/ /zhes pa'i sgra thos nas byang chub sems dpa' yang rgyags pa'i sems spangs te byang chub tu sems gtad do/ /lha'i bu 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kyang /'chi 'pho ba ni shin tu bstan/ /skyes bu seng ges tshe yang bstan/ /btsun mo'i 'khor kyang bstan par mdzad/ khyod kyis 'jig rten rjes mthun mdzad/ /'jig rten chos ni rjes thob pas/ /lha mi mang po yongs smin mdzad/ /mngon par 'byung ba'i blo dgongs pa'i/ /de yi dus la deng babs so/ /zhes sogs nas/dbyangs snyan cing ni dbyangs 'jam pa/ /mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan dgongs/ /yang dag de bzhin ma nor bar/ /rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs bsgrag tu gsol/ /zhes bskul lo/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i rmi lam du byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba rmis te nyug rum la byang chub sems dpa' 'dug gam dris pas 'dug zer ro/ /de nas rgyal pos byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba'i ltas so snyam ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chags par bya ba'i phyir dpyid bsil/dbyar ran/ dgun dro ba'i khang bzangs gsum/ re re'ang grub skas mi lnga brgya lnga brgyas 'dzugs shing 'bebs pa'i tshe gzhon nu sus kyang ma tshor bar mngon par 'byung du 'ong ngo zhes pa'i sgra dpag tshad phyed du byung ngo / /ltas mkhan kun gyis kyang bkra shis kyi chab sgo nas mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bstan 130

bu ston chos 'byung /no / / de nas rgyal pos sgo 'phar chen po sgra dpag tshad phyed du grags pa mi lnga brgya lnga brgyas 'byed cing gcod pa byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpasa'adun pa la skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba'i shing rta sbyor cig 'dun pas kyang rgyal po la don de gsol te/ rgyal pos gzhon nu'i yid du mi 'ong ba mi mthong bar byas te nyams dga' bar byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shar sgo nasathon pa dang / nyid kyi mthus lhas sprul pa'i rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa gzigs te/ 'dun pa la/ kha lo bsgyur ba mi rid nyam chung zhing / sha khrag skam la rgyus lngags nyi tshes dkris/ /mgo dkar so rnal lus ni rab bskams la/ /'khar ba brten cing mi bde 'byor 'gro su/ /des smra pa/ lha gcig mi 'di rga ba'i zil gyis non/ /dbang po nyams shing sdug bsngal brtson stobs nyams/ /gnyen gyi skye bos brnyas shing mgon med gyur/ /don bgyid mi nus nags khrod shing ltar bor/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di yi chos 'di rigs kyi yin nam 'on tam ci/ /'gro ba 'di kun la yang 'di srid de smyos shig /tshig 'di yang dag ji bzhin myur du smos shig dang / /thos nas de bzhin don la 'dir ni tshul bzhin bsam/ /des smras pa/ lha 'di rigs chos ma yin yul 'khor chos ma lags/ /skye bo kun gyi dar la bab pa rga bas 'joms/ khyed kyi yab dang yum dang nye du gnyen tshogs kyang / /rga las ma thar 'bros pa'i thabs ni gzhan ma mchis/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba byis pa'i skye bo mi mkhas pa'i/ /blo ngan gzhen pas rgyags shing myos pas rgas ma mthong / /nga ni slar 'gro nga yi shing rta myur du sku//1 /nga yang rga la gnas pa rtse dgas ci

'tsheg 'od snang la /ga 'i chos nga ge bsdus/()zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs nas nang du log go /yang lho sgor thon pas na ba gzigs te smras pa/ kha lo skur ba mi rtsub lus kyi mdog ngan la/ /dbang po thams cad nyams shing dbugs dbyung rab tu dka'/ /yan lag kun bskamasalto bas dkrugs shing nyam thag gyur/ /rang gi gcin rtug smad pa'i gnas na 'dug 'di su/ /des smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di shin tu nad kyis btab pa ste/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa nye bar mchis pas 'gum la thug /nad med gzi brdzid ma mchis stobs kyang rnam par nyams/ /mgon dang skyabs dang gling dang dpung gnyen ma ma mis lags/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ nad med pa yang rmi lam na ni rtse dang mtshungs/ /nad kyis 'jigs pa 'di lta shin tu mi bzad pa/ /skyes bu mkhas pas nad 'di mthong na ji lta bur/ /rtse la dga' dang sdug pa'i 'du shes bskyed par 'gyur/ /yang nub tu shi ba gzigs te smras pa/ kha lo sgyur ba mi 'di khyogs la blangs nas ni/ /'di dag skra bshig mgo la sa yis 'thor byed cing / /sna tshogasang ga gi tshig ni brjod la brang brdung bas/ /kun nasabaskor ba byas te 'khyer ba su zhig yin/ /des smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di 'dzam bu'i gling du gum pa ste/ /slan chad pha ma mchis brang bu rnams mthong mi 'gyur/ /longs spyod khyim dang mdza' gnyen tshogs rnams spangs nas ni/ /'jig rten pha rol mchis te slan chad gnyen mi mthong / /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ rga bas gnod par 'gyur ba'i gzhon pa cir mi rung / /sna tshogs nad kyis gnod 'gyur nad med cir mi rung / /ring du mi gnas gson pa mkhas la cir mi rung / /dga' la chags pa skyes bu mkhas la cir mi rung / /gal te rga med na 132

bu ston cho 'byung /med 'chi ba med gyur kyang / /'on kyang phung po lnga 'dzin sdug bsngal che yin na/ /rga na 'chi ba rtag tu 'brang ba smos ci dgos/ /legs par slar ldog rab tu thar par bya bar bsam/ /yang byang sgor dge slong gzigs te smras pa/ kha lo snar ba skyes bu sems zhi rab zhi zhing / /mig phab 'gro la gnya' shing gang tsam lta byed cing / /ngur smig gos rgyan shin tu rab tu zhi bar spyod/ /lhung bzed thogs nasami rgod ma khengs su zhig yin/ /des smras pa/ lha gcig mi 'di dge slong zhesani bgyi ba lags/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba spangs shing shin tu dul bar spyod/ /bdag nyid zhi ba 'tshol zhing rab tu byung bar gyur/ /'dod chags zhe sdang bral bar bsod snyoms spyod cing rgyu/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di ni dge bar legs smras nga yang 'dod pa ste/ /rab tu byung ba mkhas pa rnams kyis rtag tu bsngags/ /de ni bdag la phan zhing sems can gzhan la'ang phan/ /'tsho ba bde zhing nyams mthun 'chi med 'bras bur 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub semasadapa' nang du zhugs so/ /rgyal pos kyang de dag mthong thos pas bsrung ba'i phyir ra ba dang 'obs dang sgo brtan po bzugs/ grong khyer gyi bzhi mdor srung ba'i dpung bzhag btsun mo rnams kyang glu dbyangs dang rtse dga' sbyor du bcug go / de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'byung ba'i ltas su bya skad mi 'byin/pad ma rnying / shing la me tog mi 'chags/ gling bu dang pi wang rgyud chad/rdza rnga la sogs brdungs kyang sgra med par gyur pas rgyal po yang sems khong du chud cing 'dun go/sa 'tsho ma yang rmi lam du sa g.yos pa la sogs pa rmis so//byang chub sems dpa'i rmi lam du rka sdug gis rgya mtsho dkrugs pa dang / sa

brtse chen 'od thal/skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()mal char gyur/ ri rab sngas su bcug 'od kyis mun pa bsal salasagadugs shig byung bas 'jig rten gsum khyab/ srog chags dkar nag bzhi dang bya kha dog bzhi pa 'ongs nas kha dog gcig tu gyur pa dang / ngan skyug gi ri la 'dzegs kyang ma gos pa dang / chus khyer ba brtan pa dang / nad pa gsos pa dang / ri rab kyi ngos la seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa la lha rnams kyi phyag 'tshal ba rmis so/ /de nas byang chus sems dpas phas ma gnang bar rab tu 'byung bar mi rigs so snyam ste pha'i drung du song ste smras pa/ bdag mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab kyi gegs dang mi dgyes pa ma mdzad cig rgyal pos/ khyod ci 'dod pa'i mchog sbyin gyi khab tu bzhugs shig byang chub sems dpa smras pa/rga na 'chi rgud bzhi med pa stsol cig des smras pa/ de sbyin pa'i mas med do/ /gzhan slongs shig byang chub sems dpa' smras pa/ rga na 'chi ba'i 'jigs dang rgud par mi 'gyur ba/ /lha gcig gal te mchog bzhi 'di dag mi stsol na/ /gzhan yang mchog cig gsol gyi rgyal po gsan du gsol/ /'di nas shi 'phosanying mtshams sbyor bar mi 'gyur mdzod/ /de nas rgyal pos khyed kyis bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig ces smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rang gi gnas su song ngo / /rgyal pos kyang don de shākya rnams la bsnyad pas srung ngo zhes bgros te/ sgo bzhi re rer shākya gzhen nu lnga brgya re re'ang shing rta lnga brgya/ shing rta re re'ang dpung bu chung lnga brgya dang bcas pa bkod do/ shwakya rgan rabs rnams lam gyi bzhi mdo dang gsum mdor gcod do/ /rgyal po'ang mel rde spyad do/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin rnams dang

bu ston cho 'byung / 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya rnams kyang do nub byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 'byung gi mchod pa'i las la brtson no/ /rgyal po sde bzhi yang chibs pa 'degasapar sems so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyang mchod pa'i la byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi smon lam bzhi mngon du byed do/ /lha'i bu chos spyod la sogs pas btsun mo'i 'khor mi sdug par bsgyur ba la gzigs pas dur khrod kyi 'du shes bskyed de/ e ma skye rgu dag ni sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /srin mo'i tshogs la dga' ba ji ltar rnyed/ /'dod pa'i yon tan yon min yon tan 'dzin/ /gti mug mun pas rab bsgribs blo grosang na/ /dper na bya ni bya rgyar chud pa bzhin//nam yang 'byung ba rnyed par 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brtags nas mi sdug par bsgoms so/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' khang bzang gi steng du song ste sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal te bltas pas/ brgya byin dang rgyal po sde bzhi dang nyi zla gnyis kyang phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug par mthong ngo / /skar ma rgyal yang shar bar mthong nas 'dun pa la smras pa/ nga yi bkra shis 'di ni don kun grub/ /don nub gdon mi za bar don grub kyi/ /'dun pa phyi bgol mi byed la gor du/ /rta rgyal rgyan gyis brgyan pa nga la byin/ /des smras pa/ gang du bzhud/ smras pa/ mngon par 'byung ba'o/ /de nas 'dun pas lan mang du bzlog kyang 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs mang du gsungs te ma bzlog pa dang / lha'i bu zhi ba'i blo gros dang brtse ba bkod pasaser skya ba rnams gnyid log cig sgra mi grags par byas so/ /byang chub semasadapas kyang 'dun pa la rta byin cig ces smras so/ /de'i tshe lha'i dbang po dang 135

ba chen 'od thags 'i chos 'byung gce4bsdus/()rgyal chen bzhi yang ser skyar lhags so/ /'dun pas dus ma lags so zhes smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ sems can rnams kyi don ni 'tshor ba nas/ /byang chub rga shi med pa'i gnas thob nas/ /'gro ba sgrol zhesang yisayun ring na/ /smon lam btab pa de yi dus la bab/ zhes smras pa dang / lha'i bu yang dag skul pos bskul ba/ stobs dang brtson 'grus 'phags pa myur du bzhengs/ /sdug bsngal nyen pa'i sems can thams cad sgrol/ /da ni mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ khes bskul lo/ /de nas brgya byin gyis bkra shi kyi sgo phye/ 'dun pas rta bsngags ldan brgyan te phul ba la chibs te rgyal chen bzhis btegs nas nam mkha' la byon te tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis kyisalam bstan/ 'od kyis mun pa bsal/ mchod pa dang rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas te gyad kyi yul 'das te mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du phyin pa dang rta dang rgyan 'dun pa la byin te slar ldog cing der mchod rten brtsigs pas 'dun pa slar log pa'i mchod rten zer ro/ /de nas mchod rten rnam dag gi rtsar nyid kyi gtsug phud bcad pa lha rnams kyis gdan drangs te mchod rten brtsigs pasagatsug phud kyi mchod rten zhes zer ro/ /de nas rab tu byung ba'i tshul dang ka shi ga'i gos mi mthun pas rab byung gi tshul dang mthun pa'i gos shig rnyed na rung snyam pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha rngon pa'i gzugs su sprul pas gos ngur smig phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang ka shi rka'i gos rnams de la byin no//des kyang lag pa gnyis das blangs te spyi bor bzhag nas mchod pa'i phyir lha'i 'jig rten du song ngo / /de 'dun pas mthong nas mchod rten brtsigs pa ngur 136

bu ston rdzoga'agu pa/ smig blangs pa'i mchod rten zer ro/ /de'i tshe don grub rab tu byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra 'og min gyi bar du grag go /'dun pas kyang rta dang rgyan khyer te rgyal po dang btsun mo'i 'khor gyi mya ngan bsal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas gtsug phud bcad/ gos ngur smig bgos te rab tu byung nas bram ze rigs ldan la sogs pa'i gnas su song nas yangs pa can du byon pa dang / sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur slob ma sum brgya la ci yang med pa'i skye mched ston pa de'i drung du phyin te slob mar khas blangs te bslabs pas ci yang med pa'i sems mngon du gyur te ring 'phur la khyod kyis chos 'di tsam zhig khong du chud dam/ smras pa/ de bzhin no/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ de kho pos kyang khong du chud do/ /smra ba'i pa/ nga za/gang sheb(pa khyed kyis shes/ khyed kyi gang shes pa nga bas shes sna kyi gnyis gas slob ma'i tshogs la bstan no zer ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas chos 'dis nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur gyi de bas lhag pa zhig btsal lo snyam ste rim gyis ma ga dhar song ste ri skya bor bzhugs so/ /de nas chu dron can gyi sgo nas rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du zhugs so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer pa rnams dang / rgyal po gzugs can snying po shin tu dad de rgyal srid kyi shas phul ba yang ma bzhes so/ /de nas rings byed kyi bu lhag spyod slob ma bdun brgya la srid rtse'i sems ston pa mthong nas/ bdag 'di lta bu'i brtul zhugs dang dka' thub brtsams nas bdag khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing zag bcas kyi bsam gtan sun dbyung ngo snyam ste/ de'i slob mar khas blangs nas myur du srid rtse'i sems khong du chud 137

ba cheg 'og ngag 'i chos sang sa bsdus/()nas sngar bzhin brjod nas/ /'di ni myang 'das su 'gyur ba ma yin no zhesasun phyung ste song ngo / /de'i tshe lnga sde yang byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'brangs te rim gyis ri ga ya'i rtse mor sngar ma shes pa'i dpe gsum mngon du gyur te/ chu bo yi ra3 na'i 'gram du phyin nas/ bdag gis snyigs ma lnga'i dus dman pa la mos pas/brtul zhugasang na pas dag par 'dzin pa sun dbyung ba'i phyir brtul zhugs dang dka' thub brtsam mo snyam ste/ lo drug tu mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhag ste til 'bru gcig dang rgya shug 'bru gcig dang 'bras 'byu gcig gisalo drug tu dka' ba spyad de dbugs rgyu ba bcad de bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu kha cig gis/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la gzhen nu shi'o zhes brjod pas lha mo 'ongs pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i lus bskams pa dang shi ba dang 'dra ba mthong nas bltams ma thag tu nga'i skye ba'i mtha' ma 'di'o zhes pa'i dam bca' yang ma rdzogs/ drang srong nag po'i lung bstan yang mi bden no zhes smre sngags 'don pa la byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ nyi zla skar tshogs sa la lhung 'gyur srid/ /so so skye bo yin yang nga mi 'dri/ /de phyir 'di la mya ga khyod ma byed/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub sangs rgyas mthong / /zhes smras pas/ dga' ste gnas su song ngo / / grong gi ba lang rdzi la sogs pas kyang rna bar shing bal bcug nas snar 'byin pa la sogs byed do/ /bdud kyang srog gces par gyis shig ces pa la sogs pa snyan par smras shing glags btsal yang ma rnyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems 1 3 /ka' thub kyis grol bar 'dzin pa

bu ston cho 'byung / dgag pa'i phyir zas rags pa thos la byang chub snying por 'gro'o snyam ste/ zagarags pa za'o zhes brjod pas lnga sde ma dad nas lha rā ṇa snyir song ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' legs skyes ma'i bran mo grum ma zhes pa'i ro gso ras kyis dkris pa de blangs te lhas lag pa brdabs pa'i rdzing du brgya byin gyis bzhag pa'i rdo leb la bkrus so/ /de ngal te rdzing nas 'byung snyam pa la bdud kyis gad pa mthon por sprul pa la shing gi lha mos yal ga smad pa la 'jus te byung nas shing sgrub byed kyi drung du phyag dar khrod kyi snam sbyar bsgrubs shing gnasasna ma'i lhas kyang gos ngur smig phul ba bzhes te spyod yul gyi grong du zhugs sa / / de nas lhas sbran te legs skyes mas ba stong gi 'o ma lan bdun du nying khur byas pa dang / 'bras dang 'bru gsar pa yang blugs te btsos pas de'i nang du dpal be'u la sogs pa'i bkra shis pa dag snang bas dga' ste mtshan mkhan gyis kyang bdud rtsi thob par lung bstan no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mgron du bos nas 'o thug sbrang rtsi can gyis gser snod bkang ste phul ba bzhes nas yi ra3 na'i 'gram du song ste zas dang chos gos bzhag nas khrus mdzad pas lhas mchod cing khrus chu lhas khyer la skra dang ag tshom legs skyes mas khyer te chu de'i klu mos phul ba'i seng khri la bzhugs te 'o thug gsol nas gser snod chur bor ba klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos khyer ba la brgya byin gyis blangs nas sum cu rtsa gsum du khyer nas lo re bzhin snod kyi dus ston byed do/ /byang chub sems dpas khrus byas zas zos pas lus mthu dang ldan paba'i139

'tshe na 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bdud las rgyal ba'i phyir byang chub kyi shing drung du skyes bu chen po'i stobs kyi chas so/ /rlung dang char sprin gyis lam phyags shing chag chag gdab/ ri dang shi thams cad dang bu chung btsas ma thag thams cad kyang mgo de phyogs su ston no//stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa dbang bsgyur gyis 'khor la byang chub sem dpa' do nub byang chub snying por 'gro yi mchod pa'i las gyis shig ces bsgo nas/ mchod pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul lo/ /byang chub sem dpas sdod baX ste /na mongs dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing snod dag par sbyangs teklu nag ṭ+wāṃ kā ༵ ༷kā da gyi/ /g.yas na (tshong bkra shis rtswa brnga ba la/ bkra shisartswani nga la myur du byin/ /de ring nga la rtogi don chen 'gyur/ /dpung dang bcasapa'i bdud ni bcom nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi bar reg par 'gyur/ /zhesagasungs pa dang / des kyang dz+nyā sngo ljang yid du 'ong ba phul te khyer nas byang chub shing la lan gsum bskor te rtswa rtse mo nang du bstan nas rtsa ba phyir bstan pa la shar phyogs su bltas te 'dug nas lus drang por bsrang dran pa mngon du bzhag nas/ stan 'dir bdag gi lus ni bskams kyang rung / /pags pa rus pa sha rnams zhig kyang rung / /bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob par/ /stan 'di las ni lus bskyod mi bya'o/ /zhes yid dam brtan por byas so/ /de'i tshe lta rnams byang chub sems dpa' bsrung ba'i phyir phyogs bcur 'khod do/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang byang chub sems dpa' skul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od bkye ste zhing dpag med snang bar byas nas byang chub sems dpa' mang po bsdus nas 140

me pa byed do bu ston phyo/ de nas bdud la ma sbran par 'tshang rgya bar mi rigs so snyam ste smin mtshams nas bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'joms par byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye bas bdud kyi gnas thams cad snang zhing g.yos/ mog mog por byas te/ sems can shin tu dag pa bskal mang spyod spyad pa/ /zas gtsang sras po rgyal srid dag ni rab spangs te/ /phan byed de ni bdud rtsi mngon par 'dod pas byung / /byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyi de ring sgrim par gyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i sgra byung zhing / bdud sdig can la'ang rang gnas mun pas khyab pa la sogs pa'i rmi lam rdzoganyis rmis te/ rang gi 'khor la sbran pa dang / bu ded dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma bzlog par/ /gnod sbyin grul bum lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs/ /srin po yi dwags sha za'i gzugs dang bcas/ /'jigs byed mi sdug drag gzugs ji snyed pa/ /thams cad sgyu yis der ni sprul pa byas/ /zhesapa la sogs pa rnam 'gyur du ma mthong yang /shākya'i sras po chos rnams rten 'byung ba/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i semasadang rab tu ldan/ /dpung bcas g.yo sgyu mthong yang myos pa med/ /de nas bdud kyi g.yas nas byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba rnams kyis bzlogagayon nas mi dga' ba rnams kyis bskul te mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phangs pas me tog tu gyur to/ /de nas bdud kyis khyod kyis bsod nams de tsam gyis thar pa ga la thob ces smras pa dang / byang chub se/4 1 / khyod kyis gtan pa med pa'i

gcag 'od snang ga skya'i chos5nga tso bsdus/()mchod sbyin gcig byas pas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa yin/ ngas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin du ma byas so zhes brjod pa dang / bdud kyis sngon chad kho bos mchod sbyin kha na ma tho med/ /gtan pa med par byas pa khyod 'diradapang du yod/ khyod la 'dir ni dpang po gang yang yod min pas/ /smras kyangaphan pa ci yod khyod ni pham par gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ sa 'di nga yi dpang yin no gsungs te/ phyag g.yas pa sal brdabs te/ sa 'di 'gre(ba kun gyi gnas yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon med/ /'di nibadag gi dpang ste bdag rdzun med/ /'di la khyod ni bdag gi dpang byos shig/ces gsungs pas sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa'i gseb nas sa'i lha mo brtan malus phyed phyung nas thal mo sbyar te/ skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no/ khyod kyis ji skad smras pa de bzhin te 'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo/ /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi dpang du gyur pa lags so zhesasmras te mi snang bar gyur to/ /g.yon can dpung bcas sa sgra de thos nas/ /nags su seng gis sgra bsgrags was thos dang / /bya rog rdo 'phangs mod la byer ba bzhin/ /dngangs ga snying gas thams cad rab tu byer/ /de nas sdig can yid ma bde nas/ rang gi bu mo rnams sad du btang ste/ de dag gis kyang bzhin phyed 'gebs pa la sogs pa g.yo sgyu so gnyis bstan kyang bskur ma tshugs pasakhasdig can yid mi dga'o/ /de'i tshe shing gi lha mo dpal ldan la sogs brgyad kyis byang chub sems dpa' la/ khyod ni dgung zla yar gyi ngo ltar mdzes pa'o/ /zhes sogs bcu drug gis bstod do/ /gnas gtsang ma'i lhas/ bdud sdig can 142

bu ston chos 'byung /khyod ni glang rgan 'dam du bying ba ltar nyam chung ba'o zhes sogs bcu drug gi smad cing / lha rnams kyis bcu drug gis bzlog kyang ma bzlog par mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phangs shing cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan kyang glags ma rnyed cing bdud dpung mi gzugs pa yang 'thor te zhag bdun du ma phrad do/ /bdud mang posabyang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas bsam gtan bzhi bskyed/ rig pa gsum bskyed nas nam gyi cha smad skya rengs 'char kha rnga brdung ba'i tshod tsam na rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang bden bzhi shes nas skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas shing ta la bdun tsam du 'phags te lam gyi rgyud ni chad do zhes pa la sogs pa ched du brjod pa brjod do/ /lha rnams kyis kyang me tog pus mo nub tsam gtor te mchod do/ /'jig rten snang bar byas/ sa g.yos/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasakyis chos kyi dga' ba bskur phyag brkyang te/ bdag cag ji ltar byang chub thob ltar khyod sangs rgyas/ /dper na mar dang mar gyi nying khu mas 'dra bzhin/ /zhes gsungs shing lha'i bu mo rnams kyis bstod do/ /ston pas kyang / bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan las 'das ni ba bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ khes ched du brjod do/ /lha rnams kyis rgya cher bstod nas skyil krung ma bshig par zhag bdun du byang chub shing la gzigs so/ /zhag bdun pa gnyis pa la stong gsum stong gsum rgyang ring du 'chag go /gas/ pa la ngas 'dir sdug bsngal mthar

'tsheg 'od snang la /mo 'i chos nga ges ba sa/()phyung zhes byang chub kyi snying po la spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs so/ /bzhi pa dzoshar nub kyi bar du rgyang mi ring bar 'chag go /de nas bdud sdig can gyi ca ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab kyang gdul bya'i don byas zin gyi bar du mi 'da' bar zhal gyis bzhes te mya ngan du gyur cing bu mo dga' ma la sog pa'ang drung du song ba na rgan mor mdzad do/ /zhag bdun pa lnga pa la yul bsgyuchen po byung ste klu btang bzung gi gnas na bzhugs so/ /drug pa la shing n+ya gro snyaskyong du bzhud te kun tu rgyu rnams la/ chos thos pa dang mthong ba dang / /dbegapar dga' ba bde ba yin/ /srog chags 'byung po rnams la bsdams/ /gnodapa mi byed 'jig rten bde/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /bdun pa la shing sgrol rgyu'i drung du bzhugs te/ tshong pa ga gon dang bzang pos sbrang rtsi dang skyo ma dang bu ram shing bdus pa dag phul ba dang / lagapas blangs na ma legs/ don gyi sangs rgyas kyis snod ji lta bur bzhes snyamapa dang / rgyal chen bzhis gser la sogs pa'i lhung bzed phul ba ma bzhesapas rnam sras la rngon pa'i rigs kyi lhas byin pa'i rdo'i lhung bzed bzhi yod dzo re res bzung ste me rtag gis bkang ste phul bas/ phyag brkyangs te/ bde b.ragashegs la lhung bzed phul cig dang / khyod ni theg pa mchog gi snod du 'gyur//nga 'dra dag la lhung bzed phul ba ni/ /dran dang blo gros nam yang nyamasami 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te bzhes nas gcig tu byin gyis brlabs te der blangs so/ /de nas ga gon dang bzang pos ba stong gi 'o ma'i nying khu'i spris ma bzhams te rin po che'i gzheng par blug ste phul ba gsol te gzhong pa bor ba 144

bu ston cho 'byung /tshangs pas khyer ro/ / ston pas kyang / lha yi bkra shis don grub cing / /phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des/ khyed kyi don rnams 'grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun par shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i shis pa brjod de sbrang rtsi 'byung ba zhes pa'i rgyal bar lung bstan no/ /de nas ston pa thugs las chung ngur bzhugs te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi'i chos ni bdag gis thob par gyur/ /bdag gis bstan kyang gzhan gyis mi shes te/ /mi smra nags 'dabs gnas par bya ba snyam/ /zhes dgongs shing / 'jig rten kun la snying rje mtha' yasang / /gzhan gyis gsol ba btab la nga mi sdod//skye bo 'di dag tshangs la dad pa ste//de yisagasol ba btab na 'khor lo bskor/ /snyam ste 'od bkye bas stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis shes nas grogs sbran te tshangs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ ye shes chen po mchog gi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas ni/ /phyogs bcu dag tu 'od zer rnam par bkye mdzad de/ /ye shes zer gyis mi yi pad ma kha 'byed pa/ /smra ba'i nyi ma de ring ci slad btang snyoms bzhugs/ /zhes pa la sogs pas bskul bas cang mi gsung bas gnang ste song ngo / /ston pa yang thugs las chung ba la gzhol ba dang / des brgya byin sbran te brgya byin gyis/ zla ba nya ba gza' las thar pa ltar/ khyed kyi thugs ni rnam par grol ba lags/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhengs su gsol/ /'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od dbyung gsol/ /zhes 145
