bu ston chos 'byung /byas chos zhus 'gyur mang po mdzad de khyad par du yo ga rnams kun dga' snying po'i 'grel pa dang bstun nas dag par bcos te dbang bka' dang bshad sgrub kyi man ngag rgya cher spel lo/ jo bo rje rim gyis dbus su byon te slob ma khu rngog 'brom gsum la gdams pa dang chos mang po gnang ste/ khyad par 'brom ('bros gyi sogs za gsum ni/bu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/po to ba rin chen gsal/spyan mnga' ba tshul khrim 'bar te/phu chung pa slob ma ma bsten/po to ba la slob ma nyi stong brgyad brgya tsam 'dus/rwa smreng gdan gso gsum mdzad/ga chen brgyad byung ba la mi tsā ras lding mob/snang gresalha pa gnyis/gnyal na glang gnyis rdzoganyis su grag te gnyal ba chos 'bar dang bun po lha rje gnyis/do yon lha r+sā bu ca thodang /rog dmar ser ba gnyis/dbur stod na zhang shar ba yon tan rgya mtsho/glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge gnyis la nyi sgro zung gcig tu grags/glang thang pa'i slob ma sha bo nga pa/glang thang zhang /dge bzhes gnyan no/ shar ba'i slob ma mar kha ye shes rdo rje gdung rusabya/)la bka' gdams kyi chos lugs gnang ste dar bar mdzad do/ /(rwa sgrong bto/)lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po'ang mnga' ris su klu skar rgyal btul/ sngags log spyod pa rnams chos kyis sun phyung ste nye rgyu'i sgrub pa mdzad de mkha' spyod du gshegs zhes grags so/ /de'i lo chung grags ra shes rab kyis kyang bde mchog dang phag mo dang tshad ma la sogs pa bsgyur zhing mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /bal lo chung 'gar chos bzang gis kyang lo tswa'i chos drug ces grags pa rnams bsgyur nas rtse lngar gshegs so/ /jo bo rje la lo tsā ba sngar gyi de dag dang shākya 'od dang yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug dang / dge ba'i blo gros la sogs pas chos mang po bskur te gtan la phab pa'o/ /lha zhi 301

nga rma chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ba 'od kyis kyang dpal mchog dang zhi ba 'tsho'i tshad ma la sogs pa bsgyur ro / / lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su paṇ+ḍita 'e ti dang / phra la ring ba bya ba gnyis bal bo pad ma ru rtse bya bas gdan drangs 'ongs pas lo tsā ba bal por pho log gis shi ste paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pos bod skad mi shes pas dbus gtsang na mar 'khyams te/ smyo tis rta nag tu lug dzimadzad/ phyis dpyal rtse rtsa ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sman lung du spyan drangs te chos zhus/ khams su byon nas 'dan klong thang du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa btsugs/ phyis bod skad mkhas par gyur te gdan bzhi dang 'jam dpal gsal ldan gyi skor dang sngags don rnam gzigs la sogs pa rang 'gyur mang po mdzad/ phyisaling chu gser khang du byon te smra sgo brtsams so/ /paṇ+ḍita phra la ring bas rong pa chos bzang la grong 'jug byas pas rong pas chos mang po rdol shes su byung ba yin no/ /mnga' bdag 'od ldes kyang su n+ya shrī spyan drangs so/ /de'i sras rtse ldes kyang kha che dz+nyā na shrī spyan drangs te khyung po chos brtson gyis lo tsā byas nas rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dang / spyong rgyud dang / tshad ma rnam nges dang / de'i ṭīka khong nyid kyis mdzad pa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /gzhan yang tsan+d+ra rā hu la spyan drangs te lo tsā ba ting nge 'dzin bzang pos tshad ma kun las btus pa la sogs pa bsgyur ro / / rtse ldes rngog blo ldan kha cher brdzangs te gzhan phan bzang po dang skal ldan rgyal po la tshad ma bslabs/ bram ze sad dza na dang / go mi 'chi med la sogasapa la byams chos bslabs/ dbang sdes yon bdag byas te tshad ma rgyan la sogs pa bsgyur/ khri bkra shis dbang phyug nam mkha' btsan gyis 302

bu ston chos2gung/ kyang 'gyur gyi yon bdag byas/ kha cher lo bcu bdun bzhugs/ bod du bcu bsnyen phrag gnyis bzhugs/ paṇ+ḍi gta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / a tu ༅ dā sha dang / su ma ti girti dang / a ma ra tsan+d+ra dang / gzhon nu bum pa la sogasapa'i lo tsā mdzad de chos mang po bsgyur/ gsang phu ni'u thog la sogs par bshad pa mdzad de rgyan chos mchog phar phyin spyod 'jug la sogs pa dar bar mdzad de shin tu bka' drin che'o/ /pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis kyang kha cher lo nyi shu rtsa gsum sbyangs te paṇ+ḍi ta ka na ka warma spyan drangs te dbu ma'i skor rnams bsgyur cing bshad pas slob ma pa tshab kyi bu bzhi la sogs pa byung ngo / /'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis kyang paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra spyan drangs te gser srang lnga brgya phul te/ kye rdo rje gur sa ṭa dang ra li bzhi dang a ra li la sogs pa ma rgyud kyi sgrub skor man ngag dang bcas pa bsgyur ro/ /'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis kyang rgya gar du lan gsum du byon paṇ+ḍi ta grub pa brnyes pa bdun cu don gnyis la chos zhus/ khyad par du zhi ba bzang po dang sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po la sogs pa bsten te gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro/gdan bzhi/ ma hā mā stu/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis dus 'khor/ sangs rgya thod pa/rdo rje bdud rtsi/ bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /lto brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis kyang rgya gar du lan gsum du byon/ bla ma nā ro mi tri zhi ba bzang po pham mthing pa la sogs pa bsten nas gsang 'dus bde mchog kye rdo rje ma hā mā wā gdan bzhi la sogs pa'i man ngag mang po zhus te sgrub rgyud kyi slob ma shin tu dar ro/ /(mi 303

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()la ras chen dang rmad bang nge dang mes tshon po dang rngog chos rdor sogs byung /mi la ra pa mched brgyad dang dwag po bsod nam rin chen sog byung ngo / /)zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyis paṇ+ḍita kha che dgon pa ba dang / te dza de ba dang / pa ra hi ta bha dra la sogs pa brten nas yo ga dang gtsug tor dang phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang gi skor dang rnam thos sras dang / spyod 'jug gi 'grel chen dang bde mchog gi skor la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /gnyan dar ma grags kyis rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs te paṇ+ḍita ma ti bsnyen/ paṇ+ḍita pu rnye shrī gdan drangs te spyod 'jug gi 'grel chen dang sgrol ma dang chos skyong la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ khye'u gad pa 'khor lo grags dang / spong zho gsal ba grags dang / rtsong ga mi nyag rtsa mi (rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po mdzad zer/)sangs rgyas(grags rnam bkyis paṇ+ḍi gta abh+ya ka ra gusta bsten nas dus 'khor phreng ba skor gsum/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ man ngag snye ma la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /kre bo lo tsā ba shes rab dpal gyis kyang paṇ+ḍita de bsnyen nas gnad kyi zla zer la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /ba ri rin chen grags kyis paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje spyan drangs te don zhags dang srung ba lnga dang /rnam rgyal rnam 'joms kyi skor dang bde mchog gi skor dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis kyang mtshan brjod dang sgrol ma'i skor dang dbu ma 'jug pa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /de'i slob ma mal gyo blo gros grags pas bde mchog dang sgrol ma nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs rnams bsgyur ro/ /'bro shes rab grags kyis kha cher byon te paṇ+ḍita zla ba mgon po spyan drangs te dus 'khor cha lag rgyas pa dang ci/ rdo rje snying 'grel/304

bu ston chos 'byung /phyag rdor stod 'grel la sogs pa bskur ro/ /ba reg thos pa dga' dang / me ban chos 'bar dang / mtshur lo tsā rnams kyis rgya gar phyag na rdo rje bsten nasaphyag rgya chen po grub pa'i skor dang snying pa'i skor dang / do ha skor gsum dang do ha mdzod dang mi tri pa'i bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /dpyal kun dga' rdo rjes bal po to ngu dkar po bsten/ paṇ+ḍita stong nyid ting nge 'dzin spyan drangs te man ngag (phag mo gzhung drug sogs/)mang po zhus so/ /rwa(nus pa che bar grags/)rdo rje grags kyis bal po (me dza gling pa lha ro phyag rdum yang ra/)thugs rje chen po bsten nas dgra nag 'jigs skor gsum dang he ru ka mngon 'byung gi skor la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /dpon po rwa chos rab kyis paṇ+ḍita sa man+ta shrī spyan drangs te dus 'khor dang phag mo mngon 'byung dang mgon po mngon 'byung la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /zhang shes rab bla mas kyang paṇ+ḍita a mo gha badz+ra spyan drangs te dgra nag gi skor rgyas par bsgyur ro/ /rgyus smon lam grags kyis kyang paṇ+ḍita gzhan la phan pa bsten te sdom 'byung bsgyur ro/ /zha ma seng rgyal gyis kyang paṇ+ḍi ta nor bzang srung ba la sogs bsten nas tshad ma kun las btus rtsa 'grel bsgyur ro/ /yar 'brog gi mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis kyang bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel sgrub skor rgyas par bsgyur ro/ /dpyal chog kyi bzang pos rgya gar du lo bcu bzhugs bla ma rdo rje gdan (mi pham sba pa'i bdes gnyen kyang zer/ rol pa'i rdo rje yang zer/)pa ni ska laṅka la bde mchog dang / gshin rje gshed dmar gyi skor rnams kyang zhus te bsgyur/ kha che shākya shrī la dge tshul byas so/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis thog mar shrī dzā ga ta mi tra ā na sto 305

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()zhes pa mi tra dzo gi zhes grags pa spyan drangs te bde chen ral gcig gi skor dang sems nyid ngal bso'i skor dang / bstan pa'i gru bo la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /de nas kha che'i paṇ+ḍita burnya shrī dz+nyā na spyan drangs te mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa shes rab sgron me dang rgyal ba'i lam 'jug dang thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /de nas kha che shākya shrī bha dra spyan drangs te dpyal chos bzang gis nā ro 'grel chen (gser sding su bsgyur sngar yichu dgon pa zer ba la paṇa chen gyi gser sding brtags zer ro/ /)bskur te de'i bshad bka' man ngag dang bcas pa gnang / paṇ+ḍita de la 'khor paṇa chung bi bhu paṇa dkar yin no/)ti tsan+d+ra dang / dwa na(paṇa dkar//shī/sa skya paṇ+ḍi lha tshad ma bslab bo rdo)la dang / bal po saṃ gha shrī dang / su ga ta shī la sogs pa dgu byon te bi :('dis bod du thengs gsum byon srin po ri'i bde mchog bzhengs/ko brag pa sogs la sbyor ba yan lag drug pa gnang ngo /)ti dang dwa na shī las bod du yun ring du bzhugs te rang 'gyur yang mdzad do/ /byams pa'i dpal gyis 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud bsgyur de'i bshad bka' nod/ rdo rje phreng ba dang / bde mchog la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ kha che paṇa chen de la sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bsnyen rdzogs byas nas bal po saṃ gha shrī dang bcas pa la sgra bslabs te/ paṇa chen dang dwa na shrī la la rnam 'grel bslabs nas 'gyur bcos byas te mkhas pa chen por gyur nas (saskya legs bshad dang sdom gsum rab dbye brtsam phyi rgya nag la rgyal po go dan go kug rgyal po'i nu bo spyan drangs dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa la byon gnam mchod pa'i gral dbu thob lo bdun cu bzhes pa lcag phag la zhing gshegs so/)cho khrig ma dag pa rnams sun phyung ngo / /paṇa chen la 306

bu ston chos 'byung /byang chub dpal dang rdo rje dpal gnyis kyis bsnyen rdzogs byas te/ gdan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ngo / /de nas brgyud de paṇa chen gyi mkhan brgyud kyi bslab pa 'dzin pa mang po byung ngo / /paṇa chen gyis srin po rir rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur rdzogs par mdzad nas dbang bka' dar bar 'phel lo / / chag dgra bcom kyis kyang rgya gar du byon nas rgyal ba'i lam 'jug la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ /de'i dbon po chag chos rje dpal gyis rgya gar du byon/re me spro dang rat+na rak+ṣi ta la sogs grub thob mang po bsnyen gtsug dgu'i rgyud bsgyur/ 'gyur bcos mang po mdzad do/ khong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis kyang bal por byon paṇ+ḍi ta la shrī spyan drangs te snyan dngags me long dang / dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / bstod pa brgya pa la sogs bsgyur ro/ /de'i gcung po blo gros brtan pas kyang gshin rje gshed dmar gyi rgyud bsgyur 'gyur bcos byas so/ /yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis kyang mi g.yo ba'i rgyud dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / bya ba bsdusapa la sogs bsgyur ro/ /bdag gi bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang posabal por lo bcu bzhir sbyangs pa mdzad/ ri'i kun dga'i mdo la sogs mdo bcu gsum tsam paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+ta shrī spyan drangs te bsgyur ro/ /gzhan yang gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos mang po mdzad do/ /dpang blo gros brtan pas kyang tshad ma kun las btus kyi 'grel pa rgyal dbang blos mdzad pa dang / dus 'khor gyi bshad sbyar snying po snang ba la sogs pa bsgyur te de dag gis bstan spu dar bar byas pa yin no/ /zhib tu rang rang gi rnam par thar pa'i yi ge las shes 307

spro ba chen 'od snang la /tsho 'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()par bya /ra/ byung / bod du dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍita dang lo tsā ba'i mtshan tho/ de ltar bod du dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍita bod du byung ba ni (1)mkhan po shārnyi rak+ṣi ta bod skad du zhi ba 'tsho dang /(2 )pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /(3)sngags 'chang dharma girti dang /(4)bi ma la mi tra dri med bshes gnyen dang /(5)sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / 9)bsam yas kyi rab gnas mkhan shān+ti gar+bha zhi ba snying po dang /(7)bi shud+dha sidha ha rnam dag seng ge dang / (8)ka ma la shī la pad+ma'i ngang tshul dang / (9)rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sar dang / (10)bram ze shi ka dang / (11)bal po shī la mañju dang / (12)bram ze ā nan+da dang / (13)ka phye mi tra dge ba'i bshesaganyen dang / (14)dzi na mi tra rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen dang / (15)su ren+d+ra bo dhi lha'i dbang po byang chub dang / (16)shi len+d+ra bo dhi tshul khrims dbang po byang chub dang / (17)dwa na shī la dang /(18)bo dhi mi tra dang / (19)mu ni warma thub pa'i go cha dang / (20)sarba dz+nyā de ba kun mkhyen lha dang / (21)bi sdi ka ra pra bha rig byed 'od zer dang / (22)shud+dhā ka ra wa me dad byed go cha dang /(23)pad+ma gup+ta pad+ma sbas pa dang / (24)mu: mi tra grol ba'i bshes gnyen dang / (25)brdzi shrī shārnyi dang / (26)brnya pā la sangs rgyas skyong dang /(27)dharma pā la dang / (28)bra dz+nyā pā la dang / (29)su bhā ṣi ta legs par gsungs pa dang / (30)pra dz+nyā wa me dang / (31)di pa nar shrī dz+nyā na mar me mdzad ye shes te jo bo rje dang / (32)de'i dbon po dwa na shrī dang / (33): ti 308

bu ston rmos 'byung/dz+nyā na kirti dran pa'i ye shes grags pa dang /(34)phra la ring ba dang /(35)su cu ta shrī legs par rig pa'i dpal dang / (36)kha che dz+nyā na shrī dang /(37) tsan+d+ra rā hu la dang / (38)ra dhi pā la brtan skyong ste 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / (39)a tu phye dwa sha mi mnyam khol po dang / (40)su ma ti girti blo bzang grags pa dang / (41)a ma ra tsan+d+ra dang / (42)thig le bum pa dang / (43)gzhen nu bum pa dang / (44)ka na ka warma dang /(45)dam pa (ding ri glang 'khor btab ste bod du gshegs/)rgya gar dang / (46)dza ya ā na sto dang / (47)ga ya(grin gyi shug can kyang zer//dha ra dang / (48)don yod rdo rje dang / (49)zla ba mgon po(kha che nga yin)/dang / (50)stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rje dang / (51)ye shes rdo rje dang / (52)shes rab gsang ba dang /(53)ma hā dza na dang /(54)wa la tsan+d+ra dang /(55)marnya ka la ku dang /(56)su ga ta shrī dang / (57)rkarma badz+ra dang / (58)dza ma ri dang / (59)ze ro tsa na badz+ra dang / (60)mañju sto dzi dang / (61)gur ya kirti dang / (62)pra dz+nyā shrī dz+nyā na dang / 43)ge gā dh+wa ra dang / (64)nor sbas dang /(65)sa man+ta shrī dang /(66)ni ska laṅka de ba dang / (67)dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+ta dang / (68)burnya shrī dz+nyā na dang / (69)shākya shrī bha dra dang / (70)bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra dang / (71)dwa na shī la dang / (72) gha shrī dang /(73)longs spyod rdo rje dang / (74)rat+na shrī dang /(75)bal po mahā pa na dang / (76)bal po badz+ra kirti dang / (77)ba'i/po kwa ya shrī dang / (78)bal po grags pa dpal dang / (79)ku mā ra dang /(80)thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal dang / (81)su dhu kirti dang / (82)bi 309

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(3)nā ya shrī dang / (83)shi la shrī dang / (84) gha ma shrī dang / (85)bi ma la shrī dang / (86)dar pan ā tsar+ya dang / (87)dza ya de ba dang / (88)la ka ra dang / (5)ra sne shrī dang / (90)ā nan+ta shrī dang / (91)rā hu la shrī dang /(92)bla ma zangs gling pa dang / (93)girti paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa byon no/ /lo tsā ba la snga ba (1)thon mi saṃ bho ṭa dang /(2)dharma ko ṣa dang / (3)rdo rje dpal dang / (4)bran ka mu la ko ṣa dang / (5)gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra dang /(6)sba ye shes dbang po dang /(7)ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / (8)'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta dang / (9)sbrang rgyar legasagazigs dang /(10)seng gong lha lung gzigs dang / (11)sba mang rje gsal snang dang /(12)sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ (13)lte dz+nyā na sirnyi/(14)mchims shākya pra bha dang / (15)brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ (16)shud pu dpal gyi seng ge(17)dba' mañju shrī/ (18)gtsang de len+d+ra ra sti ta/(19)bran ka mu ti ga (20)pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ (21)'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta/(22)me rin chen mchog(23)gtsang sa la'i bu rin chen legs grub/(24)dharma ā lo ka dang / (25)dran pa nam mkha' dang / (26)dgra bcom rin chen sde dang /(27)rnam par mi rtog pa dang / (28)shākya 'od dang /(29)lte khri 'brug dang / (30)nyang khams pa go cha dang / (31)tswa na de ba koṣa dang / (32)zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang dang / (33)'gos chos grub dang /(34)stong tsa ā tsar+ya dang / (35)dharma ta shī la dang / (36)klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / (37)dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta dang / (38)ra tā rak+ṣi ta dang /310

bu ston chos nga /39 ye shes sde dang / 40dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / 41mañju shrī warma dang / 42ra sne spro shi la dang / 43bzang skyong dang / 44lha'i zla ba dang /45dpal gyi lhun po dang / 46dpal 'byor dang /47me shes snying po dang /48rgyal ba shes rab dang /49shākya bshes gnyen dang /50dge ba dpal dang / 51legs kyi sde dang / 52gnubs nam mkha'i snying po dang / 53yi ge pa dgon gling me dang / 54gzhon nu srung ba dang /55nam mkha' skyong dang /56rin chen bzang po dang tho 4sa ra 'a du grags/ 57grags 'a cas ra shes rab dang lus ma spang par mkha' spyod la gshegs/58'bro seng dkar shākya 'od dang / 59rngog legs ga4 zhe'u thog btab/pa'i shes rab dang / 90lha bla ma zhi ba 'od mnga' ris rgyal po/dang /61rgya brtson 'grus seng ge rdzo bo rje spyan 'dren pa po yin/dang /62nag tsho jo bo rje spyan 'dren pa po yin/tshul khrims rgyal ba dang /63khudangos grub dang /64chos kyi shes rab dang /95mar thung dad pa shes rab dang / 7me dge ba'i blo gros dang /97ga rod tshulakhrimasang gnas dang / 68shākya blo gros dang /99'brom rgyal ba'i dge spun 'byung gnas dang / 70khyung po chos kyi brtson 'grus dang /71stag lo tsā ba dang / 72'gar snang(ri bo rtse lnga lagashegs/kyi bzang po dang / 73she'u badz+ra de ba dang / 74rab zhi bdes gnyen dang / 75rngog blo ldan shes rab dang / 76zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab dang /77gnyan dar ma grags dang / 78gzu dga' ba rdo rje dang /79gyi 3

ba chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(3)ljang du dbu dka' dang / (80)chos kyi yon tan dang / (81)chos kyi rin chen dang /(82)lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros dang / (83)'brog mi shākya ye shes dang / (84)'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang/ (85)gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer dang / (86)klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang / (87)mal gyo blo grosagrags dang /(88) se rtsa ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan(sman lung btab/)dang /(89)rong pa chos bzang dang / (90)yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug dang /(91)mang 'or byang chub shes rab dang/ (92)tsa mi sangs rgyas (rgya gar labyon/)grags dang / (93)khe'u gad pa 'khor lo grags dang / (94)spong zho gsal ba grags dang / (95)ding ri cho khrig grags dang / (96)rgyus smon 'gru grags dang / (97)pa tshab nyi ma grags dang / (98)ba ri rin chen grags dang /(99)'bro shes rab grags dang / (100)rwa rdo rje grags/ (101)kre bo shes rab dpal dang / (102)bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / (103)ba reg thos pa dga' dang / (104)me ban chos 'bar dang / (105)mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan dang /(106)mtshur dbang nge dang /(107)dpyal kun dga' rdo rje dang /(108)dpyal dga' ba grags dang / (109)mar do chos kyi dbang phyug dang /(110)chos kyi snying po dang /(111)kam chos kyi ye shes dang / (112)phyugs mtshams dbang phyug rgya mtsho dang / (113)tshul khrims yon tan dang /(114)khye'u gad pa yon tan dpal dang /(115)bsod nams bzang po dang /(116) sum pa dpal mchog rdo rje dang / (117)nyi ma rdo rje dang /(118)khu dge bsnyen ne tso dang / (119)klog skya gzhen nu 'bar dang /312

bu ston chos 'byung/ (120)lha ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / (121)byang chub 'byung gnas dang /(122)glan chos kyi blo gros dang / (123)cog gru ting nge 'dzin bzang po dang / (124)shes rab ye shes dang / (125)rig pa gzhen nu dang /(126)gzhon tshul dang / (127) khu mdo sde 'bar dang / (128)shesarab brtson 'grus dang / (129)g.yung drung 'od dang / (130)bsod namasargyal ba dang / (131)cog gru shes rab bla ma dang / (132)cog gru mya ngan med pa'i dpal dang / (133)la chings yon tan 'bar dang /(134)bsod nams mos pa dang / (135)dge tshul khyung grags dang /(136)rnab lha khrimasabartsegs dang /(137) lha btsun pa dang / (138)lha btsan po mu ni rā dza dang /(139)rngog brnya pā la dang / (140)rgya lo tsā dang /(141)sbal rdo rje rgyal po dang / (142)lha rin po che dang / (143)lha chos kyi rin chen dang /(144)skyur tshul khrims 'od zer dang / (145)dge slong bya'i gdong can dang /(146)ra byid lo tsā ba dang / (147)phur bu 'od dang /(148)pa tshab tshul rgyal dang / (149)shes rab legs dang / (150)nag tsho dar ma grags dang / (151)mar pa blo gros bzang po dang / (152)selotsā ba dang / (153)zla ba grags pa dang / (154)mnyal mi ye shes sna tre gdang /(155)chos kyi zla ba dang / (156)dge slong shes rab skyabs dang /(157)nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / (158)'a zha rgya gar brtsegs dang /(159)gnyan bsod nams dar dang / (160)ba ri chos grags dang /(161)yong po lo tsā ba dang / (162)gzhen nu shes rab dang /313

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(3)(163)'gar shes rab 'byung gnas dang / (164)'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / (165)shes rab 'od zer dang / (166)lce dga' ba dpal dang /(167)ye shes 'byung gnas dang / (168)shākya brtson 'grus dang /(169)rwa chos rab dang / (170)lo btsun chung rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /(171)zha ma dge bsnyen seng rgyal dang / (172)lce bkra shis dang / (173)chag dgra bcom dang / (174)dpyal chos bzang dang /(175)gnubs byams pa'i dpal (nyi ma lta bur grags/)dang / (176)bas skya paṇ+ḍita (zla po lta ra grags/thogamanyal pa nyi zla zung gcig tu grags so/)dang /(177)chag chos rje dpal dang /(178)dpyal shes rab 'od dang / (179)shad grub pa dpal dang /(180)glo bo shes rab rin chen dang / (181)lho brag pa dar seng dang / (182)mi mnyam bzang po dang /(183)shong rdo rje rgyal mas dang /(184)shong blo gros brtan pa dang /(185)khams pa blo gros rgyal po dang / (186)'dan ma tshul seng dang /(187)ras gzhon brtson dang /(188)shud kye grags pa rgyal mtshan dang /(189)nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang /(190)dpang blo gros brtan pa dang /(191)sgra tshad pa rin rgyal dang / (192)legs pa'i blo gros la sogasapa ste/ de dag gis gang bsgyur 'og tu 'chad cing / 'dir ma chud pa'i paṇ+ḍita bod du byon pa'i drin can dang lo tsā ba rnams kyang ji ltar rnyed pa bsnan par bya'o/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod las/ bod du chosabyung tshul gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /314

bu ston chos 'gung // gsum pa bka' dang bstan bcos bod du ji ltar 'gyur ba'i rnam grangs la/ mdo phyogs dang / sngags phyogs gnyis so/ /dang po la bka' dang /bstan bcos gnyis so/ /bka' la 'khor lo rim pa gsum las/ dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bka' las/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i dang po lung gzhi sho lo ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya ste bam po brgya rtsa dgu tshang ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba dang / lung rnam 'byed la pha'i rnam 'byed sho lo ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya ste bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba dang/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa dpal gyi lhun po dang dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba dang / lung phran tshegs la/ kha cig phran tshegs sgo brgyad las drug pa yan chad lasam 'gyur zer ba dang / dpe kha cig las phran tshegs bsgyur pa'i dus su lo tsā ba mang pos bgos nas bsgyur pas/ bam po sum cu rtsa dgu pa dang/ bzhi bas rtsa gsum pa chad pas gnyis po 'di dang po nas 'gyur ram ma 'gyur yang / lo tsā ba chen po dpal 'byor la'ang zhu zhing brtag sgra bsgyur pa'i dpe reg zig dang yang gtugs zhes pa dang / mchims phu'i dkar chag las/ 'dul ba phran tshegs bsgyur 'phro bam po lnga bcu rtsa gnyis zhes pa dang / dkar chag ldan dkar mar/ 'dul ba phran tshegs kyi gzhi blo ka nyi khri bzhi stong drug brgya ste bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis zhes pa la sogs pa the tshom gyi gzhi mang du yod pas na tha snyad kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/phran tshegs sgo brgyad ka rdzogs pa slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa phran tshegs sa kyi tshig gi rnam 315

bge' 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()par bshad pa dang gtugs pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa lo tsā ba dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur ba 'di tshad mar bya'o/ /lung gzhung bla ma/ zhu ba rdzogs pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum tshang ba dang / zhu ba ma rdzogs pa bam po bcu gnyis pa dang gnyis la gzhung dam pa'ang zer/ de dag gi lung gzhis rab byung gi gzhi la sogs pa nas gnas mal gyi gzhi'i bar gzhi bcu bdun ston/ dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed kyis dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum ston/ ma'i rnam 'byed kyis dge slong ma'i khrims sum brgya drug cu ston/ gzhung bla masagazhi dang rnam 'byed kyi don zhib tu 'chad pas 'grel pa lta bu yin/ phran tshegs de rnams kyi ma tshang ba kha skong lta bu yin/ rtsa ba'i lung dge slong gi so sor thar pa sho lo ka bdun brgya ste bam po gnyis dang / dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa sho lo ka brgyad brgya ste bam po gnyis pa gnyis klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa'o so so thar pa'i mdo gnyis po dgra bcom pa chos kyi tshong dpon gyis byas pas bka' min zer ba dang / kha cig bka' yin yang ston pa bzhi yin te/ sangs rgyas dang/ nye bar 'bor dang / chos kyi tshong dpon dang /dri med bshes gnyen dang bzhi'o zer te bstan pa gcig la ston pa bzhi ngo mtshar che'o/ kho bo'i bla ma lung sde bzhi dang / mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo bstan bcos su bzhed pa ni bzhed pa tsam du zad do/ /de dag 'dul ba'i skor ro/ /gzhan yang dus phyis gsungs pa dang ci rigs yod kyang theg chung rnams phyogasagacig tu bstan par bya ste/ 'phags pa dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bam po pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di lo tsā bas theg chen du mdzad dkar 316

bu ston chos 'byung /chag chen po dag las theg chung du bshad do/ /tshangs pa'i dra ba bam po gnyis/ mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba bam po gcig dang sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo bam po gcig mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka lnga bcu/ mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos zhus pa bam po phyed/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid sho lo ka dgu ༅/ mdo wo po stong pa nyid r+ṣa po bam po phyed/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog sho lo ka bzhi bcu ste bdun po de ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ mdo chen po lnga gsum pa sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu ste de gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo bam po gnyis/ skyes bu dam pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyisabargya ste bzang skyong dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dga' bo rab tu 'byung ba'i mdo sho lo ka lnga bcu gtsang de we rgyu'i 'gyur/ lha'i mdo sho lo ka sum cu rtsa bdun/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu sho lo ka brgya bcu bdun ste ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zla ba'i mdo sha lo ka bcu gsum/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo sho lo ka drug storat+na rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ gnas 'jog gi mdo sho lo ka nyi shu dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ dga' ba can gyi mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya/ gzhen nu dpe'i mdo sho lo ka nyi shu/ khams mang po'i mdo sho lo da nyis brgya/ 'bar gsil gyi mdo dang / 'khar gsil 'chang ba'i kun tu spyod pa'i cho ga gnyis bam po gcig gaṇ+ḍi'i mdo sho lo ka bcu tshul khrims yon tan dang rin r+pā bzang po'i 'gyur/ gaṇ+ḍi'i dus rdo 7mdo sho lo ka dge blo'i 'byur/ dge

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byu gces bsdus/(2)ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen pa'i mdo sho lo ga dge slong la rab tu gcesapa'i mdo sho lo ga tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo sho ga lhung ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba bstan pa'i mdo shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/mchog tu btags pa'i mdo/rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i mdo dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/'di dkar chag chen mo dag tu mdor byas la kha cig bstan bcos su 'dod/tshe'i mtha'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya rtsa lnga pa dge ba dpal dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/'chi 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i mdo/mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo sho lo ka bco lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/'du shes bcu bstan pa'i mdo sho lo ka brgyad/'du shesabacu gcig bstan pa'i mdo sho lo ka bcu gcig 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal 7sa yin no//mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo sho lo ka lnga h+phu rtsa phyed dang gnyis/mun gyi nags tshal gyi sgo'i mdo/pha ma'i drin lan bstan pa sho lo na sum brgya/bden pa bzhi'i mdo/chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo/don rnamapar gdon mi za ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs sho lo ka bdun cu/don rgyas pa'ichos kyi rnam grangs sho lo ka brgya mjug ma tshang ba/med du byung ba'i chosakyirnam grangs sho lo ka bdun cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/de bzhin gshegs pa'igazugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sho lo/drug cu ye shes snying po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/mchod rten bskoraba'i tshigs bcad sho lo ka bdun cu/gsal rgyal gyi tshigs bcad sho lo kobargya/klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs suḥ bcad pa sho lo ka brgya/tshigs

bu ston chos nga / bcad pa gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ ma can par 'byung ba'i mdo rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bam po bzhi rin chen mchog dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di sngar gyi dkar chag dag lasabastan bcos su bgrangs la da lta bkar grags/ thabs la mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi drin lan bsab pa bam po bdun/ las rnam 'byed chung ngu bam po gcig ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba bstan pa'i gzhung sho lo ka nyis brgya bdun cu/ rgyal bu don grub kyi mdo bam po gcig bsod nams kyi stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa sho lo ka nyisabargya bcu lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ rgyal po zla 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang /dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa gnyis shes rab legs dang rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rgyal po gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba bstan pa sho lo ka bcu bdun/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes rab ldan gyi mdo sho lo ka bco lnga dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod sho lo ka brgya ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod tshul khrims yon tan dang rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa bam po nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ las brgya pa bam po sum cu so bdun/ mdzangs blun gyi mdo bam po bcu gsum/ legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa 'gos chos grub kyis rgya gar dang rgya'i dpe las bsgyur pa/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu bstan pa/ zla ba snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las sang /9 mya ngan las 'das nas bstan

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()pa gnas pa dang 'jig pa lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis/ ri glang ru lung bstan pa bam po gcig stag sna'i rtogs pa brjod pa bam po gnyisashākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ mig bcu gnyis pa 'di gnyis klu mes dbang phyug gragasabaka' min par smra'o/ /kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka sum cu rtsa bdun/ byams pa lung bstan pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur la sho lo kabargya/ sngar 'gyur nges pa da lta ma rnyed pa la bsod nams kyi mdo sho lo kabargya rtsa/ bsod nams kyi gdugs kyi mdo sho lo ka brgya/ gang zag gi mdo sho lo ka brgya rtsa/ khyim bdag 'du shes kyi mdo sho lo ka lnga bcu/ ched du brjod pa'i mdo/ lus 'phags mo'i mdo/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa sho lo ka brgya/ 'di dkar chag ldan dkar mar bstan bcos su bgrangs pas de nyid yin par sems/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i mdo chung du/ sems can la skye shi'i rtsa ba bstan pa bam po gcig 'jig rten pha rol sgrub pa bam po gnyis/ dge ba bcu yi dam du blangs pa'i cho ga sho lo ka brgya/ bzang sbyin gyi mdo bam po gnyis/ byams pa skar gyi mdo/dad pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i mdo/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bshad pa'i mdo/smon lam gyi mdo/ sa'i mdo/ 'dod pa la gdams pa'i mdo/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo chung ngu sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa gsum/ las rnam par 'byed pa chen po bam po gnyis/ mang pos bsdus pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /'di dag las drin lan bsab pa dang mdzangasablun dang sems can la skye shi'i rtsa ba 31/na pa la sogs pa mang po zhig theg

bu ston chos 'gung / chen du dkar chag chen mo dag tu bshad pas brtag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bka' ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa bam po sum brgya ste nyang khams pa go cha / be+e ro tsa na/ lce khyi 'brug zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur byang drug yod par grags so/ /nyi khri lnga stong pa bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum dang sho lo ka brgya/ khri brgyad stong pa bam po drug cu ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/shesarab khri pa bam po sum cu rtsa gsum/ brgyad stong pa bam po nyer bzhi rngog chen po la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ sdud pa bam po gcig dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur ba ste de dag la yum drug zer ro/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab kyi rtsal gyi rnam par gnon pas zhus pa sho lo ka nyis stong chig brgya drug cu ste bam po bdun dang sho lo ka drug cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa sho lo ka lnga brgya/rdo rje gcod pa bam po gcig de gnyis skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ tshul brgya lnga bcu pa sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu/ lnga bcu pa sho lo ka lnga bcu/ ko'u shi ka sho lo ka sum cu rtsa gcig sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa lnga skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ shes rab snying po sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa lnga rin chen sde dang / brnye nam mkha' la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ 'di la sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa brgyad zer yang rgya dper nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad do/ /yi ge nyung ngu sho lo ka sum cu/ yi ge gcig ma/ 'di'i steng du dkon brtsegs kyi 'dus pa bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa bsnan pas sras bcu gcig ste sras yum bcu sdu/na zhes grags so/ khri shes rab kyi pha

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sho lo ka sum cu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ sher phyin kun tu bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo ste / drug po de dag kyang sher phyin yin pas sras yum bcu bdun zhes yum dang sras su phye ba'i don dang grangs gnyis ka nor ba'o zhes kha cig go sa cig sdud mdo rgyas pa gsar 'gyur zhes pa yod gsungs te brtag go /sngar gyi bsgyur 'phro sher phyin stong phrag bzhi pa da lta ma rnyed ces kyang bya'o/ /gsum pa bka' mtha' ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i bka' la/ sangasargyas phal po che la/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang / 'phags pa byang chub semasadapa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa dang zhing khams dang 'khor dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa dang zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don mtha' dang dbus med par ston pa sangs rgyas phal po che 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi le'u nas sdong po rgyan pa'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa yan chad la sho lo ka sum khri dgu stong sum cu ste bam po brgya sum cu dang sho lo ka sum cu be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas zhu chen bgyis pa la de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'ur gtogs pa la bam po bcu bzhi/rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u bam po bcu gsum/ sabacu pa bam po brgyad/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa bam po bcu drug de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa bam po lnga/ 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i le'u bam po bcu gcig sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u bam po sum cu tham pa'o/'di la shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dang / sdu/ gyi gong rgyan dang pad+ma'i rgyan dang shin

bu ston chos 'byung /tu rgyas pa'i mdo zhes 'chad do/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po chos sgyu rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las sdom pa gsum bstan pa bam po gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par spyong ba bam po bzhi dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyibs mi khyab pa bstan pa sho lo ka sum stong lnga brgya ste bam po bcu gcig dang sho lo ka nyis brgya ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rmi lam bstan pa sho lo ka stong / 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa bam po gsum/ me 'brugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa sho lo ka stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu ste bam po lnga dang sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ go cha bkod pa bam po drug chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis dbyer med par bstan pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo /lnga bcu/ chos bcu pa sho lo ka lnga brgya/ kun nasasgo'i le'u sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu pa rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa bam po lnga/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bam po nyi shu skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ dga' bo la mngal na gnas pa bstan pa bam po gnyis/ mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gcig 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa bam po gsum dang sho lo ka brgya bzhi bcu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ yab sras mjal ba bam po bco lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gang pos zhus pa bam po drug yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa bam po gsum dang sho lo ka brgya ye shesasde'i 'gyur/ khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu/ klog thob kyis3 gyus pa bam po gnyis/ sgyu ma mkhan

'tsher 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos pa gce bsdus/()bzang po lung bstan pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya sum cu/ cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa lha'i bu ded dpon gyis zhus pa bam po gsum/ byams pa seng ge sgra chen po bam po bzhi/ 'dul ba rnam par gtan la dbab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa bam po gnyis/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba bam po gnyis/ lag bzang gis zhus pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya rtsa brgyad/ des pas zhus pa bam po gcig khyim bdag dpal sbyin gyis zhusapa bam po gcig pad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa sho lo ka nyis brgya/ bu mo ga ba'i mchog gis zhus pa sho lo ka brgyad cu/ bu mo mya ngan med pas byin pa lung bstan pa bam po gcig bu mo dri ma med pas byin pas zhus pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu/ yon tan rin chen me tog kun tu rgyas pas zhus pa sho lo ka brgya bzhi bcu/ sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa bam po gnyis/ de rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lha'i bu blo gros rab gams kyis zhus pa bam po bzhi klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ seng ges zhus pa sho lo ka drug cu/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa bam po bzhi dang sho lo ka bcu gsum/tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa bam po gnyis pa rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bu mo rnam dag dad pas zhus pa sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu/ byams pasazhus pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka bcu/ byams pas zhus pa chos brgyad pa bam po gcig 'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i le'u bam po gsum/ rin po che'i phung po'i mdo bam po gnyis dang dz+wa ༵ ka bdun cu/ blo gros mi zad pas

bu ston chos yang / zhus pa sho lo ka nyis brgya/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya/ de rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa bam po gsum chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ lha mo dpal phreng seng ge sgra'i le'u bam po gnyis dang / drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa bam po gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur te dkon brtsegs kyi 'dus pa bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yan chad tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde sna tshogs la/ bskal pa bzang po bam po nyi shu rtsa drug pa dpal dbyangs dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/rgya cher rol pa bam po bco brgyad skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol ba bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka bcu/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u bam po gcig dang sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa bzhi skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa bam po lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo bam po nyi shu rtsa lnga ye shes snying po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan bam po gsum dang sho lo ka lnga bcu pa ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa bam po bco brgyad legs kyi sde dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs bam po bzhi skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ khye khra kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sho lo ka nyis brgya bdun cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rdi zhung gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()rnam grangs/ dkyil 'khor brgyad ces bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs sho lo ka drug cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa bam po bzhi dang sho lo ka nyi shu skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ lang skar gshegs pa rgya las bsgyur pa bam po bcu gcig lang kur gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po'i le'u 'gos chos grub kyis rgya las bskur pa bam po brgyad/ ga ya go ri sho lo ka brgya brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa dang / dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po bam po bcu gsum pa dang /snying rje pad+ma dkar po bam po bco lnga pa dang / snying rje chen po pad+ma dkar po bam po drug pa ste bzhi ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i le'u nyi khri lnga stong pa las lha dang mi la sogs pas zhus pa'i le'u bam bo bcu gsum pa lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo chung ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'da' ga ye shes sho lo ka bcu rgya las 'gyur bar dkar chag ldan dkar mar bris/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod bam po lnga rgya lasabasgyur pa 'di dkar chag chen mo gsum du mdor mdzad kha cig the tshom gyi gzhir 'chad do/ /rgyan stug po bkod pa bam po bzhi yan chad 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa bam po gnyis klu'i rgyal mtshan dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po bam po drug pa dang/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa sho lo ka brgya sum cu pa gnyis ye shes sde la sogs pa'i ༷༷ra/ za ma tog bkod pa bam po bzhi

bu ston chos 'byung /dang sho lo ka brgya drug cu rtsa lnga/ dkon mchog za ma tog bam po bzhi rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas bam po bdun pa dang / rin po che'i mtha' sho lo ka nyis brgya bcu pa gnyis ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po che ba bam po brgyad pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po chung ba bam po lnga/gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba bam po bcu 'gos chos grub kyis rgya las bsgyur ba/ gser gyi mdo/ gser gyi bye ma lta bu sho lo ka brgyad cu ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bam po bco lnga yan chad tshang ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par ngesapa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum dang sho lo ka bcu pa dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka drug cu pa ste gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin bam po lnga rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bam po bdun rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin bam po bzhi ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin bam po drug pa rgya las bsgyur ba/khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa bam ༵ /cig 'dus pa chen po rin po che

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()tog gi gzungs bam po brgyad dang sho lo ka sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang /rdo rje snying po'i gzungs bam po gcig dang sho lo ka nyis brgya bdun cu pa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ spyo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu/ spyo drug pa' gzungs sho lo ka bco brgyad/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa' gzungs sho lo ka brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka bcu dgu ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ gzungasa'adi dag slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis sgo drug pa mdor bkral zhing ka ma la shī las rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa mdor bkral la tog dang rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dkar chag chen mo dag las rma dor bshad pa bzhin yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po bstan pa gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa bam po bdun/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa bam po brgyad/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa bam po gsum/ byams pas zhus pa sho lo ka bdun cu/ spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka bcu/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa bam po bzhi dang sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa bam po bcu/klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chen po bam po bdun/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa dge ba bcu bshad pa sho lo ka nyis brgya/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngu sho lo ka bcu/ de rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa chos bdun byi2 /ge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal

bu ston chos 'byung /po ma dros pas zhus pa bam po bzhi ye shes sde dang yi ge pa dgon gling me la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa bam po lnga dpal gyi lhun po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ tshangs pas zhus pa sho lo ka nyisabargya/ tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa bam po gcig ste de gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa bam po bdun chos nyid tshul khrims dang bar zhus kyi lo rtsa ba lha'i dbang po srung ba dang gzhen nu srung ba la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa bam po gsum/dpal dbyig gis zhus pa sho lo ka brgya rtsa bco lnga pa gnyis ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu ye shes snying po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ khye'u rin chen zla bas zhus pa sho lo ka nyis brgya rtsa bdun pa dge ba'i dpal dang lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ bde byed kyis zhus pa sho lo ka brgyad cu ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa gsum/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa bam po drug bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa sho lo ka dgu bcu/ bgres mos zhus pa sho lo ka brgya rtsa bco lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa sho lo ka dgu bcu/ bdag med pa dris pa rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten 'dzin gyis yongs su dris pa rnams/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa bam po bdun pa dang / dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa bam po drug pa gnyis chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis bsta/ huX sho lo ka phyed dang bco lnga/ sbyin pa'i

ba ga 'od snang la /ga skya'i chos sting tsos bsdus/()phan yon bstan pa sho lo ka sum cu/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa khye'u rin chen byin gyis zhus pa sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa bam po gnyis/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bstan pa bam po drug byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis de rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa bam po gnyis chos nyid tshul khrims la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa bam po gsum rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gsum dang sho lo ka nyi shu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul gyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka lnga bcu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa/ mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan pa sho lo ka nyisabargya bcu pa dge ba dpal dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa sho lo ka bzhi bcu dge ba dpal dang lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa bam po gnyis dang / bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa sho lo ka brgya/ bde ldan ma lung bstan pa sho lo ka bdun cu/rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis zhus pa sho lo ka bcu gcig spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu pa dang/ 'jam dpal gnas pa sho lo ka brgya bzhi bcu pa gnyis me shes sde/ ༷gyur/ byams pa la bdud rtsi brjod

bu ston chos 'byung /pa sho lo ka brgyad cu/ byams pa 'jug pa bam po gnyis pa dang / 'jig rten dang rjes su mthun par 'jug pa sho lo ka brgya rtsa bcu gcig pa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya bam po lnga dang sho lo ka bsnyen cu pa dang / nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa bam po gcig dang mar me 'bul ba bam po gcig rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos kyi phyag rgya sho lo ka brgyad cu/ grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba'i mdo sho lo ka brgya klu'i dbang po dang lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ zas kyi 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa'i mdo sho lo sum cu rtsa brgyad/ glang po che'i rtsal gyi mdo bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu/ sgra chen po sho lo ka drug cu rtsa bzhi dge ba dpal dang lha'i zla ba'i 'gyur/ seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa bam po gcig sba rje ye shes snying po'i 'gyur/ su lu ljang pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa drug pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bstan pa sho lo ka bcu gsum/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par 'byed pa bstan pa sho lo ka sum cu pa nam mkha'i 'gyur/ 'di theg pa chung ngur gragasakyang dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / rig byed ma yin pa gzugs min pa la sogs pa bstan pa'i phyir theg pa thun mong du 'thad do/ /sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa bam po bdun chos nyid tshul khrims dang rgya'i lo tsā ba stong ā tsar+ya la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba bam po lnga rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur/ dpal sbas kyi mdo bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu pa dang / las kyi sgrib rdi /ma par dag pa bam po gcig dang sho

'tshechen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chosa'abyungagacesabasdus/()lo ka bzhi bcu pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa sho lo ka nyisabargya sum cu pa rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa bam po bdun pa dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ rgyal po la gdams pa sho lo ka brgya drug cu pa/ rnga bo che chen po'i le'u bam po lnga dpal gyi lhun po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u bam po gsum pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i le'u bam po bzhi pa dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa mtshan gzhan chosa'agro ba zhes pa dang / rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu pa rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas 'gro ba bam po gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba bam po gsum dang sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa lnga pa dpal dbyangs dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ chos kun bgro ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig bam po gsum dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ dkon mchog sprin bam po brgyad rin chen 'tsho dang chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ sprin chen po bam po bcu/ sprin chen po las phyogasabacu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rnam par rtse ba'i le'u bam po gsum dang sho lo ka nyisabargya nyi shu/ sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor le'u bam po gcig sprin chen po'i mdo rlung gi dkyil 'khor las sprin chen po le'u bam po phyed dang gsum dang sho lo ka bdun cu/ char dbab pa'i le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa cho ga dang bcas pa rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sprin chen po chung ngu sho lo ṭ+wāṃ 31rgya nyi shu dang gcig mi gcig dpyad/

bu ston chos 'byung /bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po'i mdo 'di bka' yin min the tsho mi gyi gzhir klu mes dbang phyug grags 'chad/ gtsug tor bam po dgu pa lasabadud kyi le'u nyi tshe phyung ba rgya las bsgyur pa bam po gnyis/ 'di dkar chag snga ma gsum gar bkar bshad do/ /sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa bam po bcu gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo bam po drug ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo/ yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo bam po nyis rgya je pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/chos kyi rgyal po'i mdo bam po gtsig dang sho lo ka brgya/ 'di dang tshi nge 'dzin mchog dam pa gnyis dkar chag snga ma gsum gar mdor mdzad do/ /chos kyi tshul bam po gcig chos kyi phung po sho lo ka brgya lnga brgya/don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba sho lo ka nyis brgya brgyad cu/ chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis te bzhi ye shes sde'i 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa'i so so thar pa chos bzhi sgrub pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya shākya blo gros dang dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ chos bzhi bstan pa sho lo ka bcu gsum ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos bzhi pa sho lo ka bcu/ chosabazhi ma btang ba/ bzhi pa sgrub pa sho lo ka nyis brgya drug cu/ chos gsum pa lha'i zla ba dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ chos kyi rgya mtsho sho lo ka brgyad cu/chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgya mo bam po gnyis rgya las 'gyur ba/ nyi ma'i snying po bam po bcu gsum pa bzang skyong dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bam ṭ+wāṃ /cig dang sho lo ka bcu ye shes sde'i

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'gyur/ yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po sho lo ka brgya/ nam mkha'i snying po bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga/yang dag pa'i spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gi 'dul ba'i bzod pa bam po bcu gcig rgya las 'gyur ba/ thabs la mkhas pa theg pa chen po bam por gtogs/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa bam po brgyad/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyi sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya rtsa bcu gnyis rgya las 'gyur ba/ rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las mtshan nas brjod pa'i yon tan gyi gling gzhi/ me tog gi tshogs bam po gsum chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa lnga pa/phyogs bcu'i mun sel sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu gtsang de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bdun pa sho lo ka brgya rtsa lnga/ sangs rgyas brgyad pa sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa gcig sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i mdo sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa bdun/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan sho lo ka nyis brgya rin chen 'tsho dang de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi sa sho lo ka nyis brgya ye shesasdes ṭī ka bzhi dang sbyar te gsar du bsgyur ba/ sangs rgyas mi spong ba sho lo ka brgya nyi shu pa dang dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i mdo sde sho lo ka bdun cu pa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bkra shis brgyad pa sho lo ka lnga bcu rtsa gcigadakon mchog gsum rjes su dra/ 31/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo/ sku

bu ston chos thing /gsum pa'i mdo/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo sho lo ka lnga brgya sum cu ye shesasde'i 'gyur/ byang chub kyi lhung ba bshags pa/ 'di nye bar 'khor gyis zhusapa las 'byung ba yin/ de bzhan gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa sho lo ka brgyad brgya pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa bam po gnyis pa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo sho lo ka sum cu dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo sho lo ka bdun cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo rgya las bskur pa bam po lnga bcu rtsa drug pa mu stegs kyi rgyal po pa la shas gdung ma thob pa yan ho tshang ba/ ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nyer dga' bo gas ba'i mdo/ 'od srung chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/ byamasapa sgom pa'i mdo/ slabs pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes pa rabs kyi gleng gzhi/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ de rnams paṇ+ḍita ā na sto shrī dang bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsar du bsgyur pa yin/ 'di rnams sngar gyi dang zlos mi zlos theg pa che chung gang yin dpyad par bya'o/ /bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis la/ dgongasapa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba chen po las yongs su bsngo ba chen po'i rgyal po sho lo ka brgya sum stod pa la 'byor dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po chen po sngags dang brdo~X pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka nyis

brje ོ 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 2ning gcas bsdus/()brgya mjug cung ma tshang ba/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i bsngo ba sho lo ka lnga bcu/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa'i bsngo ba sho lo ka bzhi brgya/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa bdun/ byams pa'i smon lam sho lo ka sum cu/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa gsum ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i mar me'i smon lam/ gser 'od dam pa'i bshags pa'i le'u nas byung ba'i smon lam/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma las byung ba'i smon lam/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo me bya chen mo las byung ba'i smon lam dang bden tshig yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ lhas zhus pa'i bde legs kyi migs su bcad pa/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sho lo ka dgu/rgya cher rol pa las byung ba'i tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po la gsungs pa'i shis par brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag des pa la gsungs pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas phal po che las byung ba bcom ldan 'das la brgya byin gyis bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa / lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi 3 3 6 bcad/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun

bu ston chos 'byung /gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ dkon mchog gsum dang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ye shes sdes bsgyur pa ste/ bzang spyod la sogs pa 'di dag theg chung du bris pa ni mi rigs te/ theg chen gyi mdo dang gzungs las phyung ba yin pas de nyid du gtogs shing de las logs su phye ba mi 'thad do/ /gang pos zhus pa dang / glog thob kyis zhus pa dang / rin po che'i phung po dang / sa bcu pa rnams dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i le'u yin pasamado sna tsho gos su ming bgrang ngo / /'dir sngar 'gyur nges pa deng sang gi bka' 'gyur du ma tshud cing ma rnyed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod bam po bzhi/dkon mchog gi mdzod bam po bzhi dang sho lo ku nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin bam po drug dpal dbyangs kyis zhus pa bam po gcig dang sho lo ka nyis brgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa bam po gcig chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po sho lo ka bzhi brgya/spobs pa'i rgyan bkod pa/ ye shes kyi mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa bam po phyed dang gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa bam po gcig dpal chen po'i mdo bam po gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogasang bam po gsum/rdo rje snying pos zhus pa/ zla ba mchog gi snying pos zhus pa/gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa/ rab dgas zhus pa/ stag mo'i bu mos zhus pa/pha rol tu phyin pa bcu bstan pa/ ri mo'i mtshan nyid bstan pa/ tshad med pa bstan pa/ dkyil 'khor dbu 3lta'i phan yon bstan pa/ byang chub

ba chen 'od snang /sa sbya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()sems dpa' lung bstan pa/ tshangs pa lung bstan pa/ rin po che chen po'i mdo bam po lnga/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung gi le'u 'dul ba rnam par gdon mi za ba bam po gcig ye shes rgyas pa chung ngu bam po gcigayang dag pa'i legs pa'i yon tan bshad pa sho lo ka brgyad cu/ sman bla'i mdo chung ngu sho lo ka nyis brgya/ pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa/ shes rab skyed pa / stobs skyed pa/ ye shes bsdus pa'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bajo ba la mkhas pa sho lo ka brgya drug cu/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo nyid lasami g.yo bar tha dad par thams cad la snang ba bstan pa sho lo ka dgu bcu ste / mdo sum cu rtsa drug ma rnyed do/ /zung gi mdo dang bdag med pa dris pa la sogs klu mes mdo min par smra ba ni mi 'thad de bdag med pa dris pa rin chen bzang pos phyis bsgyur pa'i phyir dang / zung gi mdo dkar chag chen mos mdor bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes kha cig go /'phang thang mar/ me 'gal 'tsho ba'i mdo/ rta mgrin gnam sa bkod pa'i mdo zhes pa li las bsgyur pa yod pa ra bshad de mdo sum brgya brgyad cu rtsa gcig ma rnyed par lnga bcu nga bdun nam nga dgu la sogs 'gyur la ko'u shi dzi blo gros bzang mo chung ba/ ljon shing gi mdo la sogs pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang klu mes la sogs pas mdo yang dag ltar snang phye ba bzhin rtogs par bya'o/ // gnyis pa bstan bcos kyi skor la gsum ste/ bka' bye brag gi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa dang/ spyi'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa dang /thor bu ba lugs kyi bstan bcos la /3 8 / /dang po ldogasum las/ dang

bu ston chos 'byung /po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'bor lo'i dgongs 'grel ni/ lung gzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bsgyur 'phro bam po bcu gcig rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa bam po bco lnga klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gzhung bla ma'i bye brag lung zhu ba ma rdzogs pa'i 'grel pa mdo sde 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bsgyur 'phro/ phran tshegs sgo brgyad pa yan chad rdzogs pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa bam po bcu dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon khyad par bshes gnyen gyisamadzad pa'i 'dul ba bsdus pa bam po bco lnga be+e ro tsa na dang rgyal ba'i shes rab dang shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ so sor thar pa'i gzhung 'grel bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun pa slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad par grags pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i so sor thar pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa 'dul ba kun las btus pa bam po lnga bcu par grags pa klu'i rgyal mas gyi 'byur/ 'dul ba bya ba'i phung po/ so so thar pa'i 'grel pa mi brjed pa'i dran pa/ yang so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa bam po bdun/ so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa'i tshig gi brjed byang dwa na shī la chen pos byas par grags pa bam po gnyis klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ so sor thar pa'i tshig gi 'grel pa tshig gi dga' skyed ma/ 'di bstan 'gyur du ma chud/ so sor thar pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa chen po bam po brgya rtsa bcu gnyisapa deng sang ma rnyed do/ /dge slong mas ḍi sor thar pa'i 'grel pa bam po

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()gnyis/ yang dge slong ma'i so thar gyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon yon to 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i mdo rtsa ba bam po dgu pa dang / las brgya rtsa gcig pa sho lo ka sum stong drug brgya bam po bcu gnyis pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mdo'i 'grel pa nyid kyi rnam bshad tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ mdo'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po bdun cu pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba mdo'i 'grel chung slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad zer ba 'di the tshom gyi gzhi yin/ 'dul ba mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon shes rab byed kyis mdzad pa/ dgra bcom pa sag lhas mdzad pa 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud bam po drug byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon mdo sde 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa sho lo ka brgya/ de'i 'grel pa bam po lnga dang sho lo ka brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi pa gnyis dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/'dul ba la bstod pa dgra bcom pa chos kyi tshong dpon gyis mdzad pa dang /de'i 'grel pa slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa gnyis klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa dang / de'i rang 'grel 'od ldan bam po brgyad pa gnyisadabang po srung ba'i 'gyur/ slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa'i slob ma la phan pa / dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lnga bcu pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i don brgyad ma/ dge tshul gyi bya ba/ sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo bas/ pa dbyig bshes kyis mdzad pa las

bu ston chos 'gung /btus pa slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa sho lo ka drug cu rtsa lnga/ slob dpon bha byas mdzad pa'i sde pa tha dad pa rnam par bshad pa sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa lhag nag tsho'i 'gyur/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi dang po'i lo dri ba rgyal ba'i shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dge slong gi dang po'i lo dri ba nag tsho'i 'gyur/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi'i mdo gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ paṇ+ḍita su n+ya shrīs mdzad pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa brgyad pa rtsa 'grel dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ gleng gzhi dang gang zag bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa kha che bi ma la shrī bha dras mdzad pa gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ /ched du brjod pa'i tshogs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bsdus pa rtsa 'grel ye shes snying po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i chos kyi snying po'i 'grel pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten gdags pa bam po bdun/ rgyu gdags pa bam po bdun/ las gdags pa bam po lnga / de rnams ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di dag bye brag tu smra bas bkar 'dod la dkar chag chen po dag tu yang bkar bshad mod kyi mdo sde pa la sogs pas bstan bcos su 'dod pa bzhin gnas so/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa bam po gnyis pa dang/ de'i rang 'grel bam po sum cu pa gnyis dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel ba// /don gsal ba bam po drug cu pa slob

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dpon rgyal po'i sras grags pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon gang ba spel gyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs pa bam po drug cu pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ bal po zhi gnas lhas mdzad pa'i chos mngon pa'i mdzod la nye bar mkho ba zhes bya ba mdo dang sbyar ba'i ṭī ka bam po shes rab 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon 'dus bzang gis mdzad pa'i chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa mdo dang mthun pa bam po bco lnga/ slob dpon phyogs glang gisamadzad pa'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa gnad kyi sgron ma 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i 'gyur te theg chung gi bstan bcos lnga bston/ /'dir slob dpon sharnyi so masamadzad pa'i mdzod 'grel bam po bcu bzhi/ mdzod kyi thabs bsdus pa bam po bcu/ chos ma ga pa la 'jug pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka lnga bcu/ de'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po lnga/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa'i dge slong gi tshul sho lo ka lnga bcu/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bye brag bkod pa'i 'khor lo sho lo ka de rnams btsal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa bka' bar pa'i dgongs 'grel la/ rgyal ba'i yum stong phrag brgya pa'i 'grel chen bam po bdun cu rtsa brgyad cung zad ma 'gyur ba/ 'di 'phang thang mar btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis byas par bris mod kyi dkar chag gong ma gnyis su rgya gar mar bshad pas de ni se nas byas pa de yin no/ /rgyal ba'i yum stong phrag brgya pa dang nyi khri lnga stong pa dang khri brgyad stong pa rnams kyi gzhung 'grel bam bo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa bsgyur 'phro/ 'di na/ zhes nas byas zer ba mang mod kyi 'di ni

bu ston chos 'grang /dbyig gnyen gyi gzhung 'grel yin te thub pa dgongs rgyan la sogs par nyi khri gzhung 'grel las drangs pa'i tshig rnams der ji lta ba bzhin snang ba'i phyir dang / dbur yang / 'di yi gzhung 'grel gnod 'joms bya bar 'dod/ /cesa'abyung ba'i phyir ro/ kha che dharma shrī'i 'bum gyi ṭī ga yum gsum mthun par don brgyad kyis bstan pa'i ṭī ka smi tis mdzad pa de'i rang 'gyur/ nyi khri le brgyad pa'i bsdus don gyi 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa grol sdes mdzad pa'i nyi khri snang ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ btsun pa grol sdes mdzad pa'i nyi khri rnam 'grel 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon shārnyi pas mdzad pa'i nyi khri'i 'grel pa dag ldan 'gos kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi snang ba sho lo ka stong phrag brgyad pa rngog 'gyur/ slob dpon shārnyi pas mdzad pa'i brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa snying po mchog shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i brgyad stong 'grel pa gnad kyi zla zer shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i brgyad stong pa'i don bsdus dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa gnyis rngog 'gyur/ dpal ldan rgyal bo dza gad ta lar gnas pas mdzad pa brgyad stong pa'i rnam par bshad pa man ngag gi rjes su 'brangs pa ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pa'i 'gyur/ slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdza/ sdu'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(3)bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa bam po bdun/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa bam po drug nam mkha' skyong gi 'gyur/ 'dir bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa sho lo ka brgya pa slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa dang / yang bdun brgya pa'i 'grel pa bam po gnyis pa dang /tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa sngags kyi tshul du bshad pa bam po gcig pa rnams btsal bar bya'o/ /slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa'i sdud 'grel rtogs par sla ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i sdud pa'i dka' 'grel bam po drug dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ kha che dharma shrīs mdzad pa'i sdud pa'i lde mig ba reg gi 'gyur du grags pa/ slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sdud pa'i don bsdus slob dpon de nyid dang dgra bcom rin chen sde'i 'gyur/ 'di bstan 'gyur du ma chud/ rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa ka ma la shī las byas pa bam po lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'dir rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon yon tan 'od zer byin gyis mdzad pa bam po gnyis pa dang /rdo rje gcod pa'i rnam par bshad pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka lnga bcu pa dang /rdo rje gcod pa'i rnam par bshad pa tshig le'ur byas pa sho lo ka sum cu rtsa bsnyen pa rnams ma rnyed do/ /slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sher snying 'grel pa / shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa don gyi sgron ma/ shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i sher snying 'grel pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ slo )pon pad mas mdzad pa'i sher snying

bu ston chos 'byung /'grel pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sher snying sgrub thabs glan chung dang stag lo'i 'gyur/ 'di sngags su gtogs par sems so/ /don bcus gsal bar bstan pa'i sher snying 'grel pa/ slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sher snying rgya cher 'grel brnye nam mkha' dang ye shes snying po'i 'gyur/ yang rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa rgya las 'gyur ba bam po lnga pa ma rnyed do/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skor la/ mngon rtogs rgyan bam po gnyis rngog la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa don gsal bam po lnga dpal brtsegs dang blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dkar chag mchims phu ma dang 'phang thang mar mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rgya cher 'grel pa bam po drug ces 'byung ba de 'di la 'khrul lam gzhan yod brtag par bya'o/ /don gsal gyi 'grel bshad tshig rab tu gsal ba slob dpon dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ nub kyi sgo glegs pa shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyisamadzad pa rngog 'gyur/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i rtogs dka'i snang ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ kha che gzhen nu dpal gyis mdzad pa'i don bsdus bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa grags pa'i cha rat+na girtis mdzad pa/ la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ 'di 'grel chung gi 'grel par 'dod pa nor ba yin no/ /paṇ+ḍita burnya shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma'i phreng ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ ༷༷ra bstan bcos rin chen sgron ma dang /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()nyi khri gzhung 'grel chung ba ni bod kyis byas pa'o zhes kha cig go /jo bo rjesamadzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus sgron ma nag tsho'i 'gyur/ dpal rka pa las mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsdusapa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel pa gnyis rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbu ma'i skor la/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byasapa shes rab bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya bzhi bcu pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon des mdzad pa'i rigasapa drug cu pa sho lo ka drug cu rtsa gnyis pa nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ stong nyid bdun cu pa sho lo ka bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa gzhon nu mchog la sogs pa'i 'gyur/rtsod pa zlog pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa sho lo ka bdun cu dpal brtsegasadang khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ zhib mo rnam 'thag grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i rang 'grel ga la 'jigs med bam po bdun dang /rtsod zlog gi rang 'grel bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya pa dang / stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa sho lo ka nyis brgya brgyad cu pa dang / zhib mo rnam 'thag gi 'grel pa rnams mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa bam po bcu klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa tshig gsal slob dpon zla ba gragasapas mdzad pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma bam po nyi shu klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ shes rab sgron ma'i 3 4 6bshad btsun pa spyan ras gzigs

bu ston chos 'byung /brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa bam po brgyad cu pa klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan la phan pa bzang pos mdzad pa gzhen nu mchog gi 'gyur/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa zla grags kyis mdzad pa ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i dbu ma bzhi brgya pa dang / de'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa gnyis pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i ye shes snying po kun las btus pa dang / de'i 'grel pa slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa gnyis chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i dbu ma lag pa'i tshad sho lo ka bco lnga dang / de'i 'grel pa sho lo ka nyi shu pa gnyis dpal 'byor snying po dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa'i lhas mdzad pa'i 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i gtan tshigs grub pa dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ theg chen nyi shu pa shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma yi ge brgya pa rtsa 'grel gzhon nu shes rab dang grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma 〉na 'brel snying po rtsa 'grel sho lo ka lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ srid pa 'pho ba/ de' 'grel pa paṇ+ḍita byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa zla ba ga smo nu'i rang 'gyur/ skye med rin po che'i mdzod du grags pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa'i rab tu byed pa grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa nag tsho'i 'gyur/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i rtsa ba nag tsho dang pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/de'i 'grel bshad paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya rdi /rnyas mdzad pa kun dga' grags kyi

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'gyur/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya ā nan+ta sa mdzad pa'i rtog ge tho ba mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyi mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i snying po bsdus pa sho lo ka brgyad cu/ de'i 'grel pa rtog ge 'bar ba/ dbu ma'i don bsdus pa rnams nag tsho'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rin po che'i sgron ma rgya brtson seng dang nag tsho'i 'gyur/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i dbu ma rten 'byung / zhabrul pa 'joms pa rtsa 'grel nag tsho'i 'gyur/ slob dpon dze ta ris mdzad pa'i gzhung gi rab byed shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i bden gnyisal 'jug pa/ de'i dka' 'grel slob dpon dharma ka ra ma tis mdzad pa gnyis rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i bden gnyis sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa bdun/ de'i rang 'grel bam po gcig de'i 'grel bshad slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa bam po gsum/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa'i dbu ma rgyan sho lo ka brgya/ de'i 'grel pa bam po gnyis pa ste lnga ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel bshad slob dpon ka ma la shī lasamadzad pa bam po lnga ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i dbu ma snang ba bam po dgu/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par grub pa bam po phyed dang gnyis dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid snang ba'i rab tu byed pa bam po gnyis/ slob dpon dpal sbas kyisamadzad pa'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa sho lo ka sum cu/ de'i 'grel pa sho lo ka nyis brgya/ dbu ma shes rab la 'jug pa 'gos kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sdi 4 8 la 'jug pa sho lo ka brgya lnga

bu ston chos yang /bcu rtsa drug de'i 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes zla bas mdzad pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya lnga bcu pa gnyis ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ slob dpon rig byed 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma lugs kyi snying po bam po phyed dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon dbu ma'i seng ges mdzad pa'i lta ba tha dad pa rnam par phye ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon a 6 ka ra gu ltas mdzad pa'i thub pa dgongs pa'i rgyan gsal ba grags dang dpang blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ spyod 'jug gi skor la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug zhi ba lhas mdzad pa rngog 'gyur/ 'di dkar chag chen mo gsum gar sho lo ka drug brgya bam po gnyis zhes 'byung mod kyi sho lo ka stong du grags so/ /spyod 'jug le'u dgu pa blo gros mi zad pas mdzad zer ba de dang 'di mi gcig ces smra ba mang yang sdig bshags kyi le'u 31gas su byas ma byas kyi khyad par dang 'gyur snga phyi'i khyad ma gtogs pa gcig par kho bo smra'o/ /spyod 'jug gi 'grel chen slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon dge ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug 'grel pa/shes rab le'u'i dka' 'grel gsum las gcig rngog 'gyur/ bi bhu ti tsa spros mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa de'i rang 'gyur/ slob dpon gser gling pas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug gi don bsdus nag tsho'i 'gyur/ de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa'i skor la sum rdo ṭ+wāṃ dgu/ dbu ma phyogs gnyis la drug cu

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()rtsa gnyis/ spyod 'jug gi skor la bcu ste brgya rtsa bcu gcig go/'dir de kho na nyid la rtsod pa bzlog pa bam po gcig stong pa nyid kyi sgo bcu gnyis pa rtsa 'grel gnyis la bam po gnyis pa rnams ma rnyed do/ /gsum pa bka' mtha' ma'i dgongs 'grel mdo sde sna tshogs kyi 'grel pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i mdo'i gleng gzhi'i bshad pa bam po gcig shākya blos mdzad pa/ sa bcu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa bam po bcu bzhi dang sho lo ka drug cu ye shes sde dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de'i 'grel bshad slob dpon nyi ma grub kyis mdzad pa bam po bcu gnyis dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyasakyi sa'i 'grel pa slob dpon ngang tshul bzang pos mdzad pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka bzhi bcu/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i 'grel pa grags pa'i phreng ba nag tsho'i 'gyur/ de'i nang gi sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/dkon mchog gsum rjes dran gyi 'grel pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa shākya 'od kyi 'grel/ ga ya go ri'i mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa sho lo ka brgya sum cu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ga ya go ri'i mdo dang spel mar bshad pa slob dpon shākya blos mdzad pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa bam po gnyis/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa'i bshad pa/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi rnam bshad / ༵ ka sum cu rtsa gcig chos bzhi pa'i

ga tsher 'od snang /ga 'i chos nga gces bsdus/()mkha'i 'gyur/ 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon pra dz+nyā sa mu dras mdzad pa dang slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i mdo sde dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i 'grel chung sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu ye shes sde'i 'gyur/dgongs 'grel gyi 'grel pa chen po bam po bzhi bcu tsam yod pa/ 'di thogs med kyis mdzad zer te mi bden te/ de'i 'thad pa sgrub pa'i rigs pa'i skabs nas/ de dag gi mtshan nyid rab tu dbye ba ni dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag dpal lha btsan po byang chub ②'phrul gyis mdzad pa'i bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las byung ba bzhin du blta bar bya'o zhes bod kyi bstan bcos la kha 'phangs byas shing kun las btus dang tshad ma rnam nges la sogs pa'i lung drangs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bod kyi mkhas pa chen po zhig gis byas pa shesapa ra bya'o/ /klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad par yang sems so/ /dgongs 'grel gyi 'grel pa rgya'i mkhan po wen tsheg gis mdzad pa bam po bdun cu rtsa bzhi 'gos chos grub kyis rgya las bsgyur pa/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i 'grel pa siṅga gling gi slob dpon sa'i rtsa lag gis mdzad pa rgya las bsgyur pa bam po nyi shu/ lang skar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya'i mkhan po ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i rgyan rgya las 'gyur ba ste mdo sde'i 'grel pa sum cu so brgyad do/ /'dir dgongs 'grel kyi ṭī ka chen po bam po drug cu pa/dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i :sdus pa'i le'u nyi tshe bshad pa slob
