bu ston chos 'byung /chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ rtsa lhung bcu bzhi pa/ yan lag gi nyes pa/ yan lag gi dam tshig slob dpon a bh+yas mdzad pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i lhung ba'i snye ma sangs rgyas grags kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon la sa mdzad pa'i rtsa lhung bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i rtsa lhung bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa yan lag dang bcas pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa brtson seng gi 'gyur/ slob dpon rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i rtsa lhung 'grel pa nag tsho'i 'gyur/ slob dpon dz+nyā na bo dhis mdzad pa'i las dang po pa'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa bsod nams rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyi'i dam tshig mdor bsngas pa/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i dam tshig thams cad bsdas pa nag tsho'i 'byur/ slob dpon ye shes bzang posamadzad pa'i tshul khrim shā dang sdom pa dang dam tshig mi 'gal ba rab zhi bzhes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ dpal la ka ras mdzad pa'i dam tshig gi 'grel pa nyung ngu nag tsho'i 'gyur/ rab gnas dang sbyin sreg dang tshogs 'khor gyi skor la/ dpal su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa'i rten 'brel rab gnas shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pasamadzad pa'i rab gnas/ slob dpon rat+na rak+ṣi 'a tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu dang / he ru ka badz+ra'i tshogs kyi 'bor lo'i cho ga rim par phye ba grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ slob dpon a lha'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon rab 'jigs rdo /lha mdzad pa'i sbyin sgrog gi cho ga rin

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ slob dpon zla 'od kyis mdzad pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bsod nams rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs rab tu gnas pa brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ slob dpon ka ma la ma has mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i nyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon kho bhi he ru gas mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dul ba bsgrags pa dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga paṇ+ḍita bzang po sbyin pas mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i ro sreg gi cho ga chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rab gnas kyi rgyal po/ thod pa mchod pa'i cho ga bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i mtshan nyid dang / khrus kyi cho ga gnyis shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon mi 'jigs pa'i phyag gis mdzad pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa/ maṇ+ḍal cho ga dang gtor chog dang bstod pa dang bkra shis la/ dam pa la'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga 'gyur rnying / sangs rgyas gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga ta ris mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga dharma grags kyi 'gyur/ rnyog med rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rngog 'gyur/ ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga shes rab dpal ye shes kyi rang 'gyur/ kha che shākya shrīs mdzad pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga slob dpon srid gsum rdo rjes mdzad pa'i las dang po pa'i tshogs gsog pa'i bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ gtor ma/ chen po'i las kyi rim pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa dge blo'i 4 /53tor ma chen po'i cho ga lha ye shes

bu ston chos 'byung /rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga rtsa 'grel gnyis khu dngos grub kyi 'gyur/ nag po pa'i 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor chog nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i gtor ma 'brom ston pa'i 'gyur/rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu / rgyud sna tshogs las btus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gzhen nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon ba sla ā tsar+ya sa mdzad pa'i chos skyong thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga me chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga bshes gnyen ston pa'i 'gyur/ sbyor ba bzhi'i lha la bstod pa paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na kirtis mdzad pa bam po ma hā pa ṇa'i rang 'gyur/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ slob dpon dza ma ris mdzad pa'i nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang brgyad ding ri chos grags kyi 'gyur/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa slob dpon a ba sgru tī pas mdzad pa/dpal lha mo'i bstod pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa slob dpon sangs rgyas grags kyis mdzad pa sa lo'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las byung ba'i rigs lnga 'khor bcas/ lha sum cu so bdun gyi bkra shis te/ de ltar sngags phyogs la stong bdun brgya bzhi bcu zhe bdun te sngar mtshan nyid kyi skor gyi lnga brgya da/ ༷cu dang dril bas nyis stong sum brgya

ba chen 'od nga la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()sum cu bod du 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag chen mo las nyis stong sum brgya lnga bcur bshad kyang jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa logs su bgrangs pa dang snga phyi zlos pa mang po snang bas zlos pa kun dor zhing rang gis mngon sum du mthong ba dang yid ches pa'i tshig las da lta 'gyur ba yod par nges pa rnams nyis brgya tsam dang bcas pa sngar ma chud pa mchis so 'tshal bsnan nas grangs dang go rim dang sde tshan dang gzhung tshad dang 'gyur byang gi bar sngar gyi dkar chag chen mo bzhi la gzhi ma byas nas ji ltar shes pa ltar bris so/ /ye shes sdes bsgyur pa rnams skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa shas che'o/ /nag tsho'i 'gyur zhes pa rnams tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur ro/ /rngog 'gyur zhes pa rnams blo ldan shesarab kyi 'gyur ro/ /pa tshab 'gyur zhes pa rnams nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur ro/ /ba ri'i 'gyur zhes pa rnams rin chen grags kyi 'gyur yin pas gzhan du mi bsam mo/ /bod kyi sdud pa po/ 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa'i chos rgyal dam pa rnams dang lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyi mdzad byang la/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis mdzad pa'i gtsug lag la/ grub pa'i mtha' bgro ba sho lo ka bzhi bcu/bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma bam po bdun/ dbu ma'i gzer bu sho lo ka sum cu / de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad brda bam po lnga/ 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad dang shākya thub pa dang byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la bstod pa sho lo rka 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bstod pa sho lo da byams pa'i bstod pa chen po bam po gcig dang sho lo ka brgya/ byams pa la bstod pa chung ngu sho lo ka lnga brgya/ mi g.yo :spyan po la bstod pa sho lo da bsam

bu ston chos 'byung / gtan gyi dogs pa brgyad bsal ba/ lha btsan pos bkas bcad pa sho lo da bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma mdor bstan pa bam po gcig slob dpon be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas rgyal po la gnang ba don gsal ba'i sgron ma/btsun pa dpal dbyangs kyis bod rje 'bangs la brdzangs pa gces pa bsngas pa'i 'phrin yig mkhan po dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa la/ mdo sde sna 〉gas las btus pa gsung rab rin po che'i gtam/ phyi'i yul dran rgyud du yod par 'dod pa sel ba bam po gnyis/ mtshan nyid gsum mdor bstan pa sho lo na lta ba'i rim pa bshad pa dang bzhi'o/ /phyi ma 'di dpyad/ mkhan po ye shes sdes mdzad pa la/ lta ba'i khyad par bam po phyed dang gnyis/ de'i dran byed bzang po spyod pa'i 'grel pa bzhi'i don bsdus pa bam po gnyis/ 'jig rten pha rol sgrub pa sho lo ka sum cu/ dgongs pa bzhi dang ldem dgongs bzhi'i brjed byang sho lo ka nyis brgya'o/ /slob dpon klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa la/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i rgya cher 'grel bam po bzhi bcu/ nges pa'i don dbu ma bam po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las mdor bsdus te gsal ba bam po/ phreng ba'i rgyan bam po gcig chos gtan la dbab pa'i gal rnams so/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo'i bshad pa btsan po mu tig btsan gyis mdzad pa/dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi byams pa'i le'u'i brjed byang slob dpon shes rab snying pos mdzad pa/ sher snying gi ṭī ka slob dpon pra sha sde se nas byas pa/dbu ma rgyan gyi brjed byang slob da// bkra shis kyis mdzad pa bam po bcu/

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/(ni/rigs pa drug cu pa las btus te mdor bshad pa slob dpon be+e ro tsa nas mdzad pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon bkra shis kyis mdzad pa/dge slong ma'i so so thar pa'i bshad pa dpal gyi lhun pos byas pa/ chos kyi gzhung sbyir bstan pa dpal brtsegs dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi brgal lan bzha phrugs/ btsan po dpal dun brtan gyi dbu ma'i bkas bcad bshad pa dang bcas pa sho lo ka drug cu/ de'i brjed byang / bsam gtan gyi man ngag lha btsan pos mdzad pa dang / de'i brjed byang / ā tsar+ya ka la ya na'i dris lan bam po gcig rin chen zla ba 'byung gnas kyi dris lan sho lo ka nyis brgya/ khyung gong dang dge 'dun gyi gal sho lo ka brgya/ kong ut+pal ko sha'i dris lan sho lo ka lnga bcu/ dge 'dun la btsan pos sems nyams smras pa sho lo da be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i snang ba mtha' yas kyi mtshan brjod pa/ thu mi saṃ bho ṭas mdzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad las sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis las ma rnyed/ lce khyi 'brug gi sgra'i gnas brgyad rtsa 'grel gnyis/ ma byin len gyi skabs nas mkhan po bzhis dpyad pa sho lo ka jo mo byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam/lo paṇa mang pos mdzad pa'i bka' bka' che 'bring chung gsum dang / chos kyi rnam grangs kyi rtsa ba dang brjed byang bam po bzhi/ mdzad pa po'i mtshan ma smos pa la/ 'bum gyi brjed byang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po/ don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i mdo'i 'grel pa bam po/ rdo rje gcod pa'i ṭī ka che/ ༵ bam po/ brjed byang chung ngu bam po/

bu ston chos 'byung /ga ya go ri'i bsgyur byang bam po/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa/ lang mar gshegs pa/ sa bcu pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sa/ swā lu ljang pa'i mdo rnam ba(kyi brjed byang / sher snying gi bshad pa sho lo na mngon rtogs rgyan mdo dang sbyar ba bam po/ 'bum gyi ṭī ma'i don bsdus mdo dang sgyur ba bam po/rigs pa drug cu pa'i ṭī ka bam po drug rigs pa drug cu pa' tshig le'ur byas pa nyi tshe bshad pa bam po/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po brjed byang bam po/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i bskrud byang sna gsum bam po/ theg bsdas bam po/ mdo sde rgyan gyi brjed byang bam po/de'i brjed byang rnying 'thor bam po/ las grub pa'i dran byed bam po /dbus mtha' dang / pan gan dang / nyi shu pa rnams kyi brjed byang bam po/lnga phung 'grel pa'i mi brjed pa'i tshig bam po/ byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'gyur byang bam po/ byang sa'i sa bcu'i brjed byang bam po mngon pa mdzod kyi brjed byang bam po/ mdzod kyi 'jig rten bstan pa'i bskyud byang bam po/ chos mngon pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa bam po/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa rang log zhu log gi brjed byang sho lo da byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i 'grel pa bam po/ de kho na nyid kyi bsam gtan la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i mdo 'grel bam po/ rigs thigs kyi brjed byang bam po/ de'i skabs kyi brjed byang sho lo rka dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa'i brjed byang sho lo ga so sor thar pa'i brjed byang chen po bam po bcu/ so sor thar pa'i ṭī ka ba/ ༵/ 'grel pa bam po/ gleng gzhi man

brtse chen 'od snang la /skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()chad so sor thar pa'i tshig brjed pa dran byed bam po/ ba bang rka'i brjed byang bam po/ kwa ri kā lnga bcu pa'i brjed byang bam po gnyis/ dge tshul gyi bya ba lnga bcu pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po/ rdo rje g.yung drang nges par bkod pa'i rgyan bam po gsum/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu rā'i lta ba'i tshul bam po/ theg pa chen po'i kun rdzob dang don dam pa bstan pa bam po/theg pa chen po'i dbu ma'i tshul bstan pa sho lo ka nyis brgya/ bstan pa'i snying po bam po/ gzigs pa bla ma bam po/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang ba'i mdo bam po/ dmigs su med pa'i tshul gcig pa'i gzhung bam po phyed/ theg pa chen po'i chos dang don dang dkyus bris pa sho lo da theg pa chen po gcig car 'jug pa bam po bsam gtan sgom pa'i thabs dang gnyen po bshad pa sho lo ma tha snyad kyi phreng ba sho lo ga theg pa chen po'i dbu ma lugs kyi snying po sho lo da mkhan po bo dhi dharma tas bshad pa las btus pa sho lo ga rnal 'byor spyod pa la 'jug pa'i tshul rnam pa gsum las btus pa bam po/ yang dag pa'i lam bstan pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya/ grub pa'i mtha' bgro ba las btus pa bam po phyed/ bla na med pa'i spyod pa'i mdo sho lo ma theg pa chen po'i chos rgyu dang 'bras bu mdor bshad pa bam po gcig sems dang sems las byung ba'i mtshan nyid mdo tsam du bstan pa bam po phyed/ chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam pa gnyis su bstan pa bam po/ tshegs chung dus bsod nams chen po thob pa'i rtags bam po/ sdo 6)nga gi 'jig rten mdor bstan pa

bu ston chos 'byung /bam po/ gsung rab dang mdo sde las mdor bsdus pa rtsa 'grel sho rbe kasems 'khor ba mdo tsam du bstan pa sna gsum sho lo da chos kyi rnam grangs gsung rab las bstan bcos btus pa bam po bzhi/ bstan bcos gas pa'i phreng ba sho lo ka chos bslab pa'i mdo'i brjed byang sho lo ka nyis brgya/ nyon mongs pa spang pa'i rim pa sho lo ka drug cu/ thabasadang shes rab kyi spyod pa bstan pa sho lo ka brgyad cu/ tshad med pa bzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa sho lo da byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bstan pa sho lo da bden pa gnyis mdor bsdus pa'i brjed byang sho lo ka brgyad cu/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi lam bstan pa sho lo dmu stegasakyi lta ba'i skabs kyi brjed byang sho lo / chos skad gtan la dbab pa bam po/ byang chub dam pa'i smon lam/ byang chub 'byung ba'i smon la/ bla na med pa'i smon lam/ spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa sna gnyis/ 'jam dpal la bstod pa gnyis/ mchod rten la bstod pa sna gnyis so/ /de dag phal cher dkar chag 'phang thang mar smos so/ /gzhan yang lhag mthong skyed pa'i thabs/ sems gnas pa spyi'i yi ge mi sdug pa'i sgo nas semasaganas pa'i thabs/ byams pa bsgoms pa'i sems gnas pa'i thabs/rten 'brel bgrang ba'i sgo nas sems gnas pa'i thabs/ khams rab tu dbye ba'i sgo nas sems gnas pa'i thabs/ dbugs bgrang ba'i sgo nas sems gnas pa'i thabs/ zhi gnas sku la sgom pa'i thabs chung si / /zhi gnas la 'jug pa'i thabs/ bsdu/ gtan la 'jug pa bsdus pa/

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byurig ces bsdus/()sems kyi nyams mdor bsdus pa/ bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mdzad pa'i bsngo ba chen po/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i bsngo ba rnams bstan 'gyur dkar chag tu smos so/ /gzhan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od gnyis kyis sngags log sun 'byin pa dang / btsun pa byang chub 'od kyis mdzad pa'i grub mtha'i rnam dbye dang / bdag nyid chen po rin chen bzang pos mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi sdom dang / sngags log sun 'byin pa rgyas pa dang / lo tsā ba chen pos mdzad pa la/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bsdus don dang rnam bshad dang / brgyad stong 'grel pa'i bsdus don dang /sher snying 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bsdus don dang rnam bshad dang / mdo sde rgyan dang/rgyud bla ma dang/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed dang / chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed bzhi'i bsdus don re dang / rnam bshad re dang / dbu ma rtsa she de'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma/ dbu ma rgyan/ dbu ma snang ba/ bslab btus/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa/ bden gnyis chung ba/ man ngag ste brgyad la bsdus don re dang / bden gnyis kyi rnam bshad dang / spyod 'jug gi bsdus don dang rnam bshad dang / dbu ma spyi'i don bsdus dang / tshad ma rnam nges ṭī ka dang bcas pa'i don bsdus dang / rnam bshed chen po dang/ rigs thigs 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i don bsdus dang / rnam bshad dang / rnam 'grel rgyan dang bcas pa'i don bsdus le'u dang po'i stod kyi rnam bshad dang / chos mchog che ba'i man ngag dang po'i tshigs bcad bdun 6 6 bshad pa dang / de'i gzhan sel

bu ston chos 'byung /ba'i skabs cung zad bshad pa dang / slob dpon chos mchog gi tshad mi brtag pa chung ba'i bsdus don dang / sel ba grub pa'i bsdas don dang /stod kyi rnam bshad dang/ skad cig 'jig pa grwab pa'i brjes don dang /bram ze chen po'i sel ba grub pa'i bsdus don dang / stod skye rnam bshad dang / 'brel pa grub pa'i bsdus don dang / stod kyi rnam par bshad pa dang / tsong ga ru gsum gyi dge 'dun la spring yig bdud rtsi'i thig le dang / khri bkra shis dbang phyug nam mkha' btsan la spring pa kha che gser slong la sogs pa mang du mdzad do/ /de ltar mdo sde dang / rgyud sde dang / de dag gi dgongs 'grel rgya gar dang / kha che dang / gser gling dang / siṅga gling dang /u rgyan dang / za hor dang / bal po dang / li dang / rgya dang / bod kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa dang bsgyur ba'i rnam grangs rnams/ pho brang stong thang ldan dkar gyi dkar chag dang / de'i rjes kyi bsam yas mchims phu'i dkar chag dang / de'i rjes kyi 'phang thang ka med kyi dkar chag dang / phyis snar thang gi bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag dang / lo tsā ba chen pos bsgyur ba dang mdzad pa'i dkar chag dang / klu mes la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud kyi rnam dbye dang khrigs kyi dkar chag la sogs pa gzhir byas nas/ de'i steng du phyis 'gyur ba dang / dgon pa so so'i dpe ci rigs par mthong ba'i nang nas ma chud pa ji snyed dang / tshad mar gyur pa'i ngag las thos pa rnams bsnan nas dkar chag tu bris pa'o/ /'di la dor bar bya ba shin tu nyung zhing dri ma med pa'i bka' bstan btsos rnyed na da dung /sdu du bsnan par bya'o/ /chos kyi 'byung

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod las chos kyi rnam grangs dkar chag tu bris pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// /// rigs dang snying rje lhag pa'i bsam sbyor dge ba'i mthu yis thugs bskyed chu gter chen po las/ /brtson 'grus 'bar ba'i drod kyi nus pas pha rol phyin drug tshogs gnyis rlabs chen g.yos pa'i mthus/ /rang bzhin mkha' la sku gsum chu 'dzin thugs rje'i grog phreng tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra ldan pa 'khrigs/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi char gyis skal ldan snod kyi 'byor ba mtha' dag rgyas byed pa/ /'jig rten 'dren pa stobs bcu mnga' ba thub pa rma chog rnams 'jig rten gang du 'byon pa'i tshul/ khyad par nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gdung rabs thub dbang mi mjed zhing du mngon par sangs rgyas shing / /rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te mya ngan 'das nas bstan pa rim par bsdus pa'i tshul/ kha ba can du byung zhing bsgyur ba mkhas pa'i rjes 'bras mdo tsam bu ston kha ches bshad/ /de yi dge ba nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /mtha' yas sems can nor bu me shel la reg pas/ /brtse ba che ldan ye shes chen po'i me 'bar nas/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog bud shing thams cad bsreg par shog /bdag gis mdo dang mdo 'grel mkhas pa'i bstan bcos dang / /mkhas rnams brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsung don ma rtogs te/ /ma bshad log bshad nongs pa'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/ /bden mthong mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams la bzod par gsol/ /gnyis med /sbyang ba'i nyin byed nub gyur cing //

bu ston chos 'byung /bstan 'dzin skye bo'i thun mtshams 'od dang bral/ /nag po'i phyogs gyur sdig spyod 'byung po'i bya/ /lta ngan sna tshogs bzung ste rang dgar spyod/ /chos min spyod pa'i phyogs ni stobs ldan zhing / /dam pa'i las la spyod rnams nyams dus 'dir/ /bdag lta bu yi rtsom pas ci zhig bya/ /dben par bag yod byas na mi legs sam/ /kye ma kho bo sngon gyi bsod nams dman/ /chos nub log spyod dar ba bod kyi yul/ /blun po bkur zhing mkhas rnams rto ltar 'dor/ /chosaldan brnyas pa'i gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes/ /dam pa'i tshul bzung tshul 'chosamakhan po ste/ /snyan par smra na mi chos kha bsag can/ /kun dang bstun na bcol chung blo sna mang / /rang tshugs bzung na gyong po shing lag can/ /bdag gi spyod lam ji ltar byas gyur kyang / /ngan pa'i bsnyad ma btags pa ma byung zhing / /thams cad dga' ba'i spyod pa ma shes pas/ /gcig bur dben par gnas na mi legs sam/ /bdag gis chos min smra ru chos dang 'gal/ /chos bzhin smras na bod rnams dgra ru ldang / /ci yang ma smras kun gyis blun zhes brnyas/ /kye ma da ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /nyan bshad bstan pa 'dzin ces gsungs pa yang //nges 'byung rnam dag khrims la brten bcas nas/ /nyan po gzur gnas don gnyer blo ldan la/ /mkhas pas sde snod 'chad la dgongs pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i grags rnyed 'dod pas 'khor bsdus te/ /ma dad mi 'dod bzhin du chos 'chad cing / /lag len mi byed chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu/ /'chad nyan 'di yang 'khor ba'i zhags pa yin/ /rtsod pas bstan pa 'dzin ces bshad pa yang / /rang gzhan grub mtha'i gzhung lugs ku/ 6 9 / /pha rol yang dag lam la

ba chen 'od thal gas skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()gzhug pa'i phyir/ /lta ngan rigs pas zlog la dgongs pa yin/ /rang nyid grags 'dod pha rol dma' dbab 'dod/ /g.yo sgyu'i rtsod pa tshig rtsub ngan sems can/ /ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud sreg /de lta'i rtsod pa 'di yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /gzhan don chos kyi gtso bor gsungs pa yang / /gdul bya'i dbang po khams dang bag la nyal/ /tshogs dang sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' shes shing / /rang don ma chags gdul bya gdul la dgongs/ /rang nyid rnyed grags bde bstod don gnyer bas/ /mngon shes med par gzhan don byed pa ni/ /gshog pa med par mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin/ /gzhan don mi 'grub rang don nyams pa'i rgyu/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas mang pos ma thul zhing / mthu chen rgyal sras kun gyis ma thul ba/ /smad na khong khro bstod na dregs pa skye/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems can/ /dma' la nga rgyal rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba/ /chos mthun tshig gis smras kyang chags sngang skye/ /byis pa'i skye bo 'di 'dra bdag gis ni/ /da lta gdul bar mi nus rang sems thul/ /sngar bsags bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i lus/ /dal 'byor rten 'di shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru chen 'di/ /don med chud zos ma byed rin chen grub/ /tshe 'di long med myur du 'jig 'gyur zhing / /gsad sar khrid pa'i dud 'gro ji bzhin du/ /skad cig re re zhing yang 'chi la nye / / nges par 'chi ba soms dang rin chen grub/ /deng bya sang bya'i bsam pa ma rdzogs par/ /gshin rje 'jigs rung nyam ngas mdun bsus te/ /mal gyi tha mar dbugs bsdus srog chad tshe/ //sdu las gzhan gyis mi phan rin chen

bu ston chos 'byung /grub/ /tshe 'dir mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir/ /chags sdang longs spyod gsog cing 'khor bsdus kyang / /'khor dang longs spyod rjes su mi 'brang bar//las 'bras sdug bsngal rang nyid gcig pus myong / /tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs/ /'khor ba'i bde 'bras thob kyang mi brtan cing / yī nas ngan 'gror mi 'gro'i gtol med kyi/ /'khor bas yid 'byung byos shig rin chen grub/ /de bas bdag ni myur du shi 'phos te/ /sngon bsags dge ba'i mthu stobs chen po yis/ /dga' ldan skyes nas mi pham mnyes byed cing / /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob par shog /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag nyid gces par 'dzin dang dngos rnams la/ /bden par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi skye bar/ /skyo med gzhan don 'ba' zhig spyod par shog /ngan song gsum du nyam thag sdug bsngal ba'i/ /sems can gzhan yang sdug bsngal mang ldan pa'i/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin gyur cing / /bdag dge'i bde bas sems can kun bde shog /bdag la phan dang gnod pa'i sems bskyed dang / /cung zad dmigs shing dran nam yid byed dang / /ming tsam thos par gyur pa thams cad kyang / /myur du byang chub mchog la reg par shog/dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden stobs dang / /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /smon lam btab pa ji bzhin 'grub par shog /chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ mkhas pa chen po tshad ma'i skyes bu'i gsung gi 'od zer las skyes pa khro phu ba bu ston gyi /ra ba rdzogs so/ /dge zhing bkra shis
'dig 'od snang —/sa skya'i chos5nga tso bsdus/()par gyur cig/sarba maṅga lo// //
